# file opened: zpolice.asm
   1  0000              ;==============================================================================
   2  0000              ; Z-POLICE  -  3D vector city flight for the ZX Spectrum Next
   3  0000              ;
   4  0000              ;  Z80N assembler (sjasmplus --zxnext).  Layer 2 256x192x8bpp, double buffered.
   5  0000              ;  The 3D viewport is the top 256x128; the bottom third is an instrument panel.
   6  0000              ;  Maths: world positions are 16-bit integers (one city cell = 256 units),
   7  0000              ;         trig values are S7.8 fixed point (1.0 = $0100).
   8  0000              ;  Hidden line removal: painter's algorithm. Buildings are walked over the
   9  0000              ;  grid far-to-near (no sort needed). Each visible face is filled in its
  10  0000              ;  shade (roof lighter, side turned away darker) and optionally outlined, so
  11  0000              ;  nearer buildings overwrite those behind them. Faces with every corner on
  12  0000              ;  screen use cached projections; faces crossing the view frustum are
  13  0000              ;  clipped in 3D (Sutherland-Hodgman, 5 planes). Rasterisation then only
  14  0000              ;  ever sees on-screen 8-bit coordinates.
  15  0000              ;
  16  0000              ;  Controls: Q/A speed up/down   Z air brake O/P turn left/right
  17  0000              ;            W/S climb/descend   E/D nose up/down
  18  0000              ;            SPACE fire          1-5 select weapon slot
  19  0000              ;            0 change the centre slot's weapon
  20  0000              ;
  21  0000              ;  Source files: zpolice.asm (resident main code), memory_bank_defs.asm
  22  0000              ;  (slots and pages).  Game logic pages, swapped into slot 6 at $C000:
  23  0000              ;  player.asm (input/movement), weapons.asm, menu.asm (main menu).  Core
  24  0000              ;  function pages, swapped into slot 7 at $E000: city.asm (Layer 2
  25  0000              ;  drawing), hud.asm (ULA HUD), input.asm (redefinable keys, joysticks), sprites.asm
  26  0000              ;  (hardware sprites).  Always mapped: zombie.asm at $2000, human.asm and
  27  0000              ;  map.asm (the city map) at $7000.
  28  0000              ;
  29  0000              ;  Memory while running:
  30  0000              ;    $0000-$1FFF  Layer 2 back buffer, one 8K section at a time (slot 0)
  31  0000              ;    $2000-$3FFF  zombie page (slot 1)
  32  0000              ;    $4000-$7FFF  occlusion data; cell colours, humans, map (slots 2-3)
  33  0000              ;    $8000-$9FFF  ULA screen (slot 4)
  34  0000              ;    $A000-$BFFF  resident code, tables, variables, stack (slot 5)
  35  0000              ;    $C000-$DFFF  game logic page (slot 6)
  36  0000              ;    $E000-$FFFF  core function page (slot 7)
  37  0000              ;==============================================================================
  38  0000
  39  0000                      DEVICE ZXSPECTRUMNEXT
  40  0000                      SLDOPT COMMENT WPMEM, LOGPOINT, ASSERTION
  41  0000                  IFDEF RELEASE
  42  0000 ~                    CSPECTMAP "release_tmp/zpolice.map"
  43  0000                  ELSE
  44  0000                      CSPECTMAP zpolice.map
  45  0000                  ENDIF
  46  0000                      OPT --zxnext=cspect --syntax=a --reversepop
  47  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  48  0000              ; Build options
  49  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  50  0000              ; RELEASE: the build for players (-DRELEASE: build.bat release).  Turns off
  51  0000              ; everything for testing, whatever is set below: the DEBUG_ settings, DRAW_FPS
  52  0000              ; and DOTS_ALL, a START_LEVEL_SET, a START_SALVAGE.  It's assembled into
  53  0000              ; release_tmp/, so the debug build's files (and the tests') stay as they are.
  54  0000
  55  0000              ; DRAW_LINES: outline building faces with EDGE_COL vectors.  Comment it out for solid-colour buildings only; the HUD
  56  0000              ; is always drawn.  Can also be set from the command line: -DDRAW_LINES
  57  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_LINES
  58  0000
  59  0000              ; WAIT_FOR_VBLANK: wait for the raster to leave the display area before
  60  0000              ; flipping the Layer 2 buffers (no tearing).  Comment it out to flip as soon
  61  0000              ; as a frame is drawn: faster, but the flip may tear mid-screen.
  62  0000              ; Command line: -DWAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  63  0000                      ;DEFINE WAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  64  0000
  65  0000              ; DRAW_FPS: measure frames per second from the raster (vtick) and show it at
  66  0000              ; the top left of the ULA screen.  Comment it out to drop the measuring and
  67  0000              ; the display.  Command line: -DDRAW_FPS
  68  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_FPS
  69  0000
  70  0000              ; SKY_IS_WALL: the camera can never rise above the perimeter wall, so fill
  71  0000              ; the sky in the wall's colour and draw wall cells only up to camera height
  72  0000              ; (their top edge is then exactly the horizon).  No sky is ever seen.
  73  0000              ; Command line: -DSKY_IS_WALL
  74  0000                      DEFINE SKY_IS_WALL
  75  0000
  76  0000              ; OCCLUSION_CULL: in level flight, record the buildings, then cull those
  77  0000              ; completely hidden behind nearer ones (a per-column cover buffer, front to
  78  0000              ; back) before drawing the rest.  Uses pages PAGE_OCC0/1 at $4000-$7FFF.
  79  0000              ; Command line: -DOCCLUSION_CULL
  80  0000                      DEFINE OCCLUSION_CULL
  81  0000
  82  0000              ; LEVEL_FAST_PATH: while pitch is 0 (level flight) a building's top corners
  83  0000              ; have the same camera X and Z as the bottom corners below them, so each top
  84  0000              ; corner reuses its bottom corner's screen x and 1/Z and only works out its
  85  0000              ; screen y.  Comment it out to project every corner in full.
  86  0000              ; Command line: -DLEVEL_FAST_PATH
  87  0000                      DEFINE LEVEL_FAST_PATH
  88  0000
  89  0000              ; CLIP_2D: a face that crosses only the screen's sides, top or bottom, and is
  90  0000              ; within a guard band (|X| <= 2Z, |Y| <= Z), has its corners projected to
  91  0000              ; 16-bit screen coordinates and is clipped against the screen in 2D, not in
  92  0000              ; 3D (no new points to project, one multiply per new point, not three).
  93  0000              ; Faces crossing the near plane, or outside the guard band, are clipped in
  94  0000              ; 3D as before.  Comment it out to clip every face in 3D.
  95  0000              ; Command line: -DCLIP_2D
  96  0000                      DEFINE CLIP_2D
  97  0000
  98  0000                  IFDEF RELEASE
  99  0000 ~                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
 100  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE DRAW_FPS
 101  0000 ~                  ENDIF
 102  0000 ~                  IFDEF DOTS_ALL
 103  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE DOTS_ALL
 104  0000 ~                  ENDIF
 105  0000 ~                  IFDEF START_LEVEL_SET
 106  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE START_LEVEL_SET
 107  0000 ~                  ENDIF
 108  0000                  ENDIF

# file opened: memory_bank_defs.asm
   1+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 0000              ; Z-POLICE - memory bank definitions
   3+ 0000              ;
   4+ 0000              ; The Next maps its RAM into the Z80's 64K as eight 8K MMU slots, each set by
   5+ 0000              ; a NextReg ($50-$57) to an 8K page (page n = half of 16K bank n/2).  This
   6+ 0000              ; file names the slots, their registers and addresses, what each slot is
   7+ 0000              ; used for, and which page holds what.  Use:
   8+ 0000              ;   nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_CITY            ; page the city code in at $E000
   9+ 0000              ;   MMU CODE_SLOT e, PAGE_CITY, CODE_ADDR ; (sjasmplus) assemble into it
  10+ 0000              ;
  11+ 0000              ; Memory map (see README.md):
  12+ 0000              ;   slot 0 $0000  Layer 2 sections (32 rows each) while drawing; the sine
  13+ 0000              ;                 table (PAGE_SIN) whenever get_sin reads it
  14+ 0000              ;   slot 1 $2000  zombie page, always mapped: zombies, humans, the HUD
  15+ 0000              ;                 map, the IM 2 table
  16+ 0000              ;   slot 2 $4000  occlusion data
  17+ 0000              ;   slot 3 $6000  the city bank (always mapped): city_col at $6000,
  18+ 0000              ;                 city_map at $7000, loaded from the level's city file
  19+ 0000              ;   slot 4 $8000  ULA screen (page 10, the first half of bank 5)
  20+ 0000              ;   slot 5 $A000  resident main code, variables, stack (page 11, the unused
  21+ 0000              ;                 second half of bank 5)
  22+ 0000              ;   slot 6 $C000  game logic pages, swapped: player, weapons, menu, level
  23+ 0000              ;                 loading
  24+ 0000              ;   slot 7 $E000  core function pages, swapped: city (Layer 2 drawing), HUD,
  25+ 0000              ;                 keys, sprites; a sprite bank while it is loaded; the
  26+ 0000              ;                 start-up set-up (initialise.asm) once
  27+ 0000              ; So game logic in slot 6 can call any core page in slot 7: main_loop pages
  28+ 0000              ; the keys in at $E000 while the player and weapons pages run at $C000.
  29+ 0000              ; At start-up the NEX loader's default mapping is in place (slot 6 = page
  30+ 0000              ; 0), so the entry point is a stub in PAGE_BOOT at $C000 (boot, zpolice.asm)
  31+ 0000              ; that maps the resident page into slot 5 and jumps to start.
  32+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
  33+ 0000
  34+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  35+ 0000              ; MMU slots: number, NextReg, address
  36+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  37+ 0000              MEMBANK_SIZE            equ $2000       ; 8K a slot / page
  38+ 0000
  39+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0              equ 0
  40+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1              equ 1
  41+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2              equ 2
  42+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3              equ 3
  43+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4              equ 4
  44+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5              equ 5
  45+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6              equ 6
  46+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7              equ 7
  47+ 0000
  48+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER     equ $50
  49+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER     equ $51
  50+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER     equ $52
  51+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER     equ $53
  52+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER     equ $54
  53+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER     equ $55
  54+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER     equ $56
  55+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER     equ $57
  56+ 0000
  57+ 0000              membank0                equ $0000
  58+ 0000              membank1                equ $2000
  59+ 0000              membank2                equ $4000
  60+ 0000              membank3                equ $6000
  61+ 0000              membank4                equ $8000
  62+ 0000              membank5                equ $A000
  63+ 0000              membank6                equ $C000
  64+ 0000              membank7                equ $E000
  65+ 0000
  66+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  67+ 0000              ; What each slot is used for: <use>_SLOT, <use>_MMU (its NextReg) and
  68+ 0000              ; <use>_ADDR (the ORG of code or data assembled for it)
  69+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  70+ 0000              ; slot 0: one 32-row section of a Layer 2 buffer at a time (seg_map etc.)
  71+ 0000              L2SEC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_0
  72+ 0000              L2SEC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  73+ 0000              L2SEC_ADDR              equ membank0
  74+ 0000              ; slot 0 also: the sine table, paged in by get_sin (resident).  Only the
  75+ 0000              ; game logic calls it, never the drawing, and every Layer 2 writer maps its
  76+ 0000              ; own section first, so the two never meet.  Nothing may write to
  77+ 0000              ; $0000-$1FFF while it is mapped.
  78+ 0000              SIN_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_0
  79+ 0000              SIN_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  80+ 0000              SIN_ADDR                equ membank0
  81+ 0000
  82+ 0000              ; slot 1: zombie.asm, human.asm, map.asm, interrupts.asm, always mapped
  83+ 0000              ZOMBIE_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_1
  84+ 0000              ZOMBIE_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER
  85+ 0000              ZOMBIE_ADDR             equ membank1
  86+ 0000
  87+ 0000              ; slot 2: occlusion buffer, draw list and building records (OCCLUSION_CULL)
  88+ 0000              OCC_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_2
  89+ 0000              OCC_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER
  90+ 0000              OCC_ADDR                equ membank2
  91+ 0000
  92+ 0000              ; slot 3: the city bank, always mapped: city_col at $6000, city_map at
  93+ 0000              ; $7000, read from the level's city file (level_load.asm) in one go
  94+ 0000              TABLES_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_3
  95+ 0000              TABLES_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER
  96+ 0000              TABLES_ADDR             equ membank3            ; city_col
  97+ 0000              CITYMAP_ADDR            equ membank3+$1000      ; city_map
  98+ 0000
  99+ 0000              ; slot 4: the ULA screen (bank 5's first 8K: bitmap and attributes)
 100+ 0000              ULA_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_4
 101+ 0000              ULA_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER
 102+ 0000              ULA_ADDR                equ membank4
 103+ 0000              ; slot 4 also: the second city page (city2.asm), over the ULA screen while
 104+ 0000              ; main_loop draws the city (nothing then uses the ULA screen)
 105+ 0000              CITY2_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_4
 106+ 0000              CITY2_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER
 107+ 0000              CITY2_ADDR              equ membank4
 108+ 0000
 109+ 0000              ; slot 5: resident main code (zpolice.asm), tables, variables, stack
 110+ 0000              MAIN_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_5
 111+ 0000              MAIN_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER
 112+ 0000              MAIN_ADDR               equ membank5
 113+ 0000
 114+ 0000              ; slot 6: game logic pages, swapped (player, weapons, menu)
 115+ 0000              LOGIC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_6
 116+ 0000              LOGIC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER
 117+ 0000              LOGIC_ADDR              equ membank6
 118+ 0000              ; slot 6 at start-up: the boot stub (the NEX loader maps page 0 there)
 119+ 0000              BOOT_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_6
 120+ 0000              BOOT_ADDR               equ membank6
 121+ 0000
 122+ 0000              ; slot 7: core function pages, swapped (city / Layer 2, HUD, keys, sprites)
 123+ 0000              CODE_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_7
 124+ 0000              CODE_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 125+ 0000              CODE_ADDR               equ membank7
 126+ 0000              ; slot 7 also: a sprite pattern bank (sprite_data.asm), paged in to run
 127+ 0000              ; its own loader, spr_load_bank
 128+ 0000              SPRBANK_SLOT            equ MMU_SLOT_7
 129+ 0000              SPRBANK_MMU             equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 130+ 0000              SPRBANK_ADDR            equ membank7
 131+ 0000
 132+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 133+ 0000              ; 8K pages
 134+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 135+ 0000              PAGE_BOOT               equ 0           ; the NEX entry stub (slot 6 at load)
 136+ 0000              PAGE_CITY               equ 1           ; city.asm: Layer 2 drawing (slot 7)
 137+ 0000              PAGE_HUD                equ 2           ; hud.asm: ULA (Layer 1) HUD (slot 7)
 138+ 0000              PAGE_PLAYER             equ 3           ; player.asm: input, movement,
 139+ 0000                                                      ; collision (slot 6)
 140+ 0000              PAGE_WEAPONS            equ 4           ; weapons.asm: player weapons (slot 6)
 141+ 0000              PAGE_ZOMBIE             equ 5           ; zombie.asm (slot 1, always)
 142+ 0000              PAGE_OCC0               equ 6           ; occlusion buffer, draw list and
 143+ 0000                                                      ; building records (slot 2)
 144+ 0000              PAGE_OCC1               equ 7           ; the city bank: city_col and
 145+ 0000                                                      ; city_map (slot 3, always)
 146+ 0000              PAGE_MENU               equ 8           ; menu.asm: main menu (slot 6)
 147+ 0000              PAGE_SPR0               equ 9           ; sprite_data.asm: sprite pattern
 148+ 0000                                                      ; bank 0 (slot 7 while loading);
 149+ 0000                                                      ; more banks: the next free pages
 150+ 0000              PAGE_ULA0               equ 10          ; the ULA screen, bank 5 (slot 4)
 151+ 0000              PAGE_MAIN               equ 11          ; zpolice.asm, resident (slot 5): the
 152+ 0000                                                      ; second half of bank 5
 153+ 0000              PAGE_INPUT              equ 12          ; input.asm: keyboard, joysticks (slot 7)
 154+ 0000              PAGE_SPRITES            equ 13          ; sprites.asm: hardware sprites
 155+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 7)
 156+ 0000              PAGE_SIN                equ 14          ; sin_tables.asm: the sine table
 157+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 0, read by get_sin)
 158+ 0000              PAGE_INIT               equ 15          ; initialise.asm: start-up set-up,
 159+ 0000                                                      ; initgame (slot 7, once)
 160+ 0000              PAGE_FILE               equ 16          ; file_handler.asm: SD card loading
 161+ 0000                                                      ; and saving (slot 7)
 162+ 0000              PAGE_AUDIO              equ 17          ; audio.asm: sound set-up (slot 7)
 163+ 0000              PAGE_SPECIAL            equ 31          ; specials.asm: special monsters
 164+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 6)
 165+ 0000              PAGE_LOADOUT            equ 32          ; loadout.asm: the load-out screen
 166+ 0000                                                      ; between levels (slot 6)
 167+ 0000              PAGE_KEYDEF             equ 33          ; keydef.asm: the redefine keys
 168+ 0000                                                      ; screen (slot 6)
 169+ 0000              PAGE_CITY2              equ 34          ; city2.asm: more Layer 2 drawing
 170+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 4, with the city page)
 171+ 0000              PAGE_GFX0               equ 35          ; the figures' graphics (pages 35 to
 172+ 0000                                                      ; 35+GFX_PAGES_MAX-1), loaded from
 173+ 0000                                                      ; ZPDATA/SPRITES.ZPG at start-up; each
 174+ 0000                                                      ; mapped at $C000 (slot 6) to draw
 175+ 0000              PAGE_LEVEL              equ 30          ; level_load.asm: level and city
 176+ 0000                                                      ; files (slot 6); pages 18-29 are
 177+ 0000                                                      ; the Layer 2 buffers
 178+ 0000
 179+ 0000              ; Layer 2 double buffer, in 16K banks (NextReg $12 / $13 take banks; the
 180+ 0000              ; pages are bank * 2).  Layer 2 is clipped to 192 rows, so each buffer
 181+ 0000              ; uses three banks.
 182+ 0000              L2_BANK_A               equ 9           ; 16K banks 9-11 (pages 18-23)
 183+ 0000              L2_BANK_B               equ 12          ; 16K banks 12-14 (pages 24-29)

 112  0000
 113  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 114  0000              ; Tuning constants
 115  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 116  0000              ; Scale: one map tile (cell) is 20 m x 20 m = 256 world units, and one
 117  0000              ; height unit (building heights, the ceiling, the pad) is 10 m = 128 world
 118  0000              ; units.  World units are the same size on every axis, so 1 m = 12.8 units
 119  0000              ; and 1 unit = 7.8 cm.  The city is 64 x 64 tiles = 1280 m.
 120  0000              ; Speeds are per rendered frame, so real speed depends on the frame rate
 121  0000              ; (figures below are at 14 fps).
 122  0000              GRID            equ 64          ; the city is GRID x GRID tiles (gentables.py)
 123  0000              ; A city_map byte: bits 0-4 the cell code (0 road, 1-15 building height
 124  0000              ; level, PAD_CODE, TERRACE_CODE, VOID_CODE: out of bounds), bit 6 set while a human waits in the cell
 125  0000              ; (human.asm, hum_flags), bit 7 while a zombie or special monster stands in
 126  0000              ; it (zombie.asm, zflags; its type is in its record).  Bit 5 is free.  So
 127  0000              ; every reader masks with CELL_CODE before testing for road or a code.
 128  0000              CELL_CODE       equ %00011111
 129  0000              CELL_FLAGS      equ %11100000       ; (the marks, kept when the code changes)
 130  0000              CELL_HUMAN_B    equ 6
 131  0000              CELL_ZOMBIE_B   equ 7
 132  0000              CELL_HUMAN      equ 1<<CELL_HUMAN_B
 133  0000              CELL_ZOMBIE     equ 1<<CELL_ZOMBIE_B
 134  0000              TILE_M          equ 20          ; metres per tile (reference scale)
 135  0000              TILE_UNITS      equ 256         ; world units per tile
 136  0000              HEIGHT_M        equ 10          ; metres per height unit
 137  0000              HEIGHT_UNITS    equ 128         ; world units per height unit
 138  0000              NEAR            equ 16          ; near clip plane: 1.25 m
 139  0000              VIEW_R          equ 8           ; most draw distance: buildings within +/- 8
 140  0000                                              ; tiles (160 m).  Each level sets its own,
 141  0000                                              ; 2..VIEW_R (view_r; night, fog), and the
 142  0000                                              ; street dots' radius one less (dot_r)
 143  0000              PMAX            equ 24          ; pitch limit (256 = 360 deg) - match gentables.py
 144  0000              SPEED_MAX       equ 28          ; units/frame: 2.2 m/frame, ~31 m/s (110 km/h)
 145  0000              SPEED_MIN       equ -6          ; reverse: 0.47 m/frame, ~6.6 m/s
 146  0000              YAW_RATE        equ $0180       ; turn per frame, 8.8 fixed (1.5 units;
 147  0000                                              ; 256 units = 360 degrees)
 148  0000              YAW_FINE        equ 256*256/360 ; the first frame of a turn: 1 degree
 149  0000                                              ; (182: 0.711 units, 8.8 fixed)
 150  0000              CLIMB_RATE      equ 4           ; units/frame: 0.31 m/frame, ~4.4 m/s
 151  0000              SPEED_STEP      equ 1           ; Q / A: speed change a frame, units/frame
 152  0000                                              ; (1.1 m/s; player.asm uses inc / dec)
 153  0000                      ASSERT SPEED_STEP == 1
 154  0000              ; Air brake (Z): the speed falls by twice the Q / A step every frame, to 0
 155  0000              AIRBRAKE_STEP   equ 2*SPEED_STEP    ; 2 units/frame (2.2 m/s)
 156  0000              ; Booster module (a salvage reward, fitted at once: boost_fitted).  The
 157  0000              ; boost control (K_BOOST, X) puts the speed straight to BOOST_SPEED, twice
 158  0000              ; SPEED_MAX, if going forwards at BOOST_MIN or more with fuel left; again,
 159  0000              ; or out of fuel, puts back the speed it had (boost_spd).  Q, A and Z don't
 160  0000              ; change the speed while boosting.  Each boosted frame burns 1 fuel
 161  0000              ; (boost_fuel, at most BOOST_FUEL_MAX); landed on the pad it refuels 1 a
 162  0000              ; frame (pad_service).  HUD: the B gauge, and the speed bar amber.
 163  0000              BOOST_SPEED     equ 2*SPEED_MAX     ; 56 units/frame
 164  0000              BOOST_MIN       equ SPEED_MAX/2     ; 14: at least half speed, forwards
 165  0000              BOOST_FUEL_MAX  equ 200
 166  0000                      ASSERT BOOST_SPEED < 128 && BOOST_FUEL_MAX < 256
 167  0000              ; Pitch damper: with neither E nor D held, the nose eases back to level.
 168  0000              ; Every PDAMP_FRAMES frames the 8.8 pitch moves towards 0 by
 169  0000              ; max(PDAMP_MIN, |pitch| * PDAMP_K) in 1/256ths of a pitch unit.  With
 170  0000              ; PDAMP_K 0 that is a steady PDAMP_MIN a frame: half a pitch unit, half the
 171  0000              ; rate of the nose keys (1 unit a frame), however far it is from level.  (A
 172  0000              ; PDAMP_K above 0 adds a share of what is left, faster when far off: 43, as

 655  0000              ; HL = HL * GRID  (a map row offset)
 656  0000                      MACRO ROWOFS
 657  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 658  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 659  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 660  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 661  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 662  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 663  0000                      ENDM
 664  0000
 665  0000              ; A building's 8 corners (vtx, 16 bytes each; index = x + 2*z + 4*top) from
 666  0000              ; corner 0, component C (0 X, 2 Y, 4 Z) at a time: v1 = v0 + vx, v3 = v1 +
 667  0000              ; vz, v2 = v0 + vz (vx, vz: vecs0, its edge vectors), and each top corner
 668  0000              ; its bottom corner + vy (vy_vec, the vertical edge).  The sums the corners
 669  0000              ; share are made once, in registers (draw_bld, city.asm).
 670  0000                      MACRO VBOX C
 671  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)                   ; v0
 672  0000 ~                    ld de,(vecs0+C)                 ; vx
 673  0000 ~                    ld bc,(vecs0+6+C)               ; vz
 674  0000 ~                    push hl
 675  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 676  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+16+C),hl                ; v1 = v0 + vx
 677  0000 ~                    push hl
 678  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 679  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+48+C),hl                ; v3 = v1 + vz
 680  0000 ~                    ld de,(vy_vec+C)                ; vy
 681  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 682  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+112+C),hl               ; v7 = v3 + vy
 683  0000 ~                    pop hl
 684  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 685  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+80+C),hl                ; v5 = v1 + vy
 686  0000 ~                    pop hl
 687  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 688  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+32+C),hl                ; v2 = v0 + vz
 689  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 690  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+96+C),hl                ; v6 = v2 + vy
 691  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)
 692  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 693  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+64+C),hl                ; v4 = v0 + vy
 694  0000                      ENDM
 695  0000              ; The same for a component of vy that is 0 (X always; Z in level flight):
 696  0000              ; each top corner is its bottom corner
 697  0000                      MACRO VBOX0 C
 698  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)                   ; v0
 699  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+64+C),hl                ; v4 = v0
 700  0000 ~                    ld de,(vecs0+C)
 701  0000 ~                    ld bc,(vecs0+6+C)
 702  0000 ~                    push hl
 703  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 704  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+16+C),hl                ; v1 = v0 + vx
 705  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+80+C),hl                ; v5
 706  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 707  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+48+C),hl                ; v3 = v1 + vz
 708  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+112+C),hl               ; v7
 709  0000 ~                    pop hl
 710  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 711  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+32+C),hl                ; v2 = v0 + vz
 712  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+96+C),hl                ; v6
 713  0000                      ENDM
 714  0000
 715  0000              ; Copy cached screen corner of face vertex (HL)+ into p2buf (DE)+ with the
 716  0000              ; outline flag for edge bit EB taken from df_mask.  B = high vtx.
 717  0000                      MACRO FACEVTX EB
 718  0000 ~                    ld a,(hl)
 719  0000 ~                    inc hl
 720  0000 ~                    add a,7
 721  0000 ~                    ld c,a
 722  0000 ~                    ld a,(bc)
 723  0000 ~                    ld (de),a
 724  0000 ~                    inc e
 725  0000 ~                    inc c
 726  0000 ~                    ld a,(bc)
 727  0000 ~                    ld (de),a
 728  0000 ~                    inc e
 729  0000 ~                    ld a,(df_mask)
 730  0000 ~                    and EB
 731  0000 ~                    ld (de),a
 732  0000 ~                    inc e
 733  0000 ~                    inc e
 734  0000                      ENDM

 737  0000              ; NEX entry: the loader leaves its default mapping (slot 6 = page 0, slot 5

 739  0000              ; the resident page into slot 5 and jumps to start.

 741  0000                      MMU BOOT_SLOT e, PAGE_BOOT, BOOT_ADDR

 749  C00B 00 00 00...              ds 16                       ; the loader's stack, until start

 759  A057                      INCLUDE "levels.asm"            ; the current level's record
# file opened: levels.asm
   1+ A057              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A057              ; Z-POLICE - the current level's settings (resident, so any page can read
   3+ A057              ; them)
   4+ A057              ;
   5+ A057              ; level_cur holds the record of the level being played, loaded from its file
   6+ A057              ; ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPL by load_level (level_load.asm).  LV_SIZE bytes:
   7+ A057              ;   +0  LV_NUM          level number
   8+ A057              ;   +1  LV_NAME         city name, 8 characters (ASCII, space padded)
   9+ A057              ;   +9  LV_ZOMBIES      number of zombies a wave (at most NZOMB)
  10+ A057              ;   +10 LV_WAVES        number of zombie waves (1..LV_MAX_WAVES)
  11+ A057              ;   +11 LV_FAST         number of fast zombies (of LV_ZOMBIES)
  12+ A057              ;   +12 LV_VIEW_R       draw distance in tiles, 2..VIEW_R (fewer: night or
  13+ A057              ;                       fog); load_level sets view_r / dot_r from it
  14+ A057              ;   +13 LV_WAVE_DATA    the special monsters of each wave, waves 1 to
  15+ A057              ;                       LV_MAX_WAVES (wave 1 is the level's start), LV_WAVE_REC
  16+ A057              ;                       bytes each:
  17+ A057              ;         +0  LV_SPECIAL_ID   LV_SPEC_SLOTS special types (SPEC_*;
  18+ A057              ;                             SPEC_NONE, 255: none in that place)
  19+ A057              ;         +5  LV_SPECIAL      how many of each (in the same places)
  20+ A057              ; The levels and their cities are made by gentables.py (ZPDATA/); a level
  21+ A057              ; file can be replaced by a hand-made one (or its text form, .TXL, edited).
  22+ A057              ;==============================================================================
  23+ A057
  24+ A057              LV_NUM          equ 0
  25+ A057              LV_NAME         equ 1
  26+ A057              LV_NAME_LEN     equ 8
  27+ A057              LV_ZOMBIES      equ LV_NAME+LV_NAME_LEN
  28+ A057              LV_WAVES        equ LV_ZOMBIES+1
  29+ A057              LV_FAST         equ LV_WAVES+1
  30+ A057              LV_VIEW_R       equ LV_FAST+1
  31+ A057              LV_WAVE_DATA    equ LV_VIEW_R+1
  32+ A057              LV_MAX_WAVES    equ 10              ; waves a level can have specials for
  33+ A057              LV_SPEC_SLOTS   equ 5               ; special types a wave
  34+ A057              LV_SPECIAL_ID   equ 0               ; (in a wave's data) the types,
  35+ A057              LV_SPECIAL      equ LV_SPEC_SLOTS   ;   then how many of each
  36+ A057              LV_WAVE_REC     equ 2*LV_SPEC_SLOTS
  37+ A057              LV_SIZE         equ LV_WAVE_DATA+LV_MAX_WAVES*LV_WAVE_REC   ; 113 bytes
  38+ A057                      ASSERT LV_SIZE == 113           ; (gentables.py writes it)
  39+ A057              ; Special monster types in the level files (specials.asm: spec_types)
  40+ A057              SPEC_GHOST      equ 0
  41+ A057              SPEC_BANSHEE    equ 1
  42+ A057              SPEC_GHOUL      equ 2
  43+ A057              SPEC_LICH       equ 3
  44+ A057              SPEC_IDS        equ 4               ; (how many types)
  45+ A057              SPEC_CLUSTER    equ 4               ; not a monster: the wave's zombies spawn in
  46+ A057                                                  ; this many clusters (zcluster, zombie.asm)
  47+ A057                      ASSERT SPEC_CLUSTER >= SPEC_IDS ; (spec_wave skips it)
  48+ A057              SPEC_NONE       equ 255
  49+ A057
  50+ A057              ; -> HL = the current level's record
  51+ A057              level_entry:
  52+ A057 21 5B A0             ld hl,level_cur
  53+ A05A C9                   ret
  54+ A05B
  55+ A05B 00 00 00...  level_cur:  ds LV_SIZE                  ; the level being played (load_level)
  56+ A0CC
# file closed: levels.asm

 100+ A146              ; Wait for the start of the next video frame (the raster reaching line 192)
 101+ A146              menu_frame:
 102+ A146 CD 51 A1     .in:    call menu_line                  ; let any current blanking end
 103+ A149 30 FB                jr nc,.in

 107+ A151
 108+ A151              ; Carry clear if the raster is at line 192 or later (blanking).  The line is
 109+ A151              ; read as high byte ($1E), low byte ($1F), high byte again: if the high
 110+ A151              ; byte changed in between (line 255 -> 256) the pair is torn, so read again.
 111+ A151              menu_line:
 112+ A151 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 113+ A154 3E 1E                ld a,$1E

 115+ A158 04                   inc b

 117+ A15B 05                   dec b

 129+ A16E E6 01                and 1
 130+ A170 C0                   ret nz                          ; line >= 256 (carry clear)
 131+ A171 7A                   ld a,d
 132+ A172 FE C0                cp 192
 133+ A174 C9                   ret

 761  A375                      INCLUDE "sfx_data.asm"          ; the sound effects (sfx_tick plays them)
# file opened: sfx_data.asm
   1+ A375              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A375              ; Z-POLICE - sound effect data (resident: the main page, slot 5, always
   3+ A375              ; mapped, so the interrupt routine can read it whatever else is paged in)
   4+ A375              ;
   5+ A375              ; Played on AY 2 by sfx_tick (interrupts.asm); the game asks for one with
   6+ A375              ; ld a,SFX_n / ld (sfx_req),a (the numbers are in audio.asm).  A sound is a
   7+ A375              ; list of steps, one an interrupt (20 ms): each step is AY register / value
   8+ A375              ; pairs, ended by SFX_STEP (the next step next interrupt) or SFX_END (over).
   9+ A375              ; The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is 109375/P Hz; a
  10+ A375              ; lower noise period is a brighter hiss.
  11+ A375              ;==============================================================================
  12+ A375
  13+ A375              ; One step of a zap: channel A at tone period p, channel B 2 periods flat
  14+ A375              ; (the two beat: a buzz), volumes v and v-2
  15+ A375                  MACRO SFX_ZAP p, v
  16+ A375 ~                    db AY_TONE_A, low (p), AY_TONE_A+1, high (p)
  17+ A375 ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low ((p)+2), AY_TONE_B+1, high ((p)+2)
  18+ A375 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, v, AY_VOL_B, (v)-2, SFX_STEP
  19+ A375                  ENDM
  20+ A375
  21+ A375              ; One step of a woosh: channel A's noise at period n, volume v
  22+ A375                  MACRO SFX_WOOSH n, v
  23+ A375 ~                    db AY_NOISE, n, AY_VOL_A, v, SFX_STEP
  24+ A375                  ENDM
  25+ A375
  26+ A375              ; An explosion: a deep noise (channel A, darkening: period 16 up to 30) over
  27+ A375              ; a low rumble (channel B, BOOM_RUMBLE), both from volume peak (B 2 less)
  28+ A375              ; fading to nothing over len steps.  (A falling level is an exponential fade:
  29+ A375              ; the AY's levels are logarithmic.)
  30+ A375              BOOM_RUMBLE     equ 2735            ; 109375 / 2735 = 40 Hz
  31+ A375                  MACRO SFX_BOOM peak, len
  32+ A375 ~                    db AY_MIXER, SFX_MIX_BOOM       ; (channel C: the splats', left alone)
  33+ A375 ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low BOOM_RUMBLE, AY_TONE_B+1, high BOOM_RUMBLE
  34+ A375 ~            BOOM_I  DEFL 0
  35+ A375 ~                    DUP len
  36+ A375 ~                    db AY_NOISE, 16 + (BOOM_I*15)/(len)
  37+ A375 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, ((peak)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  38+ A375 ~                    db AY_VOL_B, (((peak)-2)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  39+ A375 ~                    db SFX_STEP
  40+ A375 ~            BOOM_I  DEFL BOOM_I+1
  41+ A375 ~                    EDUP
  42+ A375 ~                    db AY_VOL_A, 0, AY_VOL_B, 0, SFX_END
  43+ A375                  ENDM
  44+ A375
  45+ A375              ; One step of a splat: channel C (only: see sfx_tick) at tone period p,
  46+ A375              ; volume v
  47+ A375                  MACRO SFX_SPLAT_STEP p, v
  48+ A375 ~                    db AY_TONE_C, low (p), AY_TONE_C+1, high (p), AY_VOL_C, v, SFX_STEP
  49+ A375                  ENDM

 158+ A498              ; Explosions (rocket_blast, weapons.asm; on AY 3).  Each one's loudness in
 159+ A498              ; proportion to its blast's size, damage x reach (game units):
 160+ A498              ;   missile 15 x 256 = 3840, rocket 20 x 64 = 1280, autocannon 4 x 38 = 152,
 161+ A498              ;   proximity 3 x 25 = 75.
 162+ A498              ; Sound level is logarithmic (about 2 AY levels each doubling), so the peak
 163+ A498              ; is 15 + 2*log2(size / the missile's): 15, 12, 6, 4; and the bigger the

 176+ A6CA
 177+ A6CA              ; The VTOL hitting a building (player.asm; on AY 3, as the explosions): a
 178+ A6CA              ; low crunch, like a missile's blast but deeper and shorter.  A cracking
 179+ A6CA              ; hit (brighter noise, full volume) drops at once into the deepest noise
 180+ A6CA              ; (period 31) over a lower rumble than the blasts' (about 27 Hz, channel B),
 181+ A6CA              ; fading over 260 ms.
 182+ A6CA              CRASH_RUMBLE    equ 4000            ; 109375 / 4000 = 27 Hz
 183+ A6CA                      ASSERT CRASH_RUMBLE < 4096
 184+ A6CA              CRASH_LEN       equ 10              ; the fade, steps
 185+ A6CA              ; The missile lock: two short high beeps (about 1.5 kHz, channel A), 80 ms
 186+ A6CA              ; each with 40 ms between
 187+ A6CA              LOCK_TONE       equ 73              ; tone period: 109375 / 73 = 1.5 kHz
 188+ A6CA              sfx_lock:
 189+ A6CA 07 3E                db AY_MIXER, SFX_MIX_TONE_A
 190+ A6CC 09 00 0A 00          db AY_VOL_B, 0, AY_VOL_C, 0
 191+ A6D0 00 49 01 00          db AY_TONE_A, low LOCK_TONE, AY_TONE_A+1, high LOCK_TONE
 192+ A6D4 08 0C FE FE          db AY_VOL_A, 12, SFX_STEP, SFX_STEP, SFX_STEP, SFX_STEP
 192+ A6D8 FE FE
 193+ A6DA 08 00 FE FE          db AY_VOL_A, 0, SFX_STEP, SFX_STEP
 194+ A6DE 08 0C FE FE          db AY_VOL_A, 12, SFX_STEP, SFX_STEP, SFX_STEP, SFX_STEP
 194+ A6E2 FE FE
 195+ A6E4 08 00 FF             db AY_VOL_A, 0, SFX_END

  46+ A7FF              ; DMA fill: HL = destination, BC = length (non-zero), A = the byte.  Any
  47+ A7FF              ; memory mapped in now (the Layer 2 sections in slot 0, the occlusion page,
  48+ A7FF              ; the ULA screen).  Resident (the main page, with this block), so the city,
  49+ A7FF              ; HUD and menu pages all use it.  It leaves the length's high byte set:
  50+ A7FF              ; fill_spans needs it 0 (clear_screen.spans), so the city page restores it
  51+ A7FF              ; after a fill of its own.
  52+ A7FF              dma_fill:

  54+ A802 22 F9 A7             ld (l2_fill_bstrt),hl

  56+ A809 21 ED A7             ld hl,l2_fill
  57+ A80C 06 12                ld b,l2_fill_cmd_len

 963  A9B4              main_loop:
 964  A9B4 ED 91 57 0C          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INPUT     ; input at $E000, while the logic runs
 965  A9B8 CD 00 E0             call kbd_scan                   ; all key and joystick banks
 966  A9BB 3E 12                ld a,K_PAUSE                    ; paused until the pause control is
 967  A9BD CD CF E0             call key_pressed                ; pressed again
 968  A9C0 C4 3E AB             call nz,game_pause
 969  A9C3 3E 14                ld a,K_VISION                   ; the next vision mode the VTOL has
 970  A9C5 CD CF E0             call key_pressed                ; (level_load.asm: its palettes are
 971  A9C8 28 07                jr z,.nv                        ; there)
 972  A9CA ED 91 56 1E          nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_LEVEL
 973  A9CE CD 73 C1             call vis_cycle
 974  A9D1              .nv:
 975  A9D1 ED 91 56 03          nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_PLAYER   ; input/movement logic at $C000
 976  A9D5 CD 00 C0             call update_player
 977  A9D8 CD 27 AE             call setup_frame
 978  A9DB CD BC 21             call zombie_update              ; walk the zombies (page at $2000)
 979  A9DE ED 91 56 1F          nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_SPECIAL  ; and fly the special monsters
 980  A9E2 CD AA C0             call spec_update                ; (specials.asm)
 981  A9E5 ED 91 56 04          nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_WEAPONS  ; weapons logic at $C000
 982  A9E9 CD 00 C0             call update_weapons             ; fire, move rounds, hits
 983  A9EC CD 3F 32             call human_update               ; map dots, rescues (page at $7000)
 984  A9EF 3A B7 AF             ld a,(game_over)
 985  A9F2 B7                   or a
 986  A9F3 28 07                jr z,.play
 987  A9F5 ED 91 56 08          nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_MENU     ; the pad is destroyed: game over
 988  A9F9 C3 54 C0             jp game_over_screen             ; (menu.asm) -> main menu
 989  A9FC 3A B5 AF     .play:  ld a,(level_done)
 990  A9FF B7                   or a
 991  AA00 28 07                jr z,.go
 992  AA02 ED 91 56 08          nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_MENU     ; the last wave wiped out: level
 993  AA06 C3 93 C0             jp level_complete_screen        ; complete (menu.asm) -> next_level
 994  AA09              .go:
 995  AA09 CD 4D AA             call map_shadow
 996  AA0C                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
 997  AA0C ~                    call vtick
 998  AA0C                  ENDIF
 999  AA0C ED 91 57 01          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_CITY      ; Layer 2 drawing code at $E000
1000  AA10 ED 91 54 22          nextreg CITY2_MMU,PAGE_CITY2    ; and more at $8000, over the ULA
1001  AA14 CD 5B F2             call clear_screen               ;   screen (city2.asm)
1002  AA17                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
1003  AA17 ~                    call vtick
1004  AA17                  ENDIF
1005  AA17 CD 00 80             call draw_dots
1006  AA1A                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
1007  AA1A ~                    call vtick
1008  AA1A                  ENDIF
1009  AA1A CD AA F2             call draw_city                  ; also calls vtick once per building
1010  AA1D CD E7 81             call draw_bullets               ; machine gun tracers
1011  AA20 CD 9C 83             call draw_particles             ; zombie bursts
1012  AA23 CD D2 84             call draw_gunsight
1013  AA26 CD 35 85             call draw_reticule              ; the missile lock (city2.asm)
1014  AA29 ED 91 54 0A          nextreg ULA_MMU,PAGE_ULA0       ; the ULA screen back at $8000
1015  AA2D ED 91 57 02          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_HUD       ; ULA HUD code at $E000
1016  AA31 CD C4 E3             call draw_hud
1017  AA34                  IFDEF WAIT_FOR_VBLANK
1018  AA34 ~                    call wait_vblank
1019  AA34                  ENDIF
1020  AA34 CD 57 AA             call l2_flip
1021  AA37 CD 6A AA             call shake_tick                 ; a crash: the view shaken
1022  AA3A                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
1023  AA3A ~                    call fps_tick                   ; HUD page is still at $E000
1024  AA3A                  ENDIF
1025  AA3A ED 91 57 0D          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPRITES   ; the HUD sprites (humans, compass)
1026  AA3E CD DC E2             call hud_sprites                ; (hud_sprites.asm), with the new frame
1027  AA41 C3 B4 A9             jp main_loop
1028  AA44
1029  AA44              ;==============================================================================
1030  AA44              ; Frames per second, shown on the ULA layer above Layer 2.
1031  AA44              ;
1032  AA44              ; Interrupts stay off (the span filler borrows SP), so time is taken from the
1033  AA44              ; raster: vtick reads the current video line and counts a new 50Hz video
1034  AA44              ; frame whenever the line number has gone backwards.  It must be called at
1035  AA44              ; least once per video frame (~560K T at 28MHz); the main loop and draw_cell
1036  AA44              ; do that.  Every 50 video frames (1 second) the number of frames rendered
1037  AA44              ; becomes the FPS figure.
1038  AA44              ;==============================================================================
1039  AA44                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
1040  AA44 ~            vtick:
1041  AA44 ~                    ld bc,$243B
1042  AA44 ~                    ld a,$1E
1043  AA44 ~                    out (c),a
1044  AA44 ~                    inc b
1045  AA44 ~                    in d,(c)                        ; line MSB
1046  AA44 ~                    dec b
1047  AA44 ~                    ld a,$1F
1048  AA44 ~                    out (c),a
1049  AA44 ~                    inc b
1050  AA44 ~                    in e,(c)                        ; line LSB
1051  AA44 ~                    dec b
1052  AA44 ~                    ld a,$1E
1053  AA44 ~                    out (c),a
1054  AA44 ~                    inc b
1055  AA44 ~                    in a,(c)
1056  AA44 ~                    cp d
1057  AA44 ~                    jr nz,vtick                     ; MSB changed mid-read: try again
1058  AA44 ~                    and 1
1059  AA44 ~                    ld d,a                          ; DE = video line 0..311
1060  AA44 ~                    ld hl,(fps_line)
1061  AA44 ~                    ld (fps_line),de
1062  AA44 ~                    or a
1063  AA44 ~                    sbc hl,de                       ; previous - current
1064  AA44 ~                    ret c
1065  AA44 ~                    ret z
1066  AA44 ~                    ld hl,fps_vframes               ; line went backwards: new frame
1067  AA44 ~                    inc (hl)
1068  AA44 ~                    ret
1069  AA44 ~
1070  AA44 ~            ; Once per rendered frame, after the flip
1071  AA44 ~            fps_tick:
1072  AA44 ~                    call vtick
1073  AA44 ~                    ld hl,fps_count
1074  AA44 ~                    inc (hl)
1075  AA44 ~                    ld a,(fps_vframes)
1076  AA44 ~                    cp 50
1077  AA44 ~                    ret c
1078  AA44 ~                    sub 50
1079  AA44 ~                    ld (fps_vframes),a
1080  AA44 ~                    ld a,(fps_count)
1081  AA44 ~                    ld (fps_value),a
1082  AA44 ~                    xor a
1083  AA44 ~                    ld (fps_count),a
1084  AA44 ~                    jp fps_draw                     ; HUD page (paged in by main_loop)
1085  AA44                  ENDIF
1086  AA44
1087  AA44              ; A = NextReg number -> A = its value
1088  AA44              read_nextreg:
1089  AA44 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
1090  AA47 ED 79                out (c),a
1091  AA49 04                   inc b
1092  AA4A ED 78                in a,(c)
1093  AA4C C9                   ret
1094  AA4D
1095  AA4D              ; Select the shadow Layer 2 buffer for drawing: remember the 8K page of its
1096  AA4D              ; first row.  Sections are then paged in on demand by seg_map / line_seg.
1097  AA4D              map_shadow:
1098  AA4D 3E 13                ld a,$13
1099  AA4F CD 44 AA             call read_nextreg
1100  AA52 87                   add a,a                         ; 16K bank -> 8K page
1101  AA53 32 BF B6             ld (seg_base),a
1102  AA56 C9                   ret
1103  AA57
1104  AA57              ; Show the shadow buffer and make the old active buffer the new shadow
1105  AA57              l2_flip:
1106  AA57 3E 12                ld a,$12
1107  AA59 CD 44 AA             call read_nextreg
1108  AA5C 5F                   ld e,a                          ; old active
1109  AA5D 3E 13                ld a,$13
1110  AA5F CD 44 AA             call read_nextreg
1111  AA62 ED 92 12             nextreg $12,a                   ; shadow -> active
1112  AA65 7B                   ld a,e
1113  AA66 ED 92 13             nextreg $13,a                   ; old active -> shadow
1114  AA69 C9                   ret
1115  AA6A
1116  AA6A              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1117  AA6A              ; Layer 2 writes go through MMU slot 0 ($0000-$1FFF) only.  Each 8K page of
1118  AA6A              ; the buffer is a 32-row section, so row y is page seg_base + y/32 and its
1119  AA6A              ; pixels are at (y & 31)*256 + x.  Sections are paged in as drawing reaches
1120  AA6A              ; them.  Slots 4-5 keep the ULA screen.
1121  AA6A              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1122  AA6A
1123  AA6A              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1124  AA6A              ; Screen shake, when the VTOL hits a building (player.asm sets shake_t to
1125  AA6A              ; SHAKE_LEN).  Each rendered frame, as it is shown, the Layer 2 view is
1126  AA6A              ; offset by the next pair of shake_xy through the scroll registers, a pixel
1127  AA6A              ; or two each way, dying away; the last pair (0, 0) puts it back.  Only
1128  AA6A              ; Layer 2 moves: the HUD is on the ULA.  (X wraps at 256, Y at 192: -n is
1129  AA6A              ; 256-n and 192-n.  An edge row or column of the view shows the far side's
1130  AA6A              ; meanwhile.)
1131  AA6A              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1132  AA6A              SHAKE_LEN       equ 6               ; rendered frames (about half a second)
1133  AA6A              shake_tick:
1134  AA6A 3A 9C AA             ld a,(shake_t)
1135  AA6D B7                   or a
1136  AA6E C8                   ret z
1137  AA6F 3D                   dec a
1138  AA70 32 9C AA             ld (shake_t),a
1139  AA73 87                   add a,a
1140  AA74 21 90 AA             ld hl,shake_xy
1141  AA77 ED 31                add hl,a
1142  AA79 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1143  AA7A ED 92 16             nextreg $16,a                   ; Layer 2 scroll X
1144  AA7D 23                   inc hl
1145  AA7E 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1146  AA7F ED 92 17             nextreg $17,a                   ; Layer 2 scroll Y
1147  AA82 C9                   ret
1148  AA83
1149  AA83              ; Stop any shake: the view back in place
1150  AA83              shake_off:
1151  AA83 AF                   xor a
1152  AA84 32 9C AA             ld (shake_t),a
1153  AA87 ED 91 16 00          nextreg $16,0
1154  AA8B ED 91 17 00          nextreg $17,0
1155  AA8F C9                   ret
1156  AA90
1157  AA90              ; (x, y) pixels, used from the last pair back to the first
1158  AA90 00 00 01 00  shake_xy:   db 0,0, 1,0, 256-1,192-1, 1,1, 256-2,192-1, 2,1
1158  AA94 FF BF 01 01
1158  AA98 FE BF 02 01
1159  AA9C                      ASSERT $ - shake_xy == 2*SHAKE_LEN
1160  AA9C 00           shake_t:    db 0                        ; frames of shake left (0: none)
1161  AA9D 00           gfx_ok:     db 0                        ; 1: the figures' graphics are loaded
1162  AA9E
1163  AA9E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1164  AA9E              ; Wait until the raster is outside the display area (line >= 192)
1165  AA9E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1166  AA9E              wait_vblank:
1167  AA9E 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
1168  AAA1 3E 1E                ld a,$1E
1169  AAA3 ED 79                out (c),a
1170  AAA5 04                   inc b
1171  AAA6 ED 78                in a,(c)
1172  AAA8 E6 01                and 1
1173  AAAA C0                   ret nz                          ; line >= 256
1174  AAAB 05                   dec b
1175  AAAC 3E 1F                ld a,$1F
1176  AAAE ED 79                out (c),a
1177  AAB0 04                   inc b
1178  AAB1 ED 78                in a,(c)
1179  AAB3 FE C0                cp 192
1180  AAB5 38 E7                jr c,wait_vblank
1181  AAB7 C9                   ret
1182  AAB8
1183  AAB8              ; HL -> map byte for the cell the camera is in
1184  AAB8              cam_cell_ptr:
1185  AAB8 3A 98 AF             ld a,(cam_z+2)
1186  AABB 6F                   ld l,a
1187  AABC 26 00                ld h,0
1188  AABE                      ROWOFS
1188  AABE 29          >        add hl,hl
1188  AABF 29          >        add hl,hl
1188  AAC0 29          >        add hl,hl
1188  AAC1 29          >        add hl,hl
1188  AAC2 29          >        add hl,hl
1188  AAC3 29          >        add hl,hl
1189  AAC4 3A 95 AF             ld a,(cam_x+2)
1190  AAC7 ED 31                add hl,a
1191  AAC9 11 00 70             ld de,city_map
1192  AACC 19                   add hl,de
1193  AACD C9                   ret
1194  AACE
1195  AACE              ; A = damage to the VTOL (a building crash, a ghost): its hit points
1196  AACE              ; (vtol_hp) fall by that, not below 0.  At 0 it is destroyed (vtol_dead): it
1197  AACE              ; spins down out of control (vtol_wreck, player.asm), then the game is over.
1198  AACE              vtol_damage:
1199  AACE B7                   or a
1200  AACF C8                   ret z
1201  AAD0 4F                   ld c,a
1202  AAD1 3A B0 AF             ld a,(vtol_hp)
1203  AAD4 91                   sub c
1204  AAD5 30 01                jr nc,.hp
1205  AAD7 AF                   xor a
1206  AAD8 32 B0 AF     .hp:    ld (vtol_hp),a
1207  AADB C0                   ret nz
1208  AADC 3E 01                ld a,1
1209  AADE 32 B1 AF             ld (vtol_dead),a
1210  AAE1 C9                   ret
1211  AAE2
1212  AAE2              ; HL = the height the VTOL rests at: MIN_Y when its whole footprint is over
1213  AAE2              ; road, or just clear (COLL_H) of the highest roof under it
1214  AAE2              floor_y:
1215  AAE2 CD 4F AD             call vtol_ground
1216  AAE5 21 08 00             ld hl,MIN_Y

1222  AAF1
1223  AAF1              ; Weapon type details, by WPN_*: its full load, reload frames a shot (0:
1224  AAF1              ; doesn't reload; the AMMO_INF weapons) and the slots it may be fitted in
1225  AAF1              ; (resident, for the weapons page and the load-out screen)
1226  AAF1 00 00 1F     wpn_cfg:    db 0, 0, WS_ANY                             ; WPN_NONE (empty)
1227  AAF4 FF 00 01                 db AMMO_INF, 0, WS_CENTRE                   ; WPN_GUN
1228  AAF7 FF 00 01                 db AMMO_INF, 0, WS_CENTRE                   ; WPN_LASER
1229  AAFA FF 00 01                 db AMMO_INF, 0, WS_CENTRE                   ; WPN_CHAIN
1230  AAFD 0C 0F 1E                 db ROCKET_SHOTS, ROCKET_RELOAD, WS_PYLONS   ; WPN_ROCKETS
1231  AB00 04 1E 1E                 db MISSILE_SHOTS, MISSILE_RELOAD, WS_PYLONS ; WPN_MISSILE
1232  AB03 01 1E 1E                 db BOMB_SHOTS, BOMB_RELOAD, WS_PYLONS       ; WPN_BOMB
1233  AB06 32 07 1E                 db AUTOCANNON_SHOTS, AUTOCANNON_RELOAD, WS_PYLONS ; WPN_AUTOCANNON
1234  AB09 32 07 1E                 db PROX_SHOTS, PROX_RELOAD, WS_PYLONS       ; WPN_PROX
1235  AB0C C8 01 08                 db LINK_SHOTS, LINK_RELOAD, WS_LINK_L       ; WPN_LCHAIN_L
1236  AB0F C8 01 10                 db LINK_SHOTS, LINK_RELOAD, WS_LINK_R       ; WPN_LCHAIN_R
1237  AB12                      ASSERT LINK_SHOTS < AMMO_INF
1238  AB12                      ASSERT WPN_ROCKETS == 4 && WPN_MISSILE == 5 && WPN_AUTOCANNON == 7
1239  AB12                      ASSERT WPN_PROX == 8 && WPN_LCHAIN_L == 9 && WPN_LCHAIN_R == 10
1240  AB12                      ASSERT $ - wpn_cfg == WCFG_SIZE*(WPN_LAST+1)
1241  AB12
1242  AB12              ; A = weapon type -> HL = its wpn_cfg entry.  Preserves BC, DE.
1243  AB12              wpn_cfg_ptr:

1245  AB13 87                   add a,a

1247  AB15 21 F1 AA             ld hl,wpn_cfg
1248  AB18 ED 31                add hl,a
1249  AB1A C9                   ret
1250  AB1B                      ASSERT WCFG_SIZE == 3
1251  AB1B
1252  AB1B              ; A = weapon type, C = slot (0 = the centre slot): carry set if the weapon
1253  AB1B              ; may be fitted in that slot (WCFG_SLOTS).  Preserves DE.

1283  AB3E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1284  AB3E              ; Paused (main_loop: the pause control, K_PAUSE, BREAK or a Mega Drive pad's
1285  AB3E              ; START by default): PAUSED over the view, white on an opaque black ULA box,
1286  AB3E              ; and under it S: SAVE AND QUIT and X: QUIT, NO SAVE, until the pause control
1287  AB3E              ; is pressed again.  Nothing moves meanwhile and the screen keeps its last
1288  AB3E              ; frame.  S (fixed: only while paused) saves the game (save_game) and goes
1289  AB3E              ; back to the main menu; if it can't be saved, SAVE FAILED, and it stays
1290  AB3E              ; paused.  (Not in a wreck: nothing to save.)  X (fixed too) goes back to
1291  AB3E              ; the main menu without saving: the game is lost, and any save game is left
1292  AB3E              ; as it was.  Needs the input page in slot 7.
1293  AB3E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1294  AB3E              PAUSE_ROW       equ 7               ; ULA character row and column of the box
1295  AB3E              PAUSE_COL       equ 12
1296  AB3E              PAUSE_ROW2      equ 9               ; and of the save line
1297  AB3E              PAUSE_COL2      equ 7
1298  AB3E              PAUSE_ROW3      equ 10              ; and of the quit line
1299  AB3E              PAUSE_ATTR      equ 2<<3 | 7        ; paper 2 (opaque black), ink 7 (white)
1300  AB3E              VIEW_ATTR       equ %01000111       ; the viewport's own (ula_init): transparent
1301  AB3E              game_pause:
1302  AB3E 21 C9 AB             ld hl,txt_paused
1303  AB41 11 0C 07             ld de,PAUSE_ROW<<8 | PAUSE_COL
1304  AB44 0E 17                ld c,PAUSE_ATTR
1305  AB46 CD FC A0             call menu_print
1306  AB49 21 14 AC             ld hl,txt_pause_quit
1307  AB4C 11 07 0A             ld de,PAUSE_ROW3<<8 | PAUSE_COL2
1308  AB4F 0E 17                ld c,PAUSE_ATTR
1309  AB51 CD FC A0             call menu_print
1310  AB54 3A B1 AF             ld a,(vtol_dead)
1311  AB57 B7                   or a
1312  AB58 20 0B                jr nz,.w                        ; (a wreck: no saving)
1313  AB5A 21 DB AB             ld hl,txt_pause_save
1314  AB5D 11 07 09             ld de,PAUSE_ROW2<<8 | PAUSE_COL2
1315  AB60 0E 17                ld c,PAUSE_ATTR
1316  AB62 CD FC A0             call menu_print
1317  AB65 CD 46 A1     .w:     call menu_frame
1318  AB68 CD 00 E0             call kbd_scan
1319  AB6B 3A B1 AF             ld a,(vtol_dead)
1320  AB6E B7                   or a
1321  AB6F 20 08                jr nz,.np
1322  AB71 21 02 01             ld hl,KB_S                      ; save and quit
1323  AB74 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
1324  AB77 20 30                jr nz,.save
1325  AB79 21 04 00     .np:    ld hl,KB_X                      ; quit, no save
1326  AB7C CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
1327  AB7F 20 2D                jr nz,.quit
1328  AB81 3E 12                ld a,K_PAUSE
1329  AB83 CD CF E0             call key_pressed
1330  AB86 28 DD                jr z,.w
1331  AB88 21 D2 AB             ld hl,txt_unpaused              ; the box gone: the view again
1332  AB8B 11 0C 07             ld de,PAUSE_ROW<<8 | PAUSE_COL
1333  AB8E 0E 47                ld c,VIEW_ATTR
1334  AB90 CD FC A0             call menu_print
1335  AB93 21 01 AC             ld hl,txt_unpaused2
1336  AB96 11 07 0A             ld de,PAUSE_ROW3<<8 | PAUSE_COL2
1337  AB99 0E 47                ld c,VIEW_ATTR
1338  AB9B CD FC A0             call menu_print
1339  AB9E 21 01 AC             ld hl,txt_unpaused2
1340  ABA1 11 07 09             ld de,PAUSE_ROW2<<8 | PAUSE_COL2
1341  ABA4 0E 47                ld c,VIEW_ATTR
1342  ABA6 C3 FC A0             jp menu_print

1344  ABAC 38 0A                jr c,.fail
1345  ABAE ED 91 56 08  .quit:  nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_MENU     ; saved, or quit: the main menu
1346  ABB2 31 C5 B7             ld sp,stack_top
1347  ABB5 C3 00 C0             jp main_menu

1349  ABBC 21 EE AB             ld hl,txt_save_fail
1350  ABBF 11 07 09             ld de,PAUSE_ROW2<<8 | PAUSE_COL2

1366  AC27              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1367  AC27              ; Save games: ZPDATA/SAVEGAME.ZPS (beside the level files), one game.  Written
1368  AC27              ; by save and quit (game_pause: save_game), read by CONTINUE on the main menu
1369  AC27              ; (load_save, continue_game).  "ZPSV", SG_VERSION, then the fields in
1370  AC27              ; sg_fields, in order: the level and wave, the salvage, the VTOL's integrity
1371  AC27              ; (vtol_hp), its weapon slots (type and ammo each) and the selected one, the
1372  AC27              ; store (wpn_stock, wpn_unlocked), the booster (fitted, fuel), and the
1373  AC27              ; vision modes (vision_owned), and the vertical and lateral thrusters
1374  AC27              ; (vthrust_fitted, lthrust_fitted).  Files of an older version (1: before
1375  AC27              ; the vision modes, 2: before the vertical thrusters, 3: before the lateral
1376  AC27              ; ones, 4: before the linked chain guns, a longer store) are refused, as any
1377  AC27              ; other version.
1378  AC27              ; Continued, the level starts afresh at the saved wave: its zombies, the
1379  AC27              ; humans (and this level's rescues so far) and the base are new.
1380  AC27              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1381  AC27              SG_VERSION      equ 5
1382  AC27              sg_fields:      ; address, bytes
1383  AC27 AD AF                dw level
1384  AC29 01                   db 1
1385  AC2A B6 AF                dw wave_number
1386  AC2C 01                   db 1
1387  AC2D B8 AF                dw salvage_points
1388  AC2F 02                   db 2

1390  AC32 01                   db 1
1391  AC33 A0 AF                dw wpn_slots
1392  AC35 0A                   db WPN_SLOTS*2
1393  AC36 AA AF                dw wpn_sel
1394  AC38 01                   db 1
1395  AC39 21 B0                dw wpn_stock
1396  AC3B 0B                   db WPN_LAST+1
1397  AC3C 2C B0                dw wpn_unlocked
1398  AC3E 0B                   db WPN_LAST+1

1400  AC41 02                   db 2
1401  AC42 37 B0                dw vision_owned
1402  AC44 01                   db 1
1403  AC45 38 B0                dw vthrust_fitted
1404  AC47 01                   db 1
1405  AC48 39 B0                dw lthrust_fitted
1406  AC4A 01                   db 1
1407  AC4B 00 00                dw 0                            ; (the end)
1408  AC4D                      ASSERT boost_fuel == boost_fitted+1
1409  AC4D              SG_SIZE         equ 5+1+1+2+1+WPN_SLOTS*2+1+2*(WPN_LAST+1)+2+1+1+1

1772  AF4E              ;==============================================================================
1773  AF4E              ; Fixed point maths
1774  AF4E              ;==============================================================================
1775  AF4E
1776  AF4E              ; HL = -HL
1777  AF4E              neg_hl:
1778  AF4E AF                   xor a
1779  AF4F 95                   sub l
1780  AF50 6F                   ld l,a
1781  AF51 9F                   sbc a,a
1782  AF52 94                   sub h
1783  AF53 67                   ld h,a
1784  AF54 C9                   ret
1785  AF55
1786  AF55              ; HL = |HL|
1787  AF55              abs_hl:
1788  AF55 CB 7C                bit 7,h
1789  AF57 C8                   ret z
1790  AF58 18 F4                jr neg_hl
1791  AF5A
1792  AF5A              ; fmul: HL = HL * DE >> 8
1793  AF5A              ;   HL = signed 16-bit integer, DE = S7.8 factor in -1.0..+1.0
1794  AF5A              ;   Sign/magnitude using two 8x8 MUL D,E.  Preserves IX, IY.
1795  AF5A              fmul:
1796  AF5A 7C                   ld a,h
1797  AF5B AA                   xor d

 180+ E883 ~                    sbc hl,de                       ; (carry clear)

 187+ E883 ~                    q                               ; (all the jumps land here)

 204+ E90B              ; E = A / C, A = A mod C  (8-bit unsigned, C 1..127).  By reciprocal:
 205+ E90B              ; q = (A * R) >> 16, R = rcp8[C] = ceil(65536 / C), exact for every A
 206+ E90B              ; (gentables.py checks it); then the remainder A - q C.  Keeps C, D, H, L

 248+ E937              ;==============================================================================
 249+ E937              ; Perspective projection
 250+ E937              ;   in : HL -> X,Y,Z (camera space, inside the view frustum, Z > 0)
 251+ E937              ;   out: A = screen x (0..255), C = screen y (0..VIEW_H-1)
 252+ E937              ;   sx = 128 + 128*X/Z,  sy = 64 - 128*Y/Z   (90 x 53 degree field of view)
 253+ E937              ;   Z is normalised to 9 bits (256..511) with a barrel shift (count from a
 254+ E937              ;   log2 table) that is also applied to X and Y, which are then multiplied
 255+ E937              ;   by a 16-bit reciprocal from rtab.  |X| <= Z keeps Xn within 9 bits.
