   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - input: keyboard and joysticks (8K page PAGE_INPUT, runs at
   3+ E000              ; $E000 in slot 7: main_loop and the menu page it in, and the game logic
   4+ E000              ; pages in slot 6 call it)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; Redefinable controls.  An input (a key, or a joystick direction or button)
   7+ E000              ; is a 16-bit code: high byte = input bank, low byte = bit mask within it.
   8+ E000              ;   banks 0-7: the ZX Spectrum keyboard half-rows (port $xxFE, address line
   9+ E000              ;              A8+bank low): read 0 = pressed
  10+ E000              ;   bank 8:    NextReg $B0, Extended Keys 0: read 1 = pressed
  11+ E000              ;   bank 9:    NextReg $B1, Extended Keys 1: read 1 = pressed
  12+ E000              ;   bank 10:   port $1F, Kempston 1 / Mega Drive 1 (J1_*): read 1 = pressed
  13+ E000              ;   bank 11:   port $37, Kempston 2 / Mega Drive 2 (J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  14+ E000              ;   bank 12:   NextReg $B2, the 6-button Mega Drive pads' X, Y, Z and MODE
  15+ E000              ;              (left connector J1_*, right J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  16+ E000              ; A joystick bank is read only while a joystick is set (NextReg $05, the
  17+ E000              ; Next's joystick modes) to the port it reads, else it is 0: so an unused
  18+ E000              ; port can't read as everything pressed.  Joysticks in Sinclair or Cursor
  19+ E000              ; mode enter keys (6-0, 1-5, 5-8) and are read as keys.
  20+ E000              ; kbd_scan, once per frame at the top of the main loop, reads all the banks
  21+ E000              ; into key_now, inverting the ZX rows so that every bank holds 1 = pressed,
  22+ E000              ; and keeps the previous scan in key_prev.  The game asks about actions
  23+ E000              ; (K_FIRE, K_LEFT, ...), not inputs: each action has a key (key_defs) and a
  24+ E000              ; joystick input (joy_defs; 0 = none), either of which works, so both can
  25+ E000              ; be redefined (key_define) at any time.
  26+ E000              ;   key_held    A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input is down
  27+ E000              ;   key_pressed A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input went down
  28+ E000              ;               since the last scan
  29+ E000              ;   key_find    -> NZ and HL = code of an input that is down (for a
  30+ E000              ;               redefine screen); Z if none
  31+ E000              ;   key_code_pressed  HL = key code -> NZ if that key went down
  32+ E000              ; The Next normally also enters the extended keys into the 8x5 matrix (e.g.
  33+ E000              ; cursor LEFT as CAPS SHIFT + 5).  NextReg $68 bit 4 stops that: set it with
  34+ E000              ; kbd_double_on (KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = TRUE), clear it with kbd_double_off
  35+ E000              ; (FALSE, the default).
  36+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  37+ E000
  38+ E000              ; --- key codes: bank << 8 | mask ---------------------------------------------
  39+ E000              KB_SHIFT    equ $0001                   ; bank 0: $FEFE
  40+ E000              KB_Z        equ $0002
  41+ E000              KB_X        equ $0004
  42+ E000              KB_C        equ $0008
  43+ E000              KB_V        equ $0010
  44+ E000              KB_A        equ $0101                   ; bank 1: $FDFE
  45+ E000              KB_S        equ $0102
  46+ E000              KB_D        equ $0104
  47+ E000              KB_F        equ $0108
  48+ E000              KB_G        equ $0110
  49+ E000              KB_Q        equ $0201                   ; bank 2: $FBFE
  50+ E000              KB_W        equ $0202
  51+ E000              KB_E        equ $0204
  52+ E000              KB_R        equ $0208
  53+ E000              KB_T        equ $0210
  54+ E000              KB_1        equ $0301                   ; bank 3: $F7FE
  55+ E000              KB_2        equ $0302
  56+ E000              KB_3        equ $0304
  57+ E000              KB_4        equ $0308
  58+ E000              KB_5        equ $0310
  59+ E000              KB_0        equ $0401                   ; bank 4: $EFFE
  60+ E000              KB_9        equ $0402
  61+ E000              KB_8        equ $0404
  62+ E000              KB_7        equ $0408
  63+ E000              KB_6        equ $0410
  64+ E000              KB_P        equ $0501                   ; bank 5: $DFFE
  65+ E000              KB_O        equ $0502
  66+ E000              KB_I        equ $0504
  67+ E000              KB_U        equ $0508
  68+ E000              KB_Y        equ $0510
  69+ E000              KB_ENTER    equ $0601                   ; bank 6: $BFFE
  70+ E000              KB_L        equ $0602
  71+ E000              KB_K        equ $0604
  72+ E000              KB_J        equ $0608
  73+ E000              KB_H        equ $0610
  74+ E000              KB_SPACE    equ $0701                   ; bank 7: $7FFE
  75+ E000              KB_SYM      equ $0702
  76+ E000              KB_M        equ $0704
  77+ E000              KB_N        equ $0708
  78+ E000              KB_B        equ $0710
  79+ E000              KB_RIGHT    equ $0801                   ; bank 8: NextReg $B0
  80+ E000              KB_LEFT     equ $0802
  81+ E000              KB_DOWN     equ $0804
  82+ E000              KB_UP       equ $0808
  83+ E000              KB_PERIOD   equ $0810
  84+ E000              KB_COMMA    equ $0820
  85+ E000              KB_QUOTE    equ $0840
  86+ E000              KB_SEMI     equ $0880
  87+ E000              KB_EXTEND   equ $0901                   ; bank 9: NextReg $B1
  88+ E000              KB_CAPSLOCK equ $0902
  89+ E000              KB_GRAPH    equ $0904
  90+ E000              KB_TRUEVID  equ $0908
  91+ E000              KB_INVVID   equ $0910
  92+ E000              KB_BREAK    equ $0920
  93+ E000              KB_EDIT     equ $0940
  94+ E000              KB_DELETE   equ $0980
  95+ E000              JOY_BANK    equ 10                      ; the first joystick bank
  96+ E000              J1_RIGHT    equ $0A01                   ; bank 10: port $1F (Kempston 1 /
  97+ E000              J1_LEFT     equ $0A02                   ;   Mega Drive 1)
  98+ E000              J1_DOWN     equ $0A04
  99+ E000              J1_UP       equ $0A08
 100+ E000              J1_FIRE     equ $0A10                   ; (Mega Drive: B)
 101+ E000              J1_C        equ $0A20                   ; Mega Drive C, A, START
 102+ E000              J1_A        equ $0A40
 103+ E000              J1_START    equ $0A80
 104+ E000              J2_RIGHT    equ $0B01                   ; bank 11: port $37 (Kempston 2 /
 105+ E000              J2_LEFT     equ $0B02                   ;   Mega Drive 2)
 106+ E000              J2_DOWN     equ $0B04
 107+ E000              J2_UP       equ $0B08
 108+ E000              J2_FIRE     equ $0B10
 109+ E000              J2_C        equ $0B20
 110+ E000              J2_A        equ $0B40
 111+ E000              J2_START    equ $0B80
 112+ E000              J1_MODE     equ $0C01                   ; bank 12: NextReg $B2, 6-button
 113+ E000              J1_Y        equ $0C02                   ;   pads (left connector)
 114+ E000              J1_Z        equ $0C04
 115+ E000              J1_X        equ $0C08
 116+ E000              J2_MODE     equ $0C10                   ;   (right connector)
 117+ E000              J2_Y        equ $0C20
 118+ E000              J2_Z        equ $0C40
 119+ E000              J2_X        equ $0C80
 120+ E000              KEY_BANKS   equ 13
 121+ E000              JP_1F_B     equ 0                       ; joystick ports in use (joy_ports):
 122+ E000              JP_37_B     equ 1                       ;   $1F, $37, the 6-button extras
 123+ E000              JP_MD_B     equ 2
 124+ E000              FALSE       equ 0
 125+ E000              TRUE        equ 1
 126+ E000
 127+ E000              ; --- actions: index into key_defs --------------------------------------------
 128+ E000              K_SPEED_UP  equ 0
 129+ E000              K_SPEED_DN  equ 1
 130+ E000              K_AIRBRAKE  equ 2                       ; air brake: rapid stop
 131+ E000              K_LEFT      equ 3
 132+ E000              K_RIGHT     equ 4
 133+ E000              K_CLIMB     equ 5
 134+ E000              K_DESCEND   equ 6
 135+ E000              K_NOSE_UP   equ 7
 136+ E000              K_NOSE_DN   equ 8
 137+ E000              K_FIRE      equ 9
 138+ E000              K_GUN_UP    equ 10                      ; tilt the centre gun up,
 139+ E000              K_SLOT1     equ 11                      ; select weapon slots 1-5
 140+ E000              K_GUN_DN    equ 16                      ; down,
 141+ E000              K_GUN_CTR   equ 17                      ; and back to the centre
 142+ E000              K_PAUSE     equ 18                      ; pause / resume (main_loop)
 143+ E000              K_BOOST     equ 19                      ; the booster on / off (player.asm)
 144+ E000              K_VISION    equ 20                      ; the next vision mode (vis_cycle)
 145+ E000              K_STRAFE_L  equ 21                      ; a lateral thrusters pulse left,
 146+ E000              K_STRAFE_R  equ 22                      ;   right (player.asm strafe)
 147+ E000              K_ACTIONS   equ 23
 148+ E000
 149+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 150+ E000              ; Read all the input banks: key_prev = last scan, key_now = this one, every
 151+ E000              ; bit 1 = pressed
 152+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 153+ E000              kbd_scan:
 154+ E000 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 155+ E003 11 63 E1             ld de,key_prev
 156+ E006 01 0D 00             ld bc,KEY_BANKS
 157+ E009 ED B0                ldir
 158+ E00B 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 159+ E00E 01 FE FE             ld bc,$FEFE                     ; banks 0-7: half-rows $FE..$7F
 160+ E011 ED 78        .row:   in a,(c)
 161+ E013 2F                   cpl                             ; 0 = pressed -> 1 = pressed
 162+ E014 E6 1F                and %00011111
 163+ E016 77                   ld (hl),a
 164+ E017 23                   inc hl
 165+ E018 CB 00                rlc b                           ; next half-row
 166+ E01A 38 F5                jr c,.row                       ; (stops after $7F)
 167+ E01C 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B                     ; banks 8, 9: NextRegs $B0, $B1
 168+ E01F 3E B0                ld a,$B0
 169+ E021 ED 79                out (c),a
 170+ E023 04                   inc b
 171+ E024 ED 78                in a,(c)                        ; already 1 = pressed
 172+ E026 77                   ld (hl),a
 173+ E027 23                   inc hl
 174+ E028 05                   dec b
 175+ E029 3E B1                ld a,$B1
 176+ E02B ED 79                out (c),a
 177+ E02D 04                   inc b
 178+ E02E ED 78                in a,(c)
 179+ E030 77                   ld (hl),a
 180+ E031 23                   inc hl
 181+ E032                      ; banks 10-12, the joysticks: only the ports a joystick is set to
 182+ E032                      ; (NextReg $05), so an unused port can't read as all pressed
 183+ E032 05                   dec b                           ; (BC = $243B)
 184+ E033 3E 05                ld a,$05
 185+ E035 ED 79                out (c),a
 186+ E037 04                   inc b
 187+ E038 ED 58                in e,(c)                        ; the joystick modes
 188+ E03A 7B                   ld a,e                          ; joystick 1: bits 7-6, and bit 3
 189+ E03B 07                   rlca
 190+ E03C 07                   rlca
 191+ E03D E6 03                and 3
 192+ E03F CB 5B                bit 3,e
 193+ E041 28 02                jr z,.j1
 194+ E043 F6 04                or 4
 195+ E045 CD 84 E0     .j1:    call joy_ports
 196+ E048 57                   ld d,a                          ; D: the ports in use (JP_*)
 197+ E049 7B                   ld a,e                          ; joystick 2: bits 5-4, and bit 1
 198+ E04A 0F                   rrca
 199+ E04B 0F                   rrca
 200+ E04C 0F                   rrca
 201+ E04D 0F                   rrca
 202+ E04E E6 03                and 3
 203+ E050 CB 4B                bit 1,e
 204+ E052 28 02                jr z,.j2
 205+ E054 F6 04                or 4
 206+ E056 CD 84 E0     .j2:    call joy_ports
 207+ E059 B2                   or d
 208+ E05A 57                   ld d,a
 209+ E05B AF                   xor a                           ; bank 10: port $1F
 210+ E05C CB 42                bit JP_1F_B,d
 211+ E05E 28 05                jr z,.p1
 212+ E060 DB 1F                in a,($1F)
 213+ E062 CD 95 E0             call joy_sane
 214+ E065 77           .p1:    ld (hl),a
 215+ E066 23                   inc hl
 216+ E067 AF                   xor a                           ; bank 11: port $37
 217+ E068 CB 4A                bit JP_37_B,d
 218+ E06A 28 05                jr z,.p2
 219+ E06C DB 37                in a,($37)
 220+ E06E CD 95 E0             call joy_sane
 221+ E071 77           .p2:    ld (hl),a
 222+ E072 23                   inc hl
 223+ E073 AF                   xor a                           ; bank 12: NextReg $B2, the 6-button
 224+ E074 CB 52                bit JP_MD_B,d                   ; pads' extra buttons
 225+ E076 28 0A                jr z,.p3
 226+ E078 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 227+ E07B 3E B2                ld a,$B2
 228+ E07D ED 79                out (c),a
 229+ E07F 04                   inc b
 230+ E080 ED 78                in a,(c)
 231+ E082 77           .p3:    ld (hl),a
 232+ E083 C9                   ret
 233+ E084                      ASSERT KEY_BANKS == 13 && JOY_BANK == 10
 234+ E084
 235+ E084              ; A = a joystick mode (NextReg $05: 0 Sinclair 2, 1 Kempston 1, 2 Cursor,
 236+ E084              ; 3 Sinclair 1, 4 Kempston 2, 5 Mega Drive 1, 6 Mega Drive 2, 7 I/O) -> A =
 237+ E084              ; the ports it is read through (JP_* bits).  Keeps DE, HL.
 238+ E084              joy_ports:
 239+ E084 E5                   push hl
 240+ E085 21 8D E0             ld hl,joy_mode_ports
 241+ E088 ED 31                add hl,a
 242+ E08A 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 243+ E08B E1                   pop hl
 244+ E08C C9                   ret
 245+ E08D
 246+ E08D              joy_mode_ports:
 247+ E08D 00 01 00 00          db 0, 1<<JP_1F_B, 0, 0, 1<<JP_37_B
 247+ E091 02
 248+ E092 05 06 00             db 1<<JP_1F_B | 1<<JP_MD_B, 1<<JP_37_B | 1<<JP_MD_B, 0
 249+ E095
 250+ E095              ; A = a Kempston / Mega Drive port read -> A, or 0 if it reads left and
 251+ E095              ; right at once (no stick can: nothing there).  Uses C.
 252+ E095              joy_sane:
 253+ E095 4F                   ld c,a
 254+ E096 E6 03                and %00000011
 255+ E098 FE 03                cp %00000011
 256+ E09A 79                   ld a,c
 257+ E09B C0                   ret nz
 258+ E09C AF                   xor a
 259+ E09D C9                   ret
 260+ E09E
 261+ E09E              ; Stop the extended keys also appearing in the 8x5 matrix:
 262+ E09E              ; KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = TRUE, NextReg $68 bit 4 = 1
 263+ E09E              kbd_double_on:
 264+ E09E 3E 01                ld a,TRUE
 265+ E0A0 18 01                jr kbd_double
 266+ E0A2
 267+ E0A2              ; Let the extended keys also appear in the 8x5 matrix (the default):
 268+ E0A2              ; KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = FALSE, NextReg $68 bit 4 = 0
 269+ E0A2              kbd_double_off:
 270+ E0A2              kdb_double_off:                         ; (alias: the name as first asked for)
 271+ E0A2 AF                   xor a                           ; FALSE
 272+ E0A3
 273+ E0A3              ; A = TRUE / FALSE: store it, and set NextReg $68 bit 4 to match, keeping
 274+ E0A3              ; the register's other bits
 275+ E0A3              kbd_double:
 276+ E0A3 32 55 E1             ld (KBD_STOP_DOUBLING),a
 277+ E0A6 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 278+ E0A9 3E 68                ld a,$68
 279+ E0AB ED 79                out (c),a
 280+ E0AD 04                   inc b
 281+ E0AE ED 78                in a,(c)                        ; current NextReg $68
 282+ E0B0 CB A7                res 4,a
 283+ E0B2 21 55 E1             ld hl,KBD_STOP_DOUBLING
 284+ E0B5 CB 46                bit 0,(hl)
 285+ E0B7 28 02                jr z,.w
 286+ E0B9 CB E7                set 4,a
 287+ E0BB ED 79        .w:     out (c),a                       ; ($253B: still selects $68)
 288+ E0BD C9                   ret
 289+ E0BE
 290+ E0BE              ; A = action -> NZ if its key or its joystick input is down.  Preserves BC,
 291+ E0BE              ; DE, HL.
 292+ E0BE              key_held:
 293+ E0BE E5                   push hl
 294+ E0BF C5                   push bc
 295+ E0C0 4F                   ld c,a
 296+ E0C1 CD 09 E1             call key_def
 297+ E0C4 A6                   and (hl)
 298+ E0C5 20 05                jr nz,.x
 299+ E0C7 79                   ld a,c
 300+ E0C8 CD 1A E1             call joy_def
 301+ E0CB A6                   and (hl)
 302+ E0CC C1           .x:     pop bc
 303+ E0CD E1                   pop hl
 304+ E0CE C9                   ret
 305+ E0CF
 306+ E0CF              ; A = action -> NZ if its key or its joystick input is down now but wasn't
 307+ E0CF              ; at the last scan.  Preserves BC, DE, HL.
 308+ E0CF              key_pressed:
 309+ E0CF E5                   push hl
 310+ E0D0 C5                   push bc
 311+ E0D1 47                   ld b,a
 312+ E0D2 CD 09 E1             call key_def
 313+ E0D5 CD E4 E0             call def_new
 314+ E0D8 20 07                jr nz,.x
 315+ E0DA 78                   ld a,b
 316+ E0DB CD 1A E1             call joy_def
 317+ E0DE CD E4 E0             call def_new
 318+ E0E1 C1           .x:     pop bc
 319+ E0E2 E1                   pop hl
 320+ E0E3 C9                   ret
 321+ E0E4
 322+ E0E4              ; HL -> key_now[bank], A = mask -> NZ if down now but not at the last scan
 323+ E0E4              ; (a mask of 0, no input: never).  Uses C.
 324+ E0E4              def_new:
 325+ E0E4 4F                   ld c,a
 326+ E0E5 A6                   and (hl)
 327+ E0E6 C8                   ret z                           ; not down
 328+ E0E7 79                   ld a,c
 329+ E0E8 D5                   push de
 330+ E0E9 11 0D 00             ld de,KEY_BANKS
 331+ E0EC 19                   add hl,de                       ; key_prev, same bank
 332+ E0ED A6                   and (hl)
 333+ E0EE D1                   pop de
 334+ E0EF A9                   xor c                           ; down before: Z; new: NZ
 335+ E0F0 C9                   ret
 336+ E0F1
 337+ E0F1              ; HL = a key code (KB_...) -> NZ if that key went down since the last scan
 338+ E0F1              ; (for fixed keys, such as the menu's).  Preserves BC, DE, HL.
 339+ E0F1              key_code_pressed:
 340+ E0F1 E5                   push hl
 341+ E0F2 C5                   push bc
 342+ E0F3 4D                   ld c,l                          ; mask
 343+ E0F4 7C                   ld a,h                          ; bank
 344+ E0F5 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 345+ E0F8 ED 31                add hl,a
 346+ E0FA 79                   ld a,c
 347+ E0FB A6                   and (hl)
 348+ E0FC 28 08                jr z,.x                         ; not down
 349+ E0FE D5                   push de
 350+ E0FF 11 0D 00             ld de,KEY_BANKS
 351+ E102 19                   add hl,de                       ; key_prev, same bank
 352+ E103 A6                   and (hl)
 353+ E104 D1                   pop de
 354+ E105 A9                   xor c                           ; down before: Z; new: NZ
 355+ E106 C1           .x:     pop bc
 356+ E107 E1                   pop hl
 357+ E108 C9                   ret
 358+ E109
 359+ E109              ; A = action -> HL -> key_now[its key's bank], A = its key's mask
 360+ E109              key_def:
 361+ E109 21 70 E1             ld hl,key_defs
 362+ E10C                      ; fall through
 363+ E10C
 364+ E10C              ; HL = key_defs or joy_defs, A = action -> HL -> key_now[the bank], A = mask
 365+ E10C              def_at:
 366+ E10C 87                   add a,a
 367+ E10D ED 31                add hl,a
 368+ E10F 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; mask
 369+ E110 23                   inc hl
 370+ E111 F5                   push af
 371+ E112 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; bank
 372+ E113 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 373+ E116 ED 31                add hl,a
 374+ E118 F1                   pop af
 375+ E119 C9                   ret
 376+ E11A
 377+ E11A              ; A = action -> HL -> key_now[its joystick input's bank], A = its mask (0:
 378+ E11A              ; none)
 379+ E11A              joy_def:
 380+ E11A 21 9E E1             ld hl,joy_defs
 381+ E11D 18 ED                jr def_at
 382+ E11F
 383+ E11F              ; A = action, HL = an input's code: redefine the action's key, or its
 384+ E11F              ; joystick input if the code is a joystick's (bank JOY_BANK on).  Uses B.
 385+ E11F              key_define:
 386+ E11F EB                   ex de,hl
 387+ E120 87                   add a,a
 388+ E121 21 70 E1             ld hl,key_defs
 389+ E124 47                   ld b,a
 390+ E125 7A                   ld a,d
 391+ E126 FE 0A                cp JOY_BANK
 392+ E128 78                   ld a,b
 393+ E129 38 03                jr c,.k
 394+ E12B 21 9E E1             ld hl,joy_defs
 395+ E12E ED 31        .k:     add hl,a
 396+ E130 73                   ld (hl),e
 397+ E131 23                   inc hl
 398+ E132 72                   ld (hl),d
 399+ E133 EB                   ex de,hl
 400+ E134 C9                   ret
 401+ E135
 402+ E135              ; -> NZ and HL = code of an input that is down (lowest bank, lowest bit); Z
 403+ E135              ; if none.  For a redefine screen.
 404+ E135              key_find:
 405+ E135 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 406+ E138 0E 00                ld c,0                          ; bank
 407+ E13A 7E           .b:     ld a,(hl)
 408+ E13B B7                   or a
 409+ E13C 20 09                jr nz,.got
 410+ E13E 23                   inc hl
 411+ E13F 0C                   inc c
 412+ E140 79                   ld a,c
 413+ E141 FE 0D                cp KEY_BANKS
 414+ E143 20 F5                jr nz,.b
 415+ E145 AF                   xor a                           ; Z: nothing down
 416+ E146 C9                   ret
 417+ E147 06 01        .got:   ld b,1                          ; lowest bit set
 418+ E149 1F           .m:     rra
 419+ E14A 38 04                jr c,.f
 420+ E14C CB 20                sla b
 421+ E14E 18 F9                jr .m
 422+ E150 61           .f:     ld h,c
 423+ E151 68                   ld l,b
 424+ E152 F6 01                or 1                            ; NZ
 425+ E154 C9                   ret
 426+ E155
 427+ E155              ;==============================================================================
 428+ E155              ; Input data
 429+ E155              ;==============================================================================
 430+ E155              KBD_STOP_DOUBLING:
 431+ E155 00                       db FALSE                    ; TRUE: NextReg $68 bit 4 set, extended
 432+ E156                                                      ; keys kept out of the 8x5 matrix
 433+ E156 00 00 00...  key_now:    ds KEY_BANKS                ; this scan, 1 = pressed
 434+ E163 00 00 00...  key_prev:   ds KEY_BANKS                ; the scan before (must follow key_now)
 435+ E170              ; The key and the joystick input of each action, by K_*: the defaults
 436+ E170              ; (key_defaults, joy_defaults), and the ones in use (key_defs, joy_defs:
 437+ E170              ; redefinable on the redefine keys screen, keydef.asm, which can put the
 438+ E170              ; defaults back).  Each set in that order: key_defs, joy_defs, key_defaults,
 439+ E170              ; joy_defaults, one after another (keydef.asm copies all four as one).
 440+ E170                  MACRO KEY_DEFAULTS
 441+ E170 ~                        dw KB_Q                     ; K_SPEED_UP
 442+ E170 ~                        dw KB_A                     ; K_SPEED_DN
 443+ E170 ~                        dw KB_Z                     ; K_AIRBRAKE
 444+ E170 ~                        dw KB_O                     ; K_LEFT
 445+ E170 ~                        dw KB_P                     ; K_RIGHT
 446+ E170 ~                        dw KB_W                     ; K_CLIMB
 447+ E170 ~                        dw KB_S                     ; K_DESCEND
 448+ E170 ~                        dw KB_E                     ; K_NOSE_UP
 449+ E170 ~                        dw KB_D                     ; K_NOSE_DN
 450+ E170 ~                        dw KB_SPACE                 ; K_FIRE
 451+ E170 ~                        dw KB_R                     ; K_GUN_UP
 452+ E170 ~                        dw KB_1, KB_2, KB_3, KB_4, KB_5     ; K_SLOT1..5
 453+ E170 ~                        dw KB_F                     ; K_GUN_DN
 454+ E170 ~                        dw KB_V                     ; K_GUN_CTR
 455+ E170 ~                        dw KB_BREAK                 ; K_PAUSE
 456+ E170 ~                        dw KB_X                     ; K_BOOST
 457+ E170 ~                        dw KB_N                     ; K_VISION
 458+ E170 ~                        dw KB_K, KB_L               ; K_STRAFE_L, K_STRAFE_R
 459+ E170                  ENDM
 460+ E170              ; The joystick defaults: the stick flies (left / right turn, up / down climb
 461+ E170              ; and descend), FIRE (Mega Drive B) fires; a Mega Drive pad's C / A are
 462+ E170              ; speed up / down, START pauses, and a 6-button pad's X is the air brake,
 463+ E170              ; Y / Z nose up / down, MODE the boost.  0: none.
 464+ E170                  MACRO JOY_DEFAULTS
 465+ E170 ~                        dw J1_C                     ; K_SPEED_UP
 466+ E170 ~                        dw J1_A                     ; K_SPEED_DN
 467+ E170 ~                        dw J1_X                     ; K_AIRBRAKE
 468+ E170 ~                        dw J1_LEFT                  ; K_LEFT
 469+ E170 ~                        dw J1_RIGHT                 ; K_RIGHT
 470+ E170 ~                        dw J1_UP                    ; K_CLIMB
 471+ E170 ~                        dw J1_DOWN                  ; K_DESCEND
 472+ E170 ~                        dw J1_Y                     ; K_NOSE_UP
 473+ E170 ~                        dw J1_Z                     ; K_NOSE_DN
 474+ E170 ~                        dw J1_FIRE                  ; K_FIRE
 475+ E170 ~                        dw 0                        ; K_GUN_UP
 476+ E170 ~                        dw 0, 0, 0, 0, 0            ; K_SLOT1..5
 477+ E170 ~                        dw 0                        ; K_GUN_DN
 478+ E170 ~                        dw 0                        ; K_GUN_CTR
 479+ E170 ~                        dw J1_START                 ; K_PAUSE
 480+ E170 ~                        dw J1_MODE                  ; K_BOOST (a 6-button pad's MODE)
 481+ E170 ~                        dw 0                        ; K_VISION
 482+ E170 ~                        dw 0, 0                     ; K_STRAFE_L, K_STRAFE_R
 483+ E170                  ENDM
 484+ E170              key_defs:   KEY_DEFAULTS
 484+ E170 01 02       >            dw KB_Q                     ; K_SPEED_UP
 484+ E172 01 01       >            dw KB_A                     ; K_SPEED_DN

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - hardware sprites, Layer 3 (8K page PAGE_SPRITES, runs at $E000
   3+ E000              ; in slot 7: page it in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPRITES before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; The Next has 128 hardware sprites, each 16x16 pixels from a pattern in the
   6+ E000              ; sprite pattern memory (16K, separate from the Z80's: 64 8-bit patterns of
   7+ E000              ; 256 bytes, one byte per pixel, row by row).  A pattern byte is an index
   8+ E000              ; into the sprite palette; SPR_TRANS ($E3, NextReg $4B) is transparent.  The
   9+ E000              ; sprite palette starts as the identity, so until spr_palette changes it a
  10+ E000              ; pattern byte is simply its RRRGGGBB colour.
  11+ E000              ;
  12+ E000              ; Sprites are drawn above Layer 2 and the ULA (priority S U L) and, with
  13+ E000              ; NextReg $15 bit 1 set, over the border as well, so the sprite screen is
  14+ E000              ; 320 x 256 pixels:
  15+ E000              ;
  16+ E000              ;     x 0..319, y 0..255;  (SPR_SCREEN_X, SPR_SCREEN_Y) = (32, 32) is the top
  17+ E000              ;     left of the 256x192 Layer 2 / ULA screen, (288, 224) its bottom right
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; A sprite's position is its top left pixel.  Coordinates are 9 bits and
  20+ E000              ; wrap round at 512, so they may be negative (two's complement): a sprite at
  21+ E000              ; x = -8 shows its right half at the left edge.  With overlapping sprites,
  22+ E000              ; the higher numbered one is drawn on top.
  23+ E000              ;
  24+ E000              ; Use: sprites_init once (start-up), load patterns with spr_patterns or
  25+ E000              ; from a sprite bank (sprite_data.asm: page the bank into slot 7 and call
  26+ E000              ; its spr_load_bank, from outside slot 7), and a palette with spr_palette
  27+ E000              ; if wanted, then set up sprites in the shadow
  28+ E000              ; table with spr_set / spr_pos / spr_pattern / spr_flags / spr_scale /
  29+ E000              ; spr_hide / spr_show / spr_hide_all, and copy the table to the hardware
  30+ E000              ; once a frame with spr_update.  The table holds the first SPR_COUNT sprites;
  31+ E000              ; the rest stay hidden.
  32+ E000              ;
  33+ E000              ; Attributes, SPR_ATTR (5) bytes a sprite, kept in the table as they are
  34+ E000              ; sent (the 5-byte form):
  35+ E000              ;   +0  x bits 0-7
  36+ E000              ;   +1  y bits 0-7
  37+ E000              ;   +2  bits 7-4 palette offset (added to the pattern byte's top nibble),
  38+ E000              ;       bit 3 x mirror, 2 y mirror, 1 rotate 90 degrees clockwise, 0 x bit 8
  39+ E000              ;   +3  bit 7 visible, bit 6 = 1 (byte +4 follows), bits 5-0 pattern
  40+ E000              ;   +4  bits 4-3 x scale, bits 2-1 y scale (0..3 = x1, x2, x4, x8), 0 y bit 8
  41+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  42+ E000
  43+ E000              SPR_COUNT       equ 44          ; sprites in the shadow table (max 128)
  44+ E000              SPR_HW          equ 128         ; hardware sprites
  45+ E000              SPR_ATTR        equ 5           ; attribute bytes per sprite
  46+ E000              SPR_PATTERNS    equ 64          ; 8-bit 16x16 patterns in pattern memory
  47+ E000              SPR_SIZE        equ 16          ; pixels, each way (at scale x1)
  48+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_X    equ 32          ; sprite coordinates of the 256x192
  49+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_Y    equ 32          ; screen's top left pixel
  50+ E000              SPR_TRANS       equ $E3         ; transparent pattern byte (NextReg $4B)
  51+ E000
  52+ E000              SPRF_PAL        equ $10         ; flags (attribute +2): palette offset x 16,
  53+ E000              SPRF_XMIRROR    equ $08         ; mirror left-right,
  54+ E000              SPRF_YMIRROR    equ $04         ; mirror top-bottom,
  55+ E000              SPRF_ROT        equ $02         ; rotate 90 degrees clockwise
  56+ E000
  57+ E000              SPR_SLOT_PORT   equ $303B       ; write: select sprite / pattern slot
  58+ E000              SPR_ATTR_PORT   equ $57         ; write: attributes, from the selected sprite
  59+ E000              SPR_PAT_PORT    equ $5B         ; write: pattern bytes, from the selected slot
  60+ E000
  61+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  62+ E000              ; Start-up: sprites on, shown over the border too (the full 320 x 256),
  63+ E000              ; priority S U L; the transparent index; every hardware sprite hidden and the shadow table cleared (all hidden,
  64+ E000              ; pattern 0, at 0,0).
  65+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  66+ E000              sprites_init:
  67+ E000 ED 91 15 0B          nextreg $15,%00001011           ; priority S U L, sprites over the
  68+ E004                                                      ; border (bit 1), visible (bit 0)
  69+ E004 ED 91 4B E3          nextreg $4B,SPR_TRANS
  70+ E008 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT             ; from sprite 0, the 4-byte form
  71+ E00B AF                   xor a                           ; (+3 bit 6 clear): all hidden
  72+ E00C ED 79                out (c),a
  73+ E00E 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
  74+ E010 11 00 02             ld de,SPR_HW*4
  75+ E013 ED 79        .hw:    out (c),a
  76+ E015 1B                   dec de
  77+ E016 7A                   ld a,d
  78+ E017 B3                   or e
  79+ E018 3E 00                ld a,0
  80+ E01A 20 F7                jr nz,.hw
  81+ E01C 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
  82+ E01F 06 2C                ld b,SPR_COUNT
  83+ E021 77           .sh:    ld (hl),a                       ; x, y, flags 0
  84+ E022 23                   inc hl
  85+ E023 77                   ld (hl),a
  86+ E024 23                   inc hl
  87+ E025 77                   ld (hl),a
  88+ E026 23                   inc hl
  89+ E027 36 40                ld (hl),$40                     ; hidden, 5-byte form, pattern 0
  90+ E029 23                   inc hl
  91+ E02A 77                   ld (hl),a                       ; scale x1
  92+ E02B 23                   inc hl
  93+ E02C 10 F3                djnz .sh
  94+ E02E                      ; fall through: send it
  95+ E02E
  96+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  97+ E02E              ; Copy the shadow table to sprites 0..SPR_COUNT-1.  Once a frame, after the
  98+ E02E              ; changes (best just after the frame flip, so a move doesn't show half done).
  99+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 100+ E02E              spr_update:
 101+ E02E 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
 102+ E031 AF                   xor a
 103+ E032 ED 79                out (c),a                       ; from sprite 0
 104+ E034 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
 105+ E037 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT

 108+ E03D ED B3                otir

   1+ E2DC              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E2DC              ; Z-POLICE - HUD sprites (in the sprites page, PAGE_SPRITES, at $E000 in slot
   3+ E2DC              ; 7): the human status column and the compass bar, as hardware sprites on
   4+ E2DC              ; the 320 x 256 sprite screen.  hud_sprites sets both and sends the sprite
   5+ E2DC              ; table to the hardware; main_loop calls it once a frame, after the flip.
   6+ E2DC              ;
   7+ E2DC              ; Sprites used: 0..HUMAN_MAX-1 the humans, CSPR_SPR0.. the compass bar's
   8+ E2DC              ; marks, CSPR_PTR_SPR its pointer, FRM_SPR0.. the viewport's frame.
   9+ E2DC              ;==============================================================================

  19+ E2EC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  20+ E2EC              ; The viewport's frame: curved corners and edges in hardware sprites, over
  21+ E2EC              ; Layer 2 and the border, so nothing is drawn into the view.  Set once after
  22+ E2EC              ; the sprites are hidden (frm_on; spr_hide_all clears it).  frame_tab: x, y,
  23+ E2EC              ; pattern and flags, then scale across and down: the edges are 1-row patterns
  24+ E2EC              ; stretched, FRM_H across (two at x8 overlapping, 224 pixels) and FRM_V down
  25+ E2EC              ; (two at x4 overlapping, 96).  The panel's bottom corners are rounded too.
  26+ E2EC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  27+ E2EC              FRM_SPR0        equ CSPR_PTR_SPR+1  ; the frame's sprites (12)
  28+ E2EC              FRM_L           equ SPR_SCREEN_X
  29+ E2EC              FRM_R           equ SPR_SCREEN_X+256-SPR_SIZE
  30+ E2EC              FRM_T           equ SPR_SCREEN_Y
  31+ E2EC              FRM_B           equ SPR_SCREEN_Y+VIEW_H-SPR_SIZE

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - start-up initialisation (8K page PAGE_INIT, runs at $E000 in
   3+ E000              ; slot 7)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Code needed only once, at start-up, kept out of the resident page: start
   6+ E000              ; (zpolice.asm) pages this in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INIT and calls
   7+ E000              ; initgame, then slot 7 is free for the other core pages.
   8+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   9+ E000
  10+ E000              ; Hardware set-up: 28MHz, Layer 2 mode, transparency, layer priority, Layer
  11+ E000              ; 2 scroll and clip window, the memory map of the always-mapped slots, the
  12+ E000              ; peripheral settings (AY sound, turbo sound, internal speaker, no
  13+ E000              ; contention), and a black border.
  14+ E000              initgame:
  15+ E000 ED 91 07 03          nextreg $07,3                   ; 28MHz
  16+ E004 ED 91 70 00          nextreg $70,0                   ; Layer 2 256x192 mode
  17+ E008 ED 91 14 E3          nextreg $14,$E3                 ; global transparency colour
  18+ E00C ED 91 15 08          nextreg $15,%00001000           ; priority S U L (ULA over L2); sprites
  19+ E010                                                      ; off until sprites_init
  20+ E010 ED 91 16 00          nextreg $16,0                   ; Layer 2 scroll X
  21+ E014 ED 91 17 00          nextreg $17,0                   ; Layer 2 scroll Y
  22+ E018 ED 91 1C 01          nextreg $1C,%00000001           ; reset L2 clip index
  23+ E01C ED 91 18 00          nextreg $18,0                   ; Layer 2 clip: x 0..255,
  24+ E020 ED 91 18 FF          nextreg $18,255
  25+ E024 ED 91 18 00          nextreg $18,0                   ; y 0..191: the viewport, and the
  26+ E028 ED 91 18 BF          nextreg $18,191                 ; city map through the ULA panel
  27+ E02C ED 91 54 0A          nextreg ULA_MMU,PAGE_ULA0       ; ULA screen (bank 5) at $8000
  28+ E030 ED 91 51 05          nextreg ZOMBIE_MMU,PAGE_ZOMBIE  ; zombie code/data stays at $2000
  29+ E034 ED 91 52 06          nextreg OCC_MMU,PAGE_OCC0       ; occlusion data at $4000-$5FFF,
  30+ E038 ED 91 53 07          nextreg TABLES_MMU,PAGE_OCC1    ; city_col at $6000-$6FFF
  31+ E03C                      ; Peripheral settings.  $06 and $08 are read, changed and written
  32+ E03C                      ; back, so the bits not named here keep their values (in $06, bit 4
  33+ E03C                      ; is the divMMC automap, which the file handler's RST $08 needs).
  34+ E03C 3E 06                ld a,$06                        ; Peripheral 2: audio chip mode
  35+ E03E CD 44 AA             call read_nextreg               ; (bits 1-0) = %01, AY
  36+ E041 E6 FC                and %11111100
  37+ E043 F6 01                or %00000001
  38+ E045 ED 92 06             nextreg $06,a
  39+ E048 3E 08                ld a,$08                        ; Peripheral 3:
  40+ E04A CD 44 AA             call read_nextreg
  41+ E04D F6 52                or %01010010                    ; bit 6: no RAM / I/O contention,
  42+ E04F ED 92 08             nextreg $08,a                   ; bit 4: internal speaker on,
  43+ E052                                                      ; bit 1: turbo sound on

  45+ E056                                                      ; mono), no sprite id lockstep, HDMI
  46+ E056                                                      ; audio on, no scanlines

  48+ E057 D3 FE                out ($FE),a                     ; black border

# file opened: file_handler.asm
   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - file handling: loading and saving on the SD card (8K page
   3+ E000              ; PAGE_FILE, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in with nextreg
   4+ E000              ; CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE before calling)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; General-purpose routines over the esxDOS / NextZXOS file API (RST $08 with
   7+ E000              ; a function code after it).  Game-specific loading and saving (save games,
   8+ E000              ; high scores, settings) go on top of these.
   9+ E000              ;
  10+ E000              ; The ROM: the divMMC only traps RST $08 while the ROM is paged in at
  11+ E000              ; $0000-$3FFF, but the game keeps other pages there (slot 0: a Layer 2
  12+ E000              ; section or the sine table; slot 1: the zombie page).  So every call pages
  13+ E000              ; the ROM into slots 0 and 1 (fh_rom_in), makes the RST $08, then puts the
  14+ E000              ; game's pages back (fh_rom_out).  Interrupts are off over the call (the
  15+ E000              ; game's IM 2 routine is in slot 1, covered by the ROM, and IY is in use and
  16+ E000              ; slot 2 holds game data, so the ROM's routine must not run either), and
  17+ E000              ; fh_rom_out turns them back on if they were on.
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; Rules for callers:
  20+ E000              ;   * page this in at $E000 (slot 7) first, and call from outside slot 7:
  21+ E000              ;     resident code or a game logic page in slot 6;
  22+ E000              ;   * file names and data buffers must be in $4000-$DFFF: not in slots 0-1
  23+ E000              ;     (the ROM and esxDOS are there during a call) nor slot 7 (this page);
  24+ E000              ;   * file names end with a 0 byte.
  25+ E000              ;
  26+ E000              ; Every routine returns carry clear on success; carry set on failure with
  27+ E000              ; A = the esxDOS error code.  A file that was opened is closed again on
  28+ E000              ; any error in fh_load / fh_save.
  29+ E000              ;
  30+ E000              ; Routines:
  31+ E000              ;   fh_init      get the default drive (call once, before the others)
  32+ E000              ;   fh_open      HL = name, B = mode (FA_*)      -> A = handle
  33+ E000              ;   fh_close     A = handle
  34+ E000              ;   fh_read      A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes read
  35+ E000              ;   fh_write     A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes written
  36+ E000              ;   fh_seek      A = handle, BCDE = offset, L = SEEK_* -> BCDE = position
  37+ E000              ;   fh_size      A = handle                      -> BCDE = file size
  38+ E000              ;   fh_load      HL = name, DE = address, BC = most bytes -> BC = bytes read
  39+ E000              ;   fh_save      HL = name, DE = address, BC = length (created / replaced)
  40+ E000              ;   fh_exists    HL = name -> carry clear if the file exists
  41+ E000              ;   fh_delete    HL = name
  42+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  43+ E000
  44+ E000              ; esxDOS function codes (the byte after RST $08)
  45+ E000              M_GETSETDRV     equ $89             ; A = 0: get the default drive
  46+ E000              F_OPEN          equ $9A
  47+ E000              F_CLOSE         equ $9B
  48+ E000              F_READ          equ $9D
  49+ E000              F_WRITE         equ $9E
  50+ E000              F_SEEK          equ $9F
  51+ E000              F_FSTAT         equ $A1
  52+ E000              F_UNLINK        equ $AD
  53+ E000
  54+ E000              ; F_OPEN modes (B)
  55+ E000              FA_READ         equ $01             ; read
  56+ E000              FA_WRITE        equ $02             ; write
  57+ E000              FA_OPEN_EX      equ $00             ; open an existing file only
  58+ E000              FA_OPEN_AL      equ $08             ; open, or create if it doesn't exist
  59+ E000              FA_CREATE_NEW   equ $04             ; create, fail if it exists
  60+ E000              FA_CREATE_AL    equ $0C             ; create, replacing any existing file
  61+ E000              FA_OVERWRITE    equ FA_WRITE|FA_CREATE_AL   ; for saving a whole file
  62+ E000
  63+ E000              ; F_SEEK modes (L)
  64+ E000              SEEK_START      equ 0               ; from the start of the file
  65+ E000              SEEK_FWD        equ 1               ; forwards from the current position
  66+ E000              SEEK_BACK       equ 2               ; backwards from the current position
  67+ E000
  68+ E000              FSTAT_SIZE      equ 7               ; F_FSTAT buffer: file size, 4 bytes
  69+ E000              FSTAT_LEN       equ 11              ; F_FSTAT buffer length
  70+ E000
  71+ E000              ESX_DEFAULT     equ '*'             ; drive: the default drive
  72+ E000
  73+ E000              ; An esxDOS call: the ROM in at $0000-$3FFF for the RST $08, the game's
  74+ E000              ; pages back after.  Registers in and out are the function's own; flags
  75+ E000              ; and A come back from esxDOS (carry set = error, A = code).
  76+ E000                      MACRO ESXDOS fn
  77+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_in
  78+ E000 ~                    rst $08
  79+ E000 ~                    db fn
  80+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_out
  81+ E000                      ENDM
  82+ E000
  83+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  84+ E000              ; Get the default drive into fh_drive (else the '*' default is used)
  85+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  86+ E000              fh_init:
  87+ E000 AF                   xor a                           ; A = 0: get
  88+ E001                      ESXDOS M_GETSETDRV
  88+ E001 CD CC E0    >        call fh_rom_in
  88+ E004 CF          >        rst $08
  88+ E005 89          >        db M_GETSETDRV
  88+ E006 CD FD E0    >        call fh_rom_out
  89+ E009 D8                   ret c
  90+ E00A 32 16 E1             ld (fh_drive),a
  91+ E00D C9                   ret
  92+ E00E
  93+ E00E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  94+ E00E              ; HL -> file name, B = mode (FA_*) -> A = handle (also in fh_handle)
  95+ E00E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  96+ E00E              fh_open:
  97+ E00E DD E5                push ix
  98+ E010 E5                   push hl
  99+ E011 DD E1                pop ix                          ; IX = HL = the name (both
 100+ E013 3A 16 E1             ld a,(fh_drive)                 ; conventions: programs, dot
 101+ E016                      ESXDOS F_OPEN                   ; commands)
 101+ E016 CD CC E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 101+ E019 CF          >        rst $08
 101+ E01A 9A          >        db F_OPEN
 101+ E01B CD FD E0    >        call fh_rom_out
 102+ E01E DD E1                pop ix
 103+ E020 D8                   ret c
 104+ E021 32 17 E1             ld (fh_handle),a
 105+ E024 C9                   ret
 106+ E025
 107+ E025              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 108+ E025              ; A = handle: close it
 109+ E025              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 110+ E025              fh_close:
 111+ E025                      ESXDOS F_CLOSE
 111+ E025 CD CC E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 111+ E028 CF          >        rst $08
 111+ E029 9B          >        db F_CLOSE
 111+ E02A CD FD E0    >        call fh_rom_out
 112+ E02D C9                   ret
 113+ E02E
 114+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 115+ E02E              ; A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes read (fewer at the end
 116+ E02E              ; of the file)
 117+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 118+ E02E              fh_read:
 119+ E02E DD E5                push ix
 120+ E030 E5                   push hl
 121+ E031 DD E1                pop ix
 122+ E033                      ESXDOS F_READ
 122+ E033 CD CC E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 122+ E036 CF          >        rst $08
 122+ E037 9D          >        db F_READ
 122+ E038 CD FD E0    >        call fh_rom_out
 123+ E03B DD E1                pop ix
 124+ E03D C9                   ret
 125+ E03E
 126+ E03E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 127+ E03E              ; A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes written
 128+ E03E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 129+ E03E              fh_write:
 130+ E03E DD E5                push ix
 131+ E040 E5                   push hl
 132+ E041 DD E1                pop ix
 133+ E043                      ESXDOS F_WRITE
 133+ E043 CD CC E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 133+ E046 CF          >        rst $08
 133+ E047 9E          >        db F_WRITE
 133+ E048 CD FD E0    >        call fh_rom_out
 134+ E04B DD E1                pop ix
 135+ E04D C9                   ret
 136+ E04E
 137+ E04E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 138+ E04E              ; A = handle, BCDE = offset (32-bit), L = mode (SEEK_*) -> BCDE = position
 139+ E04E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 140+ E04E              fh_seek:
 141+ E04E DD E5                push ix
 142+ E050 E5                   push hl
 143+ E051 E5                   push hl
 144+ E052 DD E1                pop ix                          ; mode in IXL (programs) and L
 145+ E054                      ESXDOS F_SEEK
 145+ E054 CD CC E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 145+ E057 CF          >        rst $08
 145+ E058 9F          >        db F_SEEK
 145+ E059 CD FD E0    >        call fh_rom_out
 146+ E05C E1                   pop hl
 147+ E05D DD E1                pop ix
 148+ E05F C9                   ret
 149+ E060
 150+ E060              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 151+ E060              ; A = handle -> BCDE = file size (32-bit)
 152+ E060              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 153+ E060              fh_size:
 154+ E060 DD E5                push ix
 155+ E062 E5                   push hl
 156+ E063 21 1B E1             ld hl,fh_stat
 157+ E066 E5                   push hl
 158+ E067 DD E1                pop ix
 159+ E069                      ESXDOS F_FSTAT
 159+ E069 CD CC E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 159+ E06C CF          >        rst $08
 159+ E06D A1          >        db F_FSTAT
 159+ E06E CD FD E0    >        call fh_rom_out
 160+ E071 38 0A                jr c,.x
 161+ E073 2A 22 E1             ld hl,(fh_stat+FSTAT_SIZE)
 162+ E076 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; DE = low word
 163+ E077 2A 24 E1             ld hl,(fh_stat+FSTAT_SIZE+2)
 164+ E07A 44                   ld b,h                          ; BC = high word
 165+ E07B 4D                   ld c,l
 166+ E07C B7                   or a
 167+ E07D E1           .x:     pop hl
 168+ E07E DD E1                pop ix
 169+ E080 C9                   ret
 170+ E081
 171+ E081              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 172+ E081              ; Load a file: HL -> name, DE = address, BC = most bytes to read
 173+ E081              ; -> BC = bytes read.  The file is opened, read and closed.
 174+ E081              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 175+ E081              fh_load:
 176+ E081 D5                   push de
 177+ E082 C5                   push bc
 178+ E083 06 01                ld b,FA_READ|FA_OPEN_EX
 179+ E085 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
 180+ E088 C1                   pop bc
 181+ E089 E1                   pop hl                          ; HL = address
 182+ E08A D8                   ret c                           ; couldn't open (A = error)
 183+ E08B CD 2E E0             call fh_read
 184+ E08E 18 0D                jr fh_done                      ; close it, keeping any error
 185+ E090
 186+ E090              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 187+ E090              ; Save a file: HL -> name, DE = address, BC = length.  The file is created,
 188+ E090              ; replacing any file of that name.
 189+ E090              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 190+ E090              fh_save:
 191+ E090 D5                   push de
 192+ E091 C5                   push bc
 193+ E092 06 0E                ld b,FA_OVERWRITE
 194+ E094 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
 195+ E097 C1                   pop bc
 196+ E098 E1                   pop hl
 197+ E099 D8                   ret c
 198+ E09A CD 3E E0             call fh_write
 199+ E09D                      ; fall through
 200+ E09D
 201+ E09D              ; After a read / write on fh_handle: close the file.  Carry and A as from
 202+ E09D              ; that read / write if it failed, else as from the close.
 203+ E09D              fh_done:
 204+ E09D F5                   push af
 205+ E09E 3A 17 E1             ld a,(fh_handle)
 206+ E0A1 CD 25 E0             call fh_close
 207+ E0A4 38 02                jr c,.cerr
 208+ E0A6 F1                   pop af                          ; the read / write's result
 209+ E0A7 C9                   ret
 210+ E0A8 E1           .cerr:  pop hl                          ; the close failed: if the read /
 211+ E0A9 CB 45                bit 0,l                         ; write had already failed, report
 212+ E0AB 28 01                jr z,.ce                        ; that, else the close's error
 213+ E0AD 7C                   ld a,h
 214+ E0AE 37           .ce:    scf
 215+ E0AF C9                   ret
 216+ E0B0
 217+ E0B0              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 218+ E0B0              ; HL -> name: carry clear if the file exists (it can be opened to read)
 219+ E0B0              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 220+ E0B0              fh_exists:
 221+ E0B0 06 01                ld b,FA_READ|FA_OPEN_EX
 222+ E0B2 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
 223+ E0B5 D8                   ret c
 224+ E0B6 C3 25 E0             jp fh_close
 225+ E0B9
 226+ E0B9              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 227+ E0B9              ; HL -> name: delete the file
 228+ E0B9              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 229+ E0B9              fh_delete:
 230+ E0B9 DD E5                push ix
 231+ E0BB E5                   push hl
 232+ E0BC DD E1                pop ix
 233+ E0BE 3A 16 E1             ld a,(fh_drive)
 234+ E0C1                      ESXDOS F_UNLINK
 234+ E0C1 CD CC E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 234+ E0C4 CF          >        rst $08
 234+ E0C5 AD          >        db F_UNLINK
 234+ E0C6 CD FD E0    >        call fh_rom_out
 235+ E0C9 DD E1                pop ix
 236+ E0CB C9                   ret
 237+ E0CC
 238+ E0CC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 239+ E0CC              ; Page the ROM into slots 0 and 1 for RST $08, remembering the game's pages
 240+ E0CC              ; (fh_rom_in), and put them back (fh_rom_out).  Interrupts are off in
 241+ E0CC              ; between (the ROM covers the interrupt routine, slot 1), and back on after
 242+ E0CC              ; if they were on before.  Both keep every register and flag.
 243+ E0CC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 244+ E0CC              fh_rom_in:
 245+ E0CC F5                   push af
 246+ E0CD ED 57                ld a,i                          ; P/V: interrupts on (IFF2)
 247+ E0CF F3                   di
 248+ E0D0 3E 00                ld a,0
 249+ E0D2 E2 D6 E0             jp po,.off
 250+ E0D5 3C                   inc a
 251+ E0D6 32 1A E1     .off:   ld (fh_ints),a
 252+ E0D9 C5                   push bc
 253+ E0DA 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 254+ E0DD 3E 50                ld a,MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER        ; slot 0's page now
 255+ E0DF ED 79                out (c),a
 256+ E0E1 04                   inc b
 257+ E0E2 ED 78                in a,(c)
 258+ E0E4 32 18 E1             ld (fh_mmu0),a
 259+ E0E7 05                   dec b
 260+ E0E8 3E 51                ld a,MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER        ; slot 1's
 261+ E0EA ED 79                out (c),a
 262+ E0EC 04                   inc b
 263+ E0ED ED 78                in a,(c)
 264+ E0EF 32 19 E1             ld (fh_mmu1),a
 265+ E0F2 ED 91 50 FF          nextreg MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER,PAGE_ROM
 266+ E0F6 ED 91 51 FF          nextreg MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER,PAGE_ROM
 267+ E0FA C1                   pop bc
 268+ E0FB F1                   pop af
 269+ E0FC C9                   ret
 270+ E0FD
 271+ E0FD              fh_rom_out:
 272+ E0FD F3                   di                              ; (in case esxDOS enabled them)
 273+ E0FE F5                   push af
 274+ E0FF 3A 18 E1             ld a,(fh_mmu0)
 275+ E102 ED 92 50             nextreg MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER,a
 276+ E105 3A 19 E1             ld a,(fh_mmu1)
 277+ E108 ED 92 51             nextreg MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER,a
 278+ E10B 3A 1A E1             ld a,(fh_ints)
 279+ E10E B7                   or a
 280+ E10F 28 03                jr z,.off
 281+ E111 F1                   pop af
 282+ E112 FB                   ei                              ; on again, as they were
 283+ E113 C9                   ret
 284+ E114 F1           .off:   pop af
 285+ E115 C9                   ret
 286+ E116
 287+ E116              ;==============================================================================
 288+ E116              ; File handler data
 289+ E116              ;==============================================================================
 290+ E116 2A           fh_drive:   db ESX_DEFAULT              ; drive for F_OPEN (fh_init)
 291+ E117 00           fh_handle:  db 0                        ; the last file opened
 292+ E118 00           fh_mmu0:    db 0                        ; the game's slot 0 / 1 pages during
 293+ E119 00           fh_mmu1:    db 0                        ; an esxDOS call
 294+ E11A 00           fh_ints:    db 0                        ; 1: interrupts were on before it
 295+ E11B 00 00 00...  fh_stat:    ds FSTAT_LEN                ; F_FSTAT buffer (fh_size)
 296+ E126
# file closed: file_handler.asm

   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - audio (8K page PAGE_AUDIO, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in
   3+ E000              ; with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_AUDIO before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Sound devices: the Next's TurboSound, three AY-3-8912 chips.  initgame
   6+ E000              ; (initialise.asm) has already set the chip mode to AY (NextReg $06),
   7+ E000              ; turned TurboSound and the internal speaker on (NextReg $08) and the AY
   8+ E000              ; outputs to stereo (NextReg $09).  init_audio then sets every chip to a
   9+ E000              ; known, silent state (at start-up, and on every menu screen: menu_clear).
  10+ E000              ; AY 1 is the VTOL's engines: engine_start here, then the interrupt routine
  11+ E000              ; plays them (engine_tick, interrupts.asm).  AY 2 is the weapons' sound
  12+ E000              ; effects, AY 3 explosions: the game asks for one with ld a,SFX_n / ld
  13+ E000              ; (sfx_req),a (AY 2), ld (sfx2_req),a (AY 3's A and B) or ld (sfx3_req),a
  14+ E000              ; (AY 3's C), and the interrupt plays it (sfx_tick).  (Music would need AY 3
  15+ E000              ; back.)  The interrupt writes the AY ports while eng_on is 1,
  16+ E000              ; so code here writes them only with eng_on 0 (or interrupts off).
  17+ E000              ;
  18+ E000              ; TurboSound ports:
  19+ E000              ;   $FFFD write %1LR111cc: select AY chip cc (AY_CHIP_1..3) with its left
  20+ E000              ;         (L) and right (R) outputs on;
  21+ E000              ;         any value 0..15: select that register of the selected chip
  22+ E000              ;   $BFFD write: the value of the selected register
  23+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  24+ E000
  25+ E000              AY_CTRL_PORT    equ $FFFD           ; chip / register select
  26+ E000              AY_DATA_PORT    equ $BFFD           ; register value
  27+ E000
  28+ E000              ; Chip select ($FFFD): AY_SELECT | AY_LEFT | AY_RIGHT | AY_CHIP_n
  29+ E000              AY_SELECT       equ %10011100       ; bit 7 and bits 4-2 must be set
  30+ E000              AY_LEFT         equ %01000000       ; left output on
  31+ E000              AY_RIGHT        equ %00100000       ; right output on
  32+ E000              AY_CHIP_1       equ %11
  33+ E000              AY_CHIP_2       equ %10
  34+ E000              AY_CHIP_3       equ %01

  38+ E000              AY_TONE_B       equ 2
  39+ E000              AY_TONE_C       equ 4

  41+ E000              AY_MIXER        equ 7               ; tone / noise enable, 0 = on:

  43+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_B    equ %00000010
  44+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_C    equ %00000100

  51+ E000              AY_ENV_FINE     equ 11              ; envelope period
  52+ E000              AY_ENV_COARSE   equ 12

  59+ E000

  61+ E000              ; at zero throttle, sounds as speed 1), 1..SPEED_MAX

  65+ E000              ENG_NOISE_MUL   equ 13              ;   (29 at idle, a rumble; 7 flat out, a hiss)
  66+ E000              ENG_ROAR_VOL0   equ 4               ;   volume 4 + n*7/32 (4..10)

  69+ E000              ENG_WHINE_VOL0  equ 2               ;   volume 2 + n*7/32 (2..8)

  71+ E000              ENG_DETUNE      equ 2               ; C, the same whine 2 periods lower: the
  72+ E000              ENG_SHIMMER_VOL equ 2               ;   two beat (the turbines' shimmer), 2 quieter

  74+ E000              SFX_MG          equ 1               ; the machine gun: one round
  75+ E000              SFX_LASER       equ 2               ; the pulse laser: one pulse (a zap)
  76+ E000              SFX_CHAIN       equ 3               ; the chain gun: one round
  77+ E000              SFX_ROCKET      equ 4               ; a rocket fired: a short woosh
  78+ E000              SFX_MISSILE     equ 5               ; a missile fired: a longer woosh

  80+ E000              SFX_BOOM_ROCKET equ 7               ; explosions (AY 3, sfx2_req): a rocket's,

  85+ E000              SFX_CRASH       equ 12              ; the VTOL hitting a building (AY 3, sfx2_req)
  86+ E000              SFX_LOCK        equ 13              ; the missile lock: a double beep (AY 2)
  87+ E000              SFX_LAST        equ 13              ; (sfx_table, sfx_data.asm)

  92+ E000              SFX_MIX_TONE_AB equ AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C

  94+ E000              SFX_MIX_NOISE_A equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_TONE_B|AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C

   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - player page (8K page PAGE_PLAYER, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Keyboard input, movement along the heading, world-edge clamping and
