   6+ C000              ; PAGE_PLAYER, with the keys page (key_held) in slot 7.
   7+ C000              ; Uses the resident helpers get_sin, fmul and bld_height; camera state (cam_x/z/y, yaw, pitch, speed) is shared and
   8+ C000              ; stays in zpolice.asm.
   9+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  10+ C000
  11+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  12+ C000              ; Player input and movement
  13+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  14+ C000              update_player:
  15+ C000 AF                   xor a
  16+ C001 D3 FE                out ($FE),a                     ; border back to black
  17+ C003                      ; remember position in case we fly into something
  18+ C003 21 93 AF             ld hl,cam_x                     ; (and the heading: turning swings
  19+ C006 11 96 C3             ld de,old_pos                   ; the VTOL's nose and tail)
  20+ C009 01 0A 00             ld bc,10                        ; cam_x(3) cam_z(3) cam_y(2) yaw(2)
  21+ C00C ED B0                ldir
  22+ C00E 3A B1 AF             ld a,(vtol_dead)
  23+ C011 B7                   or a
  24+ C012 28 07                jr z,.alive
  25+ C014 AF                   xor a
  26+ C015 32 3E B0             ld (boost_on),a                 ; (no boost in a wreck)
  27+ C018 C3 1B C3             jp vtol_wreck                   ; destroyed: out of control
  28+ C01B              .alive:
  29+ C01B                      ; (keys: kbd_scan has read them; actions from input.asm)
  30+ C01B                      ; --- boost (zpolice.asm: BOOST_*): while on, the speed keys and the
  31+ C01B                      ; air brake don't change the speed, and each frame burns a fuel
  32+ C01B 3A 3E B0             ld a,(boost_on)
  33+ C01E B7                   or a
  34+ C01F 28 2A                jr z,.nb
  35+ C021 3A 9F AF             ld a,(speed)
  36+ C024 FE 38                cp BOOST_SPEED
  37+ C026 20 18                jr nz,.bend                     ; stopped meanwhile (a collision)
  38+ C028 CD 44 AD             call vtol_on_floor
  39+ C02B 28 13                jr z,.bend                      ; set down: off (the brake stops it)
  40+ C02D 3E 13                ld a,K_BOOST
  41+ C02F CD CF E0             call key_pressed
  42+ C032 20 06                jr nz,.boff                     ; pressed again: off
  43+ C034 21 3D B0             ld hl,boost_fuel
  44+ C037 35                   dec (hl)
  45+ C038 20 0A                jr nz,.bkeep                    ; still burning
  46+ C03A 3A 3F B0     .boff:  ld a,(boost_spd)                ; off (or out of fuel): the speed it
  47+ C03D 32 9F AF             ld (speed),a                    ; had before
  48+ C040 AF           .bend:  xor a
  49+ C041 32 3E B0             ld (boost_on),a
  50+ C044 AF           .bkeep: xor a                           ; (no air brake this frame)
  51+ C045 32 A2 C3             ld (ab_on),a
  52+ C048 C3 29 C1             jp .nw
  53+ C04B 3E 13        .nb:    ld a,K_BOOST                    ; off: pressed to start it?
  54+ C04D CD CF E0             call key_pressed
  55+ C050 28 2B                jr z,.nbs
  56+ C052 3A 3C B0             ld a,(boost_fitted)
  57+ C055 B7                   or a
  58+ C056 28 25                jr z,.nbs                       ; no booster
  59+ C058 3A 3D B0             ld a,(boost_fuel)
  60+ C05B B7                   or a
  61+ C05C 28 1F                jr z,.nbs                       ; no fuel
  62+ C05E CD 44 AD             call vtol_on_floor
  63+ C061 28 1A                jr z,.nbs                       ; landed: not on the ground
  64+ C063 3A 9F AF             ld a,(speed)
  65+ C066 CB 7F                bit 7,a
  66+ C068 20 13                jr nz,.nbs                      ; reversing
  67+ C06A FE 0E                cp BOOST_MIN
  68+ C06C 38 0F                jr c,.nbs                       ; under half speed
  69+ C06E 32 3F B0             ld (boost_spd),a
  70+ C071 3E 38                ld a,BOOST_SPEED                ; on: twice the top speed at once
  71+ C073 32 9F AF             ld (speed),a
  72+ C076 3E 01                ld a,1
  73+ C078 32 3E B0             ld (boost_on),a
  74+ C07B 18 C7                jr .bkeep
  75+ C07D              .nbs:
  76+ C07D                      ; --- landed (resting on the road, a roof or the pad): the speed keys
  77+ C07D                      ; only bring it back to 0 (speeding up only from reverse, slowing
  78+ C07D                      ; only from forwards), and any speed is braked away as the air brake
  79+ C07D                      ; does (as if Z were held), with a shake
  80+ C07D CD 44 AD             call vtol_on_floor
  81+ C080 20 3C                jr nz,.fly
  82+ C082 3E 00                ld a,K_SPEED_UP
  83+ C084 CD BE E0             call key_held
  84+ C087 28 0B                jr z,.lq
  85+ C089 3A 9F AF             ld a,(speed)
  86+ C08C CB 7F                bit 7,a
  87+ C08E 28 04                jr z,.lq                        ; not reversing: no
  88+ C090 3C                   inc a
  89+ C091 32 9F AF             ld (speed),a
  90+ C094 3E 01        .lq:    ld a,K_SPEED_DN
  91+ C096 CD BE E0             call key_held
  92+ C099 28 0A                jr z,.lb
  93+ C09B 3A 9F AF             ld a,(speed)
  94+ C09E 3D                   dec a
  95+ C09F FA A5 C0             jp m,.lb                        ; at 0 or reversing: no
  96+ C0A2 32 9F AF             ld (speed),a
  97+ C0A5 3A 9F AF     .lb:    ld a,(speed)
  98+ C0A8 B7                   or a
  99+ C0A9 CA E2 C0             jp z,.na                        ; stopped (Z: nothing to brake)
 100+ C0AC 3A 9C AA             ld a,(shake_t)                  ; a shake, unless one is going
 101+ C0AF B7                   or a
 102+ C0B0 20 05                jr nz,.lbr
 103+ C0B2 3E 06                ld a,SHAKE_LEN
 104+ C0B4 32 9C AA             ld (shake_t),a
 105+ C0B7 AF           .lbr:   xor a
 106+ C0B8 32 A2 C3             ld (ab_on),a
 107+ C0BB C3 ED C0             jp .brk                         ; braked, as by the air brake
 108+ C0BE              .fly:
 109+ C0BE                      ; --- speed ---
 110+ C0BE 3E 00                ld a,K_SPEED_UP                 ; (by SPEED_STEP, 1)
 111+ C0C0 CD BE E0             call key_held
 112+ C0C3 28 0B                jr z,.nq
 113+ C0C5 3A 9F AF             ld a,(speed)
 114+ C0C8 FE 1C                cp SPEED_MAX
 115+ C0CA 28 04                jr z,.nq
 116+ C0CC 3C                   inc a
 117+ C0CD 32 9F AF             ld (speed),a
 118+ C0D0 3E 01        .nq:    ld a,K_SPEED_DN
 119+ C0D2 CD BE E0             call key_held
 120+ C0D5 28 0B                jr z,.na
 121+ C0D7 3A 9F AF             ld a,(speed)
 122+ C0DA FE FA                cp (SPEED_MIN) & $FF
 123+ C0DC 28 04                jr z,.na
 124+ C0DE 3D                   dec a
 125+ C0DF 32 9F AF             ld (speed),a
 126+ C0E2              .na:    ; --- air brake: while held, the speed falls AIRBRAKE_STEP a frame
 127+ C0E2                      ; towards 0, going forwards or backwards.  Each braking frame tips the
 128+ C0E2                      ; nose one pitch step, as a nose key press does: up when braking
 129+ C0E2                      ; forward motion, down when braking reverse.  The pitch damper waits
 130+ C0E2                      ; while it brakes (ab_on), as it does while a nose key is held.
 131+ C0E2 AF                   xor a
 132+ C0E3 32 A2 C3             ld (ab_on),a
 133+ C0E6 3E 02                ld a,K_AIRBRAKE
 134+ C0E8 CD BE E0             call key_held
 135+ C0EB 28 3C                jr z,.nw
 136+ C0ED 3A 9F AF     .brk:   ld a,(speed)
 137+ C0F0 B7                   or a
 138+ C0F1 28 36                jr z,.nw                        ; stopped: nothing to brake
 139+ C0F3 32 A2 C3             ld (ab_on),a                    ; (non-zero: braking this frame)
 140+ C0F6 FA 12 C1             jp m,.rev
 141+ C0F9 D6 02                sub AIRBRAKE_STEP               ; forwards: slower, not past 0
 142+ C0FB 30 01                jr nc,.fwd
 143+ C0FD AF                   xor a
 144+ C0FE 32 9F AF     .fwd:   ld (speed),a
 145+ C101 AF                   xor a
 146+ C102 32 9D AF             ld (pitch_frac),a               ; whole steps, as the keys
 147+ C105 3A 9E AF             ld a,(pitch)
 148+ C108 FE 18                cp PMAX
 149+ C10A 28 1D                jr z,.nw
 150+ C10C 3C                   inc a                           ; nose up
 151+ C10D 32 9E AF             ld (pitch),a
 152+ C110 18 17                jr .nw
 153+ C112 C6 02        .rev:   add a,AIRBRAKE_STEP             ; backwards: towards 0, not past it
 154+ C114 30 01                jr nc,.bk
 155+ C116 AF                   xor a
 156+ C117 32 9F AF     .bk:    ld (speed),a
 157+ C11A AF                   xor a
 158+ C11B 32 9D AF             ld (pitch_frac),a
 159+ C11E 3A 9E AF             ld a,(pitch)
 160+ C121 FE E8                cp (-PMAX) & $FF
 161+ C123 28 04                jr z,.nw
 162+ C125 3D                   dec a                           ; nose down
 163+ C126 32 9E AF             ld (pitch),a
 164+ C129              .nw:
 165+ C129                      ; --- yaw: YAW_RATE a frame, but YAW_FINE on the frame a turn key is
 166+ C129                      ; first pressed (a tap turns 1 degree: fine control)
 167+ C129 3E 03                ld a,K_LEFT
 168+ C12B CD BE E0             call key_held
 169+ C12E 28 16                jr z,.ns
 170+ C130 11 80 01             ld de,YAW_RATE
 171+ C133 3E 03                ld a,K_LEFT
 172+ C135 CD CF E0             call key_pressed
 173+ C138 28 03                jr z,.lr
 174+ C13A 11 B6 00             ld de,YAW_FINE
 175+ C13D 2A 9B AF     .lr:    ld hl,(yaw_frac)                ; 8.8 heading
 176+ C140 B7                   or a
 177+ C141 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 178+ C143 22 9B AF             ld (yaw_frac),hl
 179+ C146 3E 04        .ns:    ld a,K_RIGHT
 180+ C148 CD BE E0             call key_held
 181+ C14B 28 14                jr z,.nf
 182+ C14D 11 80 01             ld de,YAW_RATE
 183+ C150 3E 04                ld a,K_RIGHT
 184+ C152 CD CF E0             call key_pressed
 185+ C155 28 03                jr z,.rr
 186+ C157 11 B6 00             ld de,YAW_FINE
 187+ C15A 2A 9B AF     .rr:    ld hl,(yaw_frac)
 188+ C15D 19                   add hl,de
 189+ C15E 22 9B AF             ld (yaw_frac),hl
 190+ C161              .nf:
 191+ C161                      ; --- pitch ---
 192+ C161 3E 08                ld a,K_NOSE_DN
 193+ C163 CD BE E0             call key_held
 194+ C166 28 0F                jr z,.ng
 195+ C168 AF                   xor a
 196+ C169 32 9D AF             ld (pitch_frac),a               ; keys move in whole steps
 197+ C16C 3A 9E AF             ld a,(pitch)
 198+ C16F FE E8                cp (-PMAX) & $FF
 199+ C171 28 04                jr z,.ng
 200+ C173 3D                   dec a
 201+ C174 32 9E AF             ld (pitch),a
 202+ C177 3E 07        .ng:    ld a,K_NOSE_UP
 203+ C179 CD BE E0             call key_held
 204+ C17C 28 0F                jr z,.nt
 205+ C17E AF                   xor a
 206+ C17F 32 9D AF             ld (pitch_frac),a
 207+ C182 3A 9E AF             ld a,(pitch)
 208+ C185 FE 18                cp PMAX
 209+ C187 28 04                jr z,.nt
 210+ C189 3C                   inc a
 211+ C18A 32 9E AF             ld (pitch),a
 212+ C18D              .nt:    ; --- pitch damper: ease back to level when the pitch keys are released
 213+ C18D                      ; (and the air brake isn't tipping the nose)
 214+ C18D 3A A2 C3             ld a,(ab_on)
 215+ C190 B7                   or a
 216+ C191 20 1B                jr nz,.held
 217+ C193 3E 07                ld a,K_NOSE_UP
 218+ C195 CD BE E0             call key_held
 219+ C198 20 14                jr nz,.held
 220+ C19A 3E 08                ld a,K_NOSE_DN
 221+ C19C CD BE E0             call key_held
 222+ C19F 20 0D                jr nz,.held
 223+ C1A1 21 A1 C3             ld hl,pd_count
 224+ C1A4 35                   dec (hl)
 225+ C1A5 20 0C                jr nz,.pdx
 226+ C1A7 36 01                ld (hl),PDAMP_FRAMES
 227+ C1A9 CD 69 C3             call pitch_damp
 228+ C1AC 18 05                jr .pdx
 229+ C1AE 3E 01        .held:  ld a,PDAMP_FRAMES               ; a full interval after letting go
 230+ C1B0 32 A1 C3             ld (pd_count),a
 231+ C1B3              .pdx:
 232+ C1B3                      ; --- height ---
 233+ C1B3 3E 05                ld a,K_CLIMB
 234+ C1B5 CD BE E0             call key_held
 235+ C1B8 28 19                jr z,.ne
 236+ C1BA 2A 99 AF             ld hl,(cam_y)
 237+ C1BD 11 04 00             ld de,CLIMB_RATE
 238+ C1C0 19                   add hl,de
 239+ C1C1 11 C0 00             ld de,MAX_Y                     ; the ceiling: higher with the
 240+ C1C4 3A 38 B0             ld a,(vthrust_fitted)           ; vertical thrusters
 241+ C1C7 B7                   or a
 242+ C1C8 28 03                jr z,.ceil
 243+ C1CA 11 80 01             ld de,MAX_Y_THRUST
 244+ C1CD CD F3 C2     .ceil:  call min_hl_de
 245+ C1D0 22 99 AF             ld (cam_y),hl
 246+ C1D3 3E 06        .ne:    ld a,K_DESCEND
 247+ C1D5 CD BE E0             call key_held
 248+ C1D8 28 19                jr z,.nd
 249+ C1DA 2A 99 AF             ld hl,(cam_y)
 250+ C1DD 11 FC FF             ld de,-CLIMB_RATE
 251+ C1E0 19                   add hl,de
 252+ C1E1 11 08 00             ld de,MIN_Y
 253+ C1E4 CD FB C2             call max_hl_de
 254+ C1E7 E5                   push hl                         ; and not below the floor under the
 255+ C1E8 CD E2 AA             call floor_y                    ; VTOL: it lands on the road or the
 256+ C1EB EB                   ex de,hl                        ; highest roof under it (no collision)
 257+ C1EC E1                   pop hl
 258+ C1ED CD FB C2             call max_hl_de
 259+ C1F0 22 99 AF             ld (cam_y),hl
 260+ C1F3              .nd:
 261+ C1F3                      ; --- move along heading: pos += speed * (sin, cos) ---
 262+ C1F3 3A 9F AF             ld a,(speed)
 263+ C1F6 B7                   or a
 264+ C1F7 28 30                jr z,.moved
 265+ C1F9 3A 9C AF             ld a,(yaw)
 266+ C1FC CD A3 AE             call get_sin
 267+ C1FF EB                   ex de,hl
 268+ C200 3A 9F AF             ld a,(speed)
 269+ C203 67                   ld h,a
 270+ C204 2E 00                ld l,0
 271+ C206 CD 5A AF             call fmul                       ; HL = speed*sin in 1/256 units
 272+ C209 DD 21 93 AF          ld ix,cam_x
 273+ C20D CD AC C2             call add_pos
 274+ C210 3A 9C AF             ld a,(yaw)
 275+ C213 C6 40                add a,64
 276+ C215 CD A3 AE             call get_sin
 277+ C218 EB                   ex de,hl
 278+ C219 3A 9F AF             ld a,(speed)
 279+ C21C 67                   ld h,a
 280+ C21D 2E 00                ld l,0
 281+ C21F CD 5A AF             call fmul
 282+ C222 DD 21 96 AF          ld ix,cam_z
 283+ C226 CD AC C2             call add_pos
 284+ C229              .moved:
 285+ C229 CD 63 C2             call strafe                     ; (the lateral thrusters)
 286+ C22C CD 03 C3             call check_collision
 287+ C22F C8                   ret z
 288+ C230                      ; crashed - restore and stop, taking |speed| / 4 (a 2-bit shift
 289+ C230                      ; right, rounded down) as damage
 290+ C230 21 96 C3             ld hl,old_pos
 291+ C233 11 93 AF             ld de,cam_x
 292+ C236 01 0A 00             ld bc,10
 293+ C239 ED B0                ldir
 294+ C23B 3A 9F AF             ld a,(speed)
 295+ C23E CB 7F                bit 7,a
 296+ C240 28 02                jr z,.dmg
 297+ C242 ED 44                neg                             ; (reversing into it)
 298+ C244 CB 3F        .dmg:   srl a
 299+ C246 CB 3F                srl a
 300+ C248 CD CE AA             call vtol_damage                ; (zpolice.asm)
 301+ C24B AF                   xor a
 302+ C24C 32 9F AF             ld (speed),a
 303+ C24F 3E 03                ld a,C_WARN
 304+ C251 D3 FE                out ($FE),a                     ; red border flash
 305+ C253 3A 9C AA             ld a,(shake_t)                  ; a shake and a crunch, unless one is
 306+ C256 B7                   or a                            ; still going (held against a wall:
 307+ C257 C0                   ret nz                          ; not every bump)
 308+ C258 3E 06                ld a,SHAKE_LEN
 309+ C25A 32 9C AA             ld (shake_t),a                  ; (shake_tick, zpolice.asm)
 310+ C25D 3E 0C                ld a,SFX_CRASH
 311+ C25F 32 6C 3C             ld (sfx2_req),a                 ; (AY 3: the explosions' voice)
 312+ C262 C9                   ret
 313+ C263
 314+ C263              ; The lateral thrusters (lthrust_fitted): while a strafe control
 315+ C263              ; (K_STRAFE_L, K_STRAFE_R) is held, the VTOL moves STRAFE_D sideways,
 316+ C263              ; square to its heading, each frame; not when landed (resting on the
 317+ C263              ; floor).  Collisions as for any move (check_collision, after this).
 318+ C263              STRAFE_D_HALVES equ 5               ; 2.5 world units a frame (0.195 m)
 319+ C263              strafe:
 320+ C263 3A 39 B0             ld a,(lthrust_fitted)
 321+ C266 B7                   or a
 322+ C267 C8                   ret z
 323+ C268 CD 44 AD             call vtol_on_floor
 324+ C26B C8                   ret z                           ; landed
 325+ C26C 0E 40                ld c,64                         ; right: the heading + 90 degrees
 326+ C26E 3E 16                ld a,K_STRAFE_R
 327+ C270 CD BE E0             call key_held                   ; (keeps BC)
 328+ C273 20 08                jr nz,.go
 329+ C275 0E C0                ld c,-64 & $FF                  ; left: - 90
 330+ C277 3E 15                ld a,K_STRAFE_L
 331+ C279 CD BE E0             call key_held
 332+ C27C C8                   ret z
 333+ C27D 3A 9C AF     .go:    ld a,(yaw)
 334+ C280 81                   add a,c
 335+ C281 32 A0 C3             ld (st_a),a
 336+ C284 CD A3 AE             call get_sin                    ; its x: sin
 337+ C287 CD A3 C2             call .d
 338+ C28A DD 21 93 AF          ld ix,cam_x
 339+ C28E CD AC C2             call add_pos
 340+ C291 3A A0 C3             ld a,(st_a)
 341+ C294 C6 40                add a,64
 342+ C296 CD A3 AE             call get_sin                    ; its z: cos
 343+ C299 CD A3 C2             call .d
 344+ C29C DD 21 96 AF          ld ix,cam_z
 345+ C2A0 C3 AC C2             jp add_pos
 346+ C2A3              ; HL = S7.8 component -> HL = 2.5 * it: the move in 1/256 units
 347+ C2A3 54           .d:     ld d,h
 348+ C2A4 5D                   ld e,l
 349+ C2A5 CB 2A                sra d
 350+ C2A7 CB 1B                rr e                            ; half
 351+ C2A9 29                   add hl,hl                       ; twice
 352+ C2AA 19                   add hl,de
 353+ C2AB C9                   ret
 354+ C2AC                      ASSERT STRAFE_D_HALVES == 5     ; (.d: 2 + 1/2)
 355+ C2AC
 356+ C2AC              ; IX -> 24-bit position (frac, lo, hi). HL = signed delta in 1/256 units.
 357+ C2AC              ; Clamps the integer part to WORLD_MIN..WORLD_MAX.
 358+ C2AC              add_pos:
 359+ C2AC 7C                   ld a,h
 360+ C2AD 17                   rla
 361+ C2AE 9F                   sbc a,a
 362+ C2AF 4F                   ld c,a                          ; sign extension
 363+ C2B0 DD 7E 00             ld a,(ix+0)
 364+ C2B3 85                   add a,l
 365+ C2B4 DD 77 00             ld (ix+0),a
 366+ C2B7 DD 7E 01             ld a,(ix+1)
 367+ C2BA 8C                   adc a,h
 368+ C2BB DD 77 01             ld (ix+1),a
 369+ C2BE DD 7E 02             ld a,(ix+2)
 370+ C2C1 89                   adc a,c
 371+ C2C2 DD 77 02             ld (ix+2),a
 372+ C2C5 DD 6E 01             ld l,(ix+1)
 373+ C2C8 DD 66 02             ld h,(ix+2)
 374+ C2CB CB 7C                bit 7,h
 375+ C2CD 20 1B                jr nz,.lo
 376+ C2CF 11 40 00             ld de,WORLD_MIN
 377+ C2D2 B7                   or a
 378+ C2D3 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 379+ C2D5 38 13                jr c,.lo
 380+ C2D7 DD 6E 01             ld l,(ix+1)
 381+ C2DA DD 66 02             ld h,(ix+2)
 382+ C2DD 11 C0 3F             ld de,WORLD_MAX
 383+ C2E0 CD F3 C2             call min_hl_de
 384+ C2E3 DD 75 01             ld (ix+1),l
 385+ C2E6 DD 74 02             ld (ix+2),h
 386+ C2E9 C9                   ret
 387+ C2EA DD 36 01 40  .lo:    ld (ix+1),WORLD_MIN & $FF
 388+ C2EE DD 36 02 00          ld (ix+2),WORLD_MIN >> 8
 389+ C2F2 C9                   ret
 390+ C2F3
 391+ C2F3              ; Unsigned 16-bit clamps
 392+ C2F3              min_hl_de:
 393+ C2F3 E5                   push hl
 394+ C2F4 B7                   or a
 395+ C2F5 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 396+ C2F7 E1                   pop hl
 397+ C2F8 D8                   ret c
 398+ C2F9 EB                   ex de,hl
 399+ C2FA C9                   ret
 400+ C2FB
 401+ C2FB              max_hl_de:
 402+ C2FB E5                   push hl
 403+ C2FC B7                   or a
 404+ C2FD ED 52                sbc hl,de
 405+ C2FF E1                   pop hl
 406+ C300 D0                   ret nc
 407+ C301 EB                   ex de,hl
 408+ C302 C9                   ret
 409+ C303
 410+ C303              ; Returns NZ if the VTOL hits a building: its footprint (10 m x 3 m, turned
 411+ C303              ; to the heading; vtol_ground) is over a roof less than COLL_H below it.
 412+ C303              check_collision:
 413+ C303 CD 4F AD             call vtol_ground                ; HL = highest ground under it
 414+ C306 C8                   ret z                           ; all road
 415+ C307 11 0C 00             ld de,COLL_H
 416+ C30A 19                   add hl,de
 417+ C30B ED 5B 99 AF          ld de,(cam_y)
 418+ C30F B7                   or a
 419+ C310 ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; height+M - camY
 420+ C312 38 05                jr c,.no
 421+ C314 28 03                jr z,.no
 422+ C316 F6 01                or 1                            ; NZ: collision
 423+ C318 C9                   ret
 424+ C319 AF           .no:    xor a
 425+ C31A C9                   ret
 426+ C31B
 427+ C31B              ; The VTOL has been destroyed (vtol_dead): the controls do nothing.  It
 428+ C31B              ; spins DEAD_SPIN a frame and falls, a unit a frame faster each frame (up
 429+ C31B              ; to DEAD_FALL_MAX), until it hits the ground under it (floor_y: the road,
 430+ C31B              ; or the highest roof under its footprint).  Once down it lies still for
 431+ C31B              ; DEAD_PAUSE frames, then sets game_over (main_loop: the GAME OVER screen,
 432+ C31B              ; then the main menu).
 433+ C31B              vtol_wreck:
 434+ C31B AF                   xor a
 435+ C31C 32 9F AF             ld (speed),a
 436+ C31F 3A B2 AF             ld a,(dead_down)
 437+ C322 B7                   or a
 438+ C323 20 39                jr nz,.down
 439+ C325 2A 9B AF             ld hl,(yaw_frac)                ; spin
 440+ C328 11 00 08             ld de,DEAD_SPIN
 441+ C32B 19                   add hl,de
 442+ C32C 22 9B AF             ld (yaw_frac),hl
 443+ C32F 3A B3 AF             ld a,(dead_vy)                  ; fall, faster each frame
 444+ C332 FE 08                cp DEAD_FALL_MAX
 445+ C334 30 04                jr nc,.vy
 446+ C336 3C                   inc a
 447+ C337 32 B3 AF             ld (dead_vy),a
 448+ C33A 5F           .vy:    ld e,a
 449+ C33B 16 00                ld d,0
 450+ C33D 2A 99 AF             ld hl,(cam_y)
 451+ C340 B7                   or a
 452+ C341 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 453+ C343 30 03                jr nc,.y
 454+ C345 21 00 00             ld hl,0

 475+ C369              ; One damping step: move the signed 8.8 pitch (pitch_frac/pitch) towards 0
 476+ C369              ; by max(PDAMP_MIN, |whole pitch| * PDAMP_K), stopping exactly at 0.
 477+ C369              ; Calculated rather than looked up: the Z80N MUL makes it as quick as a
 478+ C369              ; table, and the curve stays editable through the two equates.
 479+ C369              pitch_damp:
 480+ C369 2A 9D AF             ld hl,(pitch_frac)
 481+ C36C 7C                   ld a,h
 482+ C36D B5                   or l
 483+ C36E C8                   ret z                           ; already level
 484+ C36F 7C                   ld a,h
 485+ C370 F5                   push af                         ; sign
 486+ C371 CD 55 AF             call abs_hl

 488+ C375 1E 00                ld e,PDAMP_K
 489+ C377 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; DE = step

 491+ C37A B7                   or a
 492+ C37B 20 08                jr nz,.sub
 493+ C37D 7B                   ld a,e
 494+ C37E FE 80                cp PDAMP_MIN
 495+ C380 30 03                jr nc,.sub
 496+ C382 11 80 00             ld de,PDAMP_MIN

 498+ C386 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 499+ C388 30 03                jr nc,.sgn

 501+ C38D F1           .sgn:   pop af

 503+ C38F DC 4E AF             call c,neg_hl
 504+ C392 22 9D AF             ld (pitch_frac),hl

# file opened: weapons.asm
   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - weapons page (8K page PAGE_WEAPONS, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Player weapons.  Paged in by main_loop with nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_WEAPONS
   5+ C000              ; (the keys page in slot 7) after
   6+ C000              ; the frame is set up (it uses sin_y/cos_y/sin_p/cos_p) and the zombies have
   7+ C000              ; moved.  Bullet state lives in the resident `bullets` table so that the city
   8+ C000              ; page can draw the tracers (draw_bullets).
   9+ C000              ;
  10+ C000              ; Keys 1-5 select the weapon slot that SPACE fires (wpn_sel: 1 = the centre
  11+ C000              ; slot, 2-5 = the wing pylons).  An empty slot isn't selected: the HUD
  12+ C000              ; flashes it instead (wflash_slot / wflash_t).  What is fitted where is set
  13+ C000              ; on the load-out screen between levels (loadout.asm).
  14+ C000              ;
  15+ C000              ; Machine gun (WPN_GUN, the centre slot): hold SPACE to fire one round every
  16+ C000              ; GUN_INTERVAL frames.  Rounds leave the ship's centre line 0.5 m below the
  17+ C000              ; camera and fly straight along the view direction at 500 m/s until they hit
  18+ C000              ; something.
  19+ C000              ;
  20+ C000              ; Collision, every frame for every round in flight: the path from its last
  21+ C000              ; position to its new one (BULLET_STEP long) is walked cell by cell through
  22+ C000              ; the city grid, in order (a 2D DDA on the horizontal distance s along the
  23+ C000              ; path).  The first thing met ends the path:
  24+ C000              ;   * a building cell: hit where the path enters the cell if it is below the
  25+ C000              ;     roof there (a wall), otherwise where it drops below the roof (the roof);
  26+ C000              ;   * a street cell marked as holding zombies (CELL_ZOMBIE): those in it, each a box
  27+ C000              ;     0.5 m wide and 2 m tall, nearest along the path first;
  28+ C000              ;   * the ground, where the path reaches height 0;
  29+ C000              ;   * leaving the GRID x GRID map: the round is gone.
  30+ C000              ; A round that hits is drawn once at the impact point, then freed.  A zombie
  31+ C000              ; that is hit loses B_DMG hit points; at 0 it is killed (its map blip
  32+ C000              ; removed, its record made inactive).  A rocket also bursts (rocket_blast).
  33+ C000              ;
  34+ C000              ; Rocket pod (WPN_ROCKETS, a wing pylon, ROCKET_SHOTS rockets): rockets are
  35+ C000              ; rounds too (B_KIND = BK_ROCKET), at 150 m/s and drawn as a short white
  36+ C000              ; streak with a yellow trail.  Wherever one stops (a building, the ground,
  37+ C000              ; a zombie) rocket_blast does BLAST_DMG to every zombie, human and base tile
  38+ C000              ; within BLAST_R on each axis, and sprays BLAST_PARTS orange particles.
  39+ C000              ;
  40+ C000              ; Autocannon (WPN_AUTOCANNON, a wing pylon, AUTOCANNON_SHOTS shells): the
  41+ C000              ; machine gun's rounds (B_KIND = BK_AUTOCANNON, drawn as tracers) one every
  42+ C000              ; AUTOCANNON_INTERVAL frames; each bursts where it stops: AUTOCANNON_DMG
  43+ C000              ; within AUTOCANNON_R (3 m) on each axis, AUTOCANNON_PARTS particles.
  44+ C000              ;
  45+ C000              ; Proximity cannon (WPN_PROX, a wing pylon, PROX_SHOTS shells): the
  46+ C000              ; autocannon (B_KIND = BK_PROX), its shells also bursting when they pass within
  47+ C000              ; PROX_R (2 m) of a monster (b_pr widens the monster hit boxes,
  48+ C000              ; cell_zombies); the burst does PROX_DMG within PROX_R on each axis.
  49+ C000              ;
  50+ C000              ; Missile pod (WPN_MISSILE, a wing pylon, MISSILE_SHOTS missiles): as the
  51+ C000              ; rockets (B_KIND = BK_MISSILE, drawn the same) at half the speed; the burst
  52+ C000              ; does MISSILE_DMG within MISSILE_R (1.0 tile) on each axis, and sprays
  53+ C000              ; MISSILE_PARTS particles.  Guided: one fires only with a target locked
  54+ C000              ; (lock_update: the reticule), and turns towards it (msl_steer) at
  55+ C000              ; MISSILE_TURN a frame until it is more than LOCK_RANGE away.
  56+ C000              ;
  57+ C000              ; Damage: each round carries its damage (B_DMG): machine gun GUN_DMG, chain
  58+ C000              ; gun CHAIN_DMG, the laser LASER_DMG a beam frame, a rocket none directly
  59+ C000              ; (only its blast).  A zombie dies when its hit points (+18) run out.
  60+ C000              ;
  61+ C000              ; Positions are world units (1 tile = 20 m = 256 units, 1 m = 12.8).  Along the path,
  62+ C000              ; x = x0 + s*sinY, z = z0 + s*cosY and y = y0 + s*slope, with sinY/cosY the
  63+ C000              ; S7.8 heading at firing and slope = tan(pitch) in S7.8.
  64+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  65+ C000

 346+ C257 DD 75 05             ld (ix+B_Z),l
 347+ C25A DD 74 06             ld (ix+B_Z+1),h
 348+ C25D DD 75 13             ld (ix+B_PZ),l
 349+ C260 DD 74 14             ld (ix+B_PZ+1),h
 350+ C263 C9                   ret
 351+ C264
 352+ C264              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 353+ C264              ; The missile lock, each frame in flight.  With the missile pod selected the
 354+ C264              ; reticule is shown (ret_on).  Searching (lock_state 0), it wanders the view.
 355+ C264              ; A monster drawn last frame (fig_seen: +31) within LOCK_RANGE of the VTOL
 356+ C264              ; along x and z, the nearest, becomes the target (lock_tgt): locking (1),
 357+ C264              ; the reticule moves to where it was drawn (+32, +33) at RET_STEP pixels a
 358+ C264              ; frame, and after LOCK_TIME frames on it (within LOCK_NEAR) the target is
 359+ C264              ; locked (2): the lock tone, and the reticule stays on it.  The target lost
 360+ C264              ; (killed, out of view, out of range) it searches again.  Then the drawn
 361+ C264              ; marks are cleared for this frame's drawing.
 362+ C264              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 363+ C264              lock_update:
 364+ C264 CD 86 CB             call sel_slot
 365+ C267 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 366+ C268 FE 05                cp WPN_MISSILE
 367+ C26A C2 F7 C2             jp nz,lock_off
 368+ C26D 3E 01                ld a,1
 369+ C26F 32 19 B0             ld (ret_on),a
 370+ C272 3A 1D B0             ld a,(lock_tgt)
 371+ C275 FE FF                cp $FF
 372+ C277 28 0B                jr z,.find
 373+ C279 CD 27 C3             call lk_rec
 374+ C27C CD 33 C3             call lk_valid
 375+ C27F 30 1C                jr nc,.have
 376+ C281 CD 1A C3             call lk_lose                    ; the target lost
 377+ C284 CD 7D C3     .find:  call lk_nearest                 ; a new one?
 378+ C287 FE FF                cp $FF
 379+ C289 28 42                jr z,.wander
 380+ C28B 32 1D B0             ld (lock_tgt),a
 381+ C28E 3E 01                ld a,1
 382+ C290 32 1C B0             ld (lock_state),a
 383+ C293 AF                   xor a
 384+ C294 32 1E B0             ld (lock_t),a
 385+ C297 3A 1D B0             ld a,(lock_tgt)
 386+ C29A CD 27 C3             call lk_rec
 387+ C29D CD B9 C3     .have:  call lk_spot                    ; C, B = where it was drawn
 388+ C2A0 3A 1C B0             ld a,(lock_state)
 389+ C2A3 FE 02                cp 2

 392+ C2A8 32 1A B0             ld (ret_x),a
 393+ C2AB 78                   ld a,b
 394+ C2AC 32 1B B0             ld (ret_y),a
 395+ C2AF 18 57                jr lk_clear
 396+ C2B1 1E 04        .move:  ld e,RET_STEP
 397+ C2B3 CD DA C3             call ret_toward
 398+ C2B6 30 50                jr nc,lk_clear                  ; not on it yet
 399+ C2B8 21 1E B0             ld hl,lock_t
 400+ C2BB 34                   inc (hl)
 401+ C2BC 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 402+ C2BD FE 1C                cp LOCK_TIME

 404+ C2C1 3E 02                ld a,2                          ; locked
 405+ C2C3 32 1C B0             ld (lock_state),a
 406+ C2C6 3E 0D                ld a,SFX_LOCK
 407+ C2C8 32 69 3C             ld (sfx_req),a
 408+ C2CB 18 3B                jr lk_clear
 409+ C2CD              .wander:
 410+ C2CD 3A 1F B0             ld a,(wnd_x)
 411+ C2D0 4F                   ld c,a
 412+ C2D1 3A 20 B0             ld a,(wnd_y)
 413+ C2D4 47                   ld b,a
 414+ C2D5 1E 02                ld e,RET_WANDER
 415+ C2D7 CD DA C3             call ret_toward
 416+ C2DA 30 2C                jr nc,lk_clear
 417+ C2DC CD FB 26             call zrand                      ; there: somewhere new, within
 418+ C2DF 55                   ld d,l                          ; RET_WANDER_R of the view's centre
 419+ C2E0 1E 51                ld e,2*RET_WANDER_R+1
 420+ C2E2 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; D = 0..2*RET_WANDER_R
 421+ C2E4 7A                   ld a,d
 422+ C2E5 C6 58                add a,128-RET_WANDER_R
 423+ C2E7 32 1F B0             ld (wnd_x),a
 424+ C2EA 54                   ld d,h
 425+ C2EB 1E 51                ld e,2*RET_WANDER_R+1
 426+ C2ED ED 30                mul d,e
 427+ C2EF 7A                   ld a,d
 428+ C2F0 C6 18                add a,VIEW_CY-RET_WANDER_R
 429+ C2F2 32 20 B0             ld (wnd_y),a
 430+ C2F5 18 11                jr lk_clear
 431+ C2F7                      ASSERT VIEW_CY-RET_WANDER_R >= RET_HALF && VIEW_CY+RET_WANDER_R < VIEW_H-RET_HALF
 432+ C2F7
 433+ C2F7              ; No lock, no reticule (another weapon, landed, destroyed)
 434+ C2F7              lock_off:
 435+ C2F7 AF                   xor a
 436+ C2F8 32 19 B0             ld (ret_on),a
 437+ C2FB 3E 80                ld a,128                        ; next time from the centre
 438+ C2FD 32 1A B0             ld (ret_x),a
 439+ C300 3E 40                ld a,VIEW_CY
 440+ C302 32 1B B0             ld (ret_y),a
 441+ C305 CD 1A C3             call lk_lose
 442+ C308                      ; fall through
 443+ C308
 444+ C308              ; Clear every monster's drawn mark (+31)
 445+ C308              lk_clear:
 446+ C308 FD 21 FF 29          ld iy,zombies+31
 447+ C30C 06 30                ld b,NMON
 448+ C30E 11 22 00             ld de,ZREC
 449+ C311 FD 36 00 00  .lp:    ld (iy+0),0
 450+ C315 FD 19                add iy,de
 451+ C317 10 F8                djnz .lp
 452+ C319 C9                   ret
 453+ C31A
 454+ C31A              ; No target: searching
 455+ C31A              lk_lose:

 458+ C31F AF                   xor a
 459+ C320 32 1C B0             ld (lock_state),a
 460+ C323 32 1E B0             ld (lock_t),a
 461+ C326 C9                   ret
 462+ C327
 463+ C327              ; A = monster index -> IY = its record
 464+ C327              lk_rec:

 468+ C32C FD 21 E0 29          ld iy,zombies
 469+ C330 FD 19                add iy,de
 470+ C332 C9                   ret

 472+ C333              ; Monster IY: a target?  In play, not fading out, drawn last frame, and
 473+ C333              ; within LOCK_RANGE of the VTOL along x and z.  Carry set if not; else HL =
 474+ C333              ; the larger distance (x or z).

 477+ C337 37                   scf
 478+ C338 C8                   ret z                           ; not seen
 479+ C339                      ; fall through

 494+ C34E 2A 97 AF             ld hl,(cam_z+1)
 495+ C351 CD 66 C3             call lk_dist2
 496+ C354 D1                   pop de
 497+ C355 D8                   ret c
 498+ C356 B7                   or a                            ; the larger
 499+ C357 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 500+ C359 19                   add hl,de
 501+ C35A D0                   ret nc
 502+ C35B EB                   ex de,hl
 503+ C35C B7                   or a
 504+ C35D C9                   ret
 505+ C35E
 506+ C35E              ; HL = a point's x: HL = |x - monster IY's x|, carry set if over LOCK_RANGE
 507+ C35E              lk_dist:
 508+ C35E FD 5E 00             ld e,(iy+0)
 509+ C361 FD 56 01             ld d,(iy+1)
 510+ C364 18 06                jr lk_d
 511+ C366              lk_dist2:                               ; (z)
 512+ C366 FD 5E 02             ld e,(iy+2)
 513+ C369 FD 56 03             ld d,(iy+3)

 518+ C375 B7                   or a
 519+ C376 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 520+ C378 3F                   ccf
 521+ C379 D8                   ret c                           ; too far
 522+ C37A 19                   add hl,de
 523+ C37B B7                   or a
 524+ C37C C9                   ret
 525+ C37D
 526+ C37D              ; The nearest target (lk_valid): A = its index, $FF if none
 527+ C37D              lk_nearest:
 528+ C37D 3E FF                ld a,$FF

 531+ C385 22 64 D5             ld (ln_dist),hl
 532+ C388 FD 21 E0 29          ld iy,zombies
 533+ C38C AF                   xor a

 535+ C390 CD 33 C3             call lk_valid
 536+ C393 38 13                jr c,.nx

 538+ C399 B7                   or a

 541+ C39E 19                   add hl,de
 542+ C39F 22 64 D5             ld (ln_dist),hl

 544+ C3A5 32 63 D5             ld (ln_best),a

 551+ C3B5 3A 63 D5             ld a,(ln_best)

 553+ C3B9
 554+ C3B9              ; Monster IY -> C, B = where it was drawn (+32, +33), kept so the reticule
 555+ C3B9              ; stays in the view
 556+ C3B9              lk_spot:
 557+ C3B9 FD 7E 20             ld a,(iy+32)
 558+ C3BC FE 06                cp RET_HALF
 559+ C3BE 30 02                jr nc,.x1
 560+ C3C0 3E 06                ld a,RET_HALF
 561+ C3C2 FE FA        .x1:    cp 256-RET_HALF
 562+ C3C4 38 02                jr c,.x2

 564+ C3C8 4F           .x2:    ld c,a
 565+ C3C9 FD 7E 21             ld a,(iy+33)
 566+ C3CC FE 06                cp RET_HALF

 568+ C3D0 3E 06                ld a,RET_HALF
 569+ C3D2 FE 7A        .y1:    cp VIEW_H-RET_HALF

 572+ C3D8 47           .y2:    ld b,a
 573+ C3D9 C9                   ret
 574+ C3DA
 575+ C3DA              ; Move the reticule towards (C, B) by up to E pixels on each axis: carry
 576+ C3DA              ; set if it is then within LOCK_NEAR of it on both.  Keeps B, C.
 577+ C3DA              ret_toward:

 579+ C3DD 79                   ld a,c
 580+ C3DE CD FE C3             call .ax
 581+ C3E1 21 1B B0             ld hl,ret_y

 583+ C3E5 CD FE C3             call .ax

 587+ C3EE ED 44                neg
 588+ C3F0 FE 04        .p1:    cp LOCK_NEAR+1

 592+ C3F7 30 02                jr nc,.p2

 594+ C3FB FE 04        .p2:    cp LOCK_NEAR+1
 595+ C3FD C9                   ret
 596+ C3FE 96           .ax:    sub (hl)                        ; A = the way to go
 597+ C3FF C8                   ret z
 598+ C400 38 07                jr c,.dn
 599+ C402 BB                   cp e
 600+ C403 38 01                jr c,.up
 601+ C405 7B                   ld a,e
 602+ C406 86           .up:    add a,(hl)
 603+ C407 77                   ld (hl),a
 604+ C408 C9                   ret

 606+ C40B BB                   cp e

 610+ C410 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 611+ C411 92                   sub d
 612+ C412 77                   ld (hl),a
 613+ C413 C9                   ret

 615+ C414              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 616+ C414              ; Missile IX, before its step: turn towards its target (B_TGT) by up to
 617+ C414              ; MISSILE_TURN sideways (B_YAW) and up or down (B_PIT), aiming at its middle
 618+ C414              ; (MSL_AIM_Y above its feet).  The target gone (killed, fading out) or more
 619+ C414              ; than LOCK_RANGE from the missile along x or z: no more tracking, it flies
 620+ C414              ; straight on.  When the turn changes its heading or climb (their high
 621+ C414              ; bytes), its direction is worked out again (B_SIN, B_COS, B_S, B_SLOPE,
 622+ C414              ; and the cell spans afresh).
 623+ C414              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 624+ C414              msl_steer:

 626+ C417 FE FF                cp $FF

 633+ C429 CA E4 C4             jp z,.lost

 635+ C42F DD 66 02             ld h,(ix+B_X+1)

 638+ C438 DD 6E 05             ld l,(ix+B_Z)

 643+ C447 FD 66 01             ld h,(iy+1)

 645+ C44D DD 56 02             ld d,(ix+B_X+1)
 646+ C450 B7                   or a
 647+ C451 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 648+ C453 22 67 D5             ld (ms_dx),hl
 649+ C456 FD 6E 02             ld l,(iy+2)
 650+ C459 FD 66 03             ld h,(iy+3)
 651+ C45C DD 5E 05             ld e,(ix+B_Z)
 652+ C45F DD 56 06             ld d,(ix+B_Z+1)
 653+ C462 B7                   or a
 654+ C463 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 655+ C465 22 69 D5             ld (ms_dz),hl
 656+ C468 EB                   ex de,hl
 657+ C469 2A 67 D5             ld hl,(ms_dx)
 658+ C46C CD CC C5             call atan2                      ; the heading to it
 659+ C46F 4F                   ld c,a

 661+ C471 32 6F D5             ld (ms_chg),a

 663+ C475 21 1C 00             ld hl,B_YAW
 664+ C478 CD 82 C5             call ms_turn
 665+ C47B 2A 67 D5             ld hl,(ms_dx)                   ; horizontal distance: max + 3/8 min
 666+ C47E CD 55 AF             call abs_hl
 667+ C481 E5                   push hl
 668+ C482 2A 69 D5             ld hl,(ms_dz)
 669+ C485 CD 55 AF             call abs_hl

 671+ C489 B7                   or a

 673+ C48C 19                   add hl,de

 675+ C48F EB                   ex de,hl                        ; HL = max, DE = min
 676+ C490 E5           .mx:    push hl
 677+ C491 EB                   ex de,hl
 678+ C492 54                   ld d,h
 679+ C493 5D                   ld e,l
 680+ C494 29                   add hl,hl
 681+ C495 19                   add hl,de

 683+ C498 CB 1D                rr l
 684+ C49A CB 3C                srl h
 685+ C49C CB 1D                rr l
 686+ C49E CB 3C                srl h

 689+ C4A3 19                   add hl,de

 718+ C4E8 C9                   ret

 720+ C4E9              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 721+ C4E9              ; Bomb (WPN_BOMB, the selected slot's): gun_fire jumps here.  One bomb,
 722+ C4E9              ; released straight ahead at the VTOL's speed + BOMB_SPEED (at least 1 unit
 723+ C4E9              ; a frame), gliding down from BOMB_ANGLE, steeper every BOMB_STEEPEN frames
 724+ C4E9              ; (bomb_steer), to the ground or whatever it hits first.
 725+ C4E9              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 726+ C4E9              bomb_drop:

 728+ C4EC D8                   ret c

 747+ C512 3A 9B AF             ld a,(yaw_frac)                 ; its heading: the view's,

 750+ C51B DD 77 1D             ld (ix+B_YAW+1),a

 752+ C522 DD 36 1F F9          ld (ix+B_PIT+1),-BOMB_ANGLE & $FF   ; gliding down

 755+ C52B 32 69 3C             ld (sfx_req),a

 757+ C52F                      ASSERT BOOST_SPEED+BOMB_SPEED < 128 ; (a signed byte, and B_TGT's)
 758+ C52F                      ASSERT SPEED_MAX <= BOOST_SPEED
 759+ C52F
 760+ C52F                      ASSERT BOMB_ANGLE < MSL_PITCH_MAX && BOMB_STEEPEN > 0
 761+ C52F
 762+ C52F              ; Bomb IX, before its step: every BOMB_STEEPEN frames (B_PIT's low byte
 763+ C52F              ; counts them down) its climb one angle step steeper (B_PIT's high byte),
 764+ C52F              ; to -MSL_PITCH_MAX, and its direction afresh
 765+ C52F              bomb_steer:
 766+ C52F DD 35 1E             dec (ix+B_PIT)
 767+ C532 C0                   ret nz
 768+ C533 DD 36 1E 05          ld (ix+B_PIT),BOMB_STEEPEN
 769+ C537 DD 7E 1F             ld a,(ix+B_PIT+1)
 770+ C53A FE C8                cp -MSL_PITCH_MAX & $FF
 771+ C53C C8                   ret z                           ; as steep as it goes
 772+ C53D DD 35 1F             dec (ix+B_PIT+1)
 773+ C540 DD 6E 1B             ld l,(ix+B_TGT)                 ; its length a frame
 774+ C543 26 00                ld h,0
 775+ C545 C3 48 C5             jp rnd_dir
 776+ C548
 777+ C548              ; Round IX's direction from its heading and climb (the high bytes of B_YAW,
 778+ C548              ; B_PIT), HL = its length along its path a frame: B_SIN, B_COS, B_S,
 779+ C548              ; B_SLOPE, and its cell spans afresh.  (A missile turning, a bomb diving.)
 780+ C548              rnd_dir:
 781+ C548 22 E9 D4             ld (sr_len),hl
 782+ C54B DD 7E 1D             ld a,(ix+B_YAW+1)               ; its new direction
 783+ C54E F5                   push af
 784+ C54F CD A3 AE             call get_sin
 785+ C552 DD 75 07             ld (ix+B_SIN),l
 786+ C555 DD 74 08             ld (ix+B_SIN+1),h
 787+ C558 F1                   pop af
 788+ C559 C6 40                add a,64

1177+ C839              ; A lich's fireballs, every frame (not with the VTOL a wreck).  A lich with
1178+ C839              ; its reload done (LICH_WAIT 0) and the VTOL within FB_RANGE fires at where
1179+ C839              ; the VTOL will be: from its velocity (its move last frame, sideways and up
1180+ C839              ; or down too) and the flight time at FB_MS, worked out twice over.  The
1181+ C839              ; aim is then turned by up to FB_DEV each way (round_spread).  A
1182+ C839              ; fireball is a round (BK_FIREBALL, in its own records: the player's guns
1183+ C839              ; can't use them up) that passes through monsters and stops at a building,
1184+ C839              ; the ground, the VTOL (within FB_HIT_R: fb_step) or after FB_FRAMES frames
1185+ C839              ; (FB_RANGE).  Wherever it stops it bursts (rocket_blast): FB_DMG within

1639+ CB9E C9                   ret
1640+ CB9F 3A E0 D4     .pad:   ld a,(svc_on)
1641+ CBA2 B7                   or a
1642+ CBA3 20 13                jr nz,.go
1643+ CBA5 3C                   inc a                           ; just landed: start the counts
1644+ CBA6 32 E0 D4             ld (svc_on),a
1645+ CBA9 3E 05                ld a,REPAIR_FRAMES
1646+ CBAB 32 E1 D4             ld (svc_rep),a
1647+ CBAE 21 E2 D4             ld hl,svc_rel
1648+ CBB1 06 05                ld b,WPN_SLOTS
1649+ CBB3 36 00        .cl:    ld (hl),0                       ; (0: its interval starts next)
1650+ CBB5 23                   inc hl
1651+ CBB6 10 FB                djnz .cl
1652+ CBB8 3A 3C B0     .go:    ld a,(boost_fitted)             ; the booster: refuelled 1 a frame
1653+ CBBB B7                   or a
1654+ CBBC 28 0B                jr z,.nf
1655+ CBBE 3A 3D B0             ld a,(boost_fuel)
1656+ CBC1 FE C8                cp BOOST_FUEL_MAX
1657+ CBC3 30 04                jr nc,.nf
1658+ CBC5 3C                   inc a
1659+ CBC6 32 3D B0             ld (boost_fuel),a
1660+ CBC9 21 E1 D4     .nf:    ld hl,svc_rep                   ; repair
1661+ CBCC 35                   dec (hl)
1662+ CBCD 20 0D                jr nz,.rl
1663+ CBCF 36 05                ld (hl),REPAIR_FRAMES
1664+ CBD1 3A B0 AF             ld a,(vtol_hp)
1665+ CBD4 FE 32                cp VTOL_HP
1666+ CBD6 30 04                jr nc,.rl                       ; (undamaged)
1667+ CBD8 3C                   inc a
1668+ CBD9 32 B0 AF             ld (vtol_hp),a
1669+ CBDC DD 21 A0 AF  .rl:    ld ix,wpn_slots                 ; reload, slot by slot
1670+ CBE0 21 E2 D4             ld hl,svc_rel
1671+ CBE3 06 05                ld b,WPN_SLOTS
1672+ CBE5 C5           .sl:    push bc
1673+ CBE6 DD 7E 00             ld a,(ix+WPN_TYPE)
1674+ CBE9 E5                   push hl
1675+ CBEA CD 12 AB             call wpn_cfg_ptr                ; (resident)
1676+ CBED 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1677+ CBEE 4F                   ld c,a                          ; C = its full load (WCFG_LOAD)
1678+ CBEF 23                   inc hl
1679+ CBF0 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; frames a shot (WCFG_RELOAD)
1680+ CBF1 E1                   pop hl
1681+ CBF2 B7                   or a
1682+ CBF3 28 16                jr z,.nx                        ; doesn't reload (or an empty slot)
1683+ CBF5 47                   ld b,a                          ; B = frames a shot
1684+ CBF6 DD 7E 01             ld a,(ix+WPN_AMMO)
1685+ CBF9 B9                   cp c
1686+ CBFA 30 0D                jr nc,.full
1687+ CBFC 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1688+ CBFD B7                   or a
1689+ CBFE 20 01                jr nz,.cnt

1691+ CC01 35           .cnt:   dec (hl)
1692+ CC02 20 07                jr nz,.nx
1693+ CC04 DD 34 01             inc (ix+WPN_AMMO)               ; one more shot
1694+ CC07 18 02                jr .nx
1695+ CC09 36 00        .full:  ld (hl),0
1696+ CC0B 23           .nx:    inc hl
1697+ CC0C DD 23                inc ix
1698+ CC0E DD 23                inc ix
1699+ CC10 C1                   pop bc
1700+ CC11 10 D2                djnz .sl
1701+ CC13 C9                   ret
1702+ CC14
1703+ CC14              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1704+ CC14              ; Pulse laser: SPACE held with the laser in the centre slot fires a beam for
1705+ CC14              ; LASER_ON frames, then it cools for LASER_COOL frames.  Each beam frame the
1706+ CC14              ; beam is traced from the muzzle along the current view direction (the round
1707+ CC14              ; walk, LASER_RANGE long) to the first building, ground or zombie, killing a
1708+ CC14              ; zombie it reaches.  It is kept in laser_rec as a round (state 3) whose
1709+ CC14              ; path runs from the muzzle to where the beam stops; draw_bullets clips it
1710+ CC14              ; to the view, so it rises from the bottom edge of the screen.
1711+ CC14              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1712+ CC14              laser_update:
1713+ CC14 3A E7 D4             ld a,(las_on)
1714+ CC17 B7                   or a
1715+ CC18 20 25                jr nz,.beam
1716+ CC1A 32 A8 B3             ld (laser_rec+B_STATE),a        ; no beam this frame
1717+ CC1D 3A E8 D4             ld a,(las_cool)
1718+ CC20 B7                   or a
1719+ CC21 28 05                jr z,.ready
1720+ CC23 3D                   dec a                           ; cooling down
1721+ CC24 32 E8 D4             ld (las_cool),a
1722+ CC27 C9                   ret
1723+ CC28 CD 86 CB     .ready: call sel_slot
1724+ CC2B 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1725+ CC2C FE 02                cp WPN_LASER
1726+ CC2E C0                   ret nz
1727+ CC2F 3E 09                ld a,K_FIRE
1728+ CC31 CD BE E0             call key_held
1729+ CC34 C8                   ret z
1730+ CC35 3E 03                ld a,LASER_ON
1731+ CC37 32 E7 D4             ld (las_on),a
1732+ CC3A 3E 02                ld a,SFX_LASER                  ; a new pulse: its zap
1733+ CC3C 32 69 3C             ld (sfx_req),a
1734+ CC3F 21 E7 D4     .beam:  ld hl,las_on
1735+ CC42 35                   dec (hl)
1736+ CC43 20 05                jr nz,.on
1737+ CC45 3E 08                ld a,LASER_COOL                 ; last beam frame: cool down next
1738+ CC47 32 E8 D4             ld (las_cool),a
1739+ CC4A DD 21 A8 B3  .on:    ld ix,laser_rec
1740+ CC4E 21 00 06             ld hl,LASER_RANGE
1741+ CC51 CD B1 C6             call spawn_round                ; (start of path = the muzzle)
1742+ CC54 DD 36 19 01          ld (ix+B_DMG),LASER_DMG         ; per beam frame on a target
1743+ CC58 CD A3 CD             call bullet_step                ; trace it to the first thing it meets
1744+ CC5B DD 7E 00             ld a,(ix+B_STATE)
1745+ CC5E B7                   or a
1746+ CC5F C8                   ret z                           ; off the map (can't, inside the wall)
1747+ CC60 DD 36 00 03          ld (ix+B_STATE),3               ; beam
1748+ CC64 C9                   ret
1749+ CC65
1750+ CC65              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1751+ CC65              ; Particles (pool `particles`, drawn by draw_particles): zombie bursts and
1752+ CC65              ; rocket / missile bursts
1753+ CC65              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1754+ CC65              ; IX = a zombie just killed: spray NPART_BURST green particles from its body
1755+ CC65              ; (PART_Y up), each with a random velocity: sideways -4..3 units a frame in
1756+ CC65              ; x and z, upwards 2..5
1757+ CC65              part_burst:
1758+ CC65 DD 6E 00             ld l,(ix+0)
1759+ CC68 DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
1760+ CC6B 22 51 D5             ld (ps_x),hl
1761+ CC6E 21 0D 00             ld hl,PART_Y
1762+ CC71 22 53 D5             ld (ps_y),hl
1763+ CC74 DD 6E 02             ld l,(ix+2)
1764+ CC77 DD 66 03             ld h,(ix+3)
1765+ CC7A 22 55 D5             ld (ps_z),hl
1766+ CC7D 21 3B 08             ld hl,PART_COL0 | PART_LIFE<<8
1767+ CC80 22 57 D5             ld (ps_col),hl                  ; (and ps_life)
1768+ CC83 AF                   xor a
1769+ CC84 32 59 D5             ld (ps_fire),a
1770+ CC87 0E 0A                ld c,NPART_BURST
1771+ CC89 18 21                jr part_spray
1772+ CC8B
1773+ CC8B              ; A rocket or missile burst at rb_x/y/z: rb_parts orange particles for
1774+ CC8B              ; FIRE_LIFE frames, flying out faster than a zombie's (x and z -8..7 units
1775+ CC8B              ; a frame, y -2..5)
1776+ CC8B              fire_burst:
1777+ CC8B 2A 5A D5             ld hl,(rb_x)
1778+ CC8E 22 51 D5             ld (ps_x),hl
1779+ CC91 2A 5C D5             ld hl,(rb_y)
1780+ CC94 22 53 D5             ld (ps_y),hl

1784+ CCA0 22 57 D5             ld (ps_col),hl
1785+ CCA3 3E 01                ld a,1
1786+ CCA5 32 59 D5             ld (ps_fire),a
1787+ CCA8 3A 50 D5             ld a,(rb_parts)
1788+ CCAB 4F                   ld c,a
1789+ CCAC                      ; fall through
1790+ CCAC
1791+ CCAC              ; Spray C particles from ps_x/y/z, colour ps_col (age 1), lasting ps_life
1792+ CCAC              ; frames, velocities by ps_fire.  Uses free particles only; if the pool
1793+ CCAC              ; runs out, fewer.  Preserves IX.

1799+ CCB7 B7                   or a

1803+ CCC1 FD 75 01             ld (iy+1),l
1804+ CCC4 FD 74 02             ld (iy+2),h
1805+ CCC7 2A 53 D5             ld hl,(ps_y)
1806+ CCCA FD 75 03             ld (iy+3),l
1807+ CCCD FD 74 04             ld (iy+4),h

1810+ CCD6 FD 74 06             ld (iy+6),h

1813+ CCDF FD 74 0B             ld (iy+11),h

1816+ CCE6 3A 59 D5             ld a,(ps_fire)
1817+ CCE9 B7                   or a

1820+ CCED E6 07                and 7
1821+ CCEF D6 04                sub 4
1822+ CCF1 FD 77 07             ld (iy+7),a                     ; vx -4..3
1823+ CCF4 7C                   ld a,h
1824+ CCF5 E6 07                and 7

1826+ CCF9 FD 77 09             ld (iy+9),a                     ; vz -4..3

1829+ CCFE 0F                   rrca
1830+ CCFF 0F                   rrca

1833+ CD03 C6 02                add a,2
1834+ CD05 FD 77 08             ld (iy+8),a                     ; vy 2..5 (up)
1835+ CD08 18 1C                jr .v
1836+ CD0A 7D           .fire:  ld a,l
1837+ CD0B E6 0F                and 15
1838+ CD0D D6 08                sub 8
1839+ CD0F FD 77 07             ld (iy+7),a                     ; vx -8..7
1840+ CD12 7C                   ld a,h
1841+ CD13 E6 0F                and 15
1842+ CD15 D6 08                sub 8
1843+ CD17 FD 77 09             ld (iy+9),a                     ; vz -8..7
1844+ CD1A 7D                   ld a,l
1845+ CD1B 0F                   rrca
1846+ CD1C 0F                   rrca
1847+ CD1D 0F                   rrca
1848+ CD1E 0F                   rrca
1849+ CD1F E6 07                and 7

1857+ CD2F 10 83                djnz .lp
1858+ CD31 FD E1        .done:  pop iy
1859+ CD33 C9                   ret
1860+ CD34
1861+ CD34              ; Age every particle; past its life (+11) it is freed.  Move the rest by
1862+ CD34              ; their velocity, with gravity, stopping on the ground.
1863+ CD34              part_update:

   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - main menu (8K page PAGE_MENU, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Shown after start-up.  Layer 2 is hidden and the menu is drawn on the ULA
   5+ C000              ; screen with opaque paper.  Every frame it advances the random number
   6+ C000              ; generator (zrand), so the game doesn't start from the same seed each time
   7+ C000              ; (the wait for a key press varies), then reads the keys:
   8+ C000              ;   1  New game   -> newGame (zpolice.asm): level 1
   9+ C000              ;   2  Continue   -> the save game (made by save and quit, from the pause:
  10+ C000              ;                 game_pause), its level at its wave (load_save,
  11+ C000              ;                 continue_game, zpolice.asm); NO SAVED GAME if there's none
  12+ C000              ;   9  Redefine keys -> keydef_screen (keydef.asm)
  13+ C000              ; game_over_screen (the landing pad destroyed) shows GAME OVER until SPACE
  14+ C000              ; is pressed, then returns here.
  15+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  16+ C000
  17+ C000
  18+ C000              main_menu:
  19+ C000 ED 91 57 0C          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INPUT     ; the input page at $E000 (this page: $C000)
  20+ C004 CD CC A0             call menu_clear
  21+ C007 21 6F C5             ld hl,menu_text                 ; title and options
  22+ C00A 7E           .txt:   ld a,(hl)
  23+ C00B FE FF                cp $FF
  24+ C00D 28 0B                jr z,.loop
  25+ C00F 57                   ld d,a                          ; row
  26+ C010 23                   inc hl
  27+ C011 5E                   ld e,(hl)                       ; column
  28+ C012 23                   inc hl
  29+ C013 4E                   ld c,(hl)                       ; attribute
  30+ C014 23                   inc hl
  31+ C015 CD FC A0             call menu_print                 ; HL -> the text, past it after
  32+ C018 18 F0                jr .txt
  33+ C01A CD 46 A1     .loop:  call menu_frame                 ; one video frame
  34+ C01D CD FB 26             call zrand                      ; stir the random number generator
  35+ C020 CD 00 E0             call kbd_scan
  36+ C023 21 01 03             ld hl,KB_1
  37+ C026 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
  38+ C029 C2 69 A8             jp nz,newGame
  39+ C02C 21 02 04             ld hl,KB_9                      ; redefine keys
  40+ C02F CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
  41+ C032 C2 30 AB             jp nz,keydef_go                 ; (zpolice.asm)
  42+ C035 21 02 03             ld hl,KB_2                      ; continue the save game
  43+ C038 CD F1 E0             call key_code_pressed
  44+ C03B 28 DD                jr z,.loop
  45+ C03D CD 9C AC             call load_save                  ; (zpolice.asm; pages the file
  46+ C040 D2 D8 AC             jp nc,continue_game             ; handler in)
  47+ C043 ED 91 57 0C          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INPUT     ; none (or not usable): say so
  48+ C047 11 09 12             ld de,18<<8 | 9
  49+ C04A 0E 0B                ld c,MENU_BAD
  50+ C04C 21 B9 C5             ld hl,txt_no_save
  51+ C04F CD FC A0             call menu_print
  52+ C052 18 C6                jr .loop
  53+ C054
  54+ C054              ; The game is over: GAME OVER until SPACE is pressed, then the main menu
  55+ C054              game_over_screen:
  56+ C054 31 C5 B7             ld sp,stack_top
  57+ C057 CD CC A0             call menu_clear
  58+ C05A 16 0B                ld d,11
  59+ C05C 1E 0B                ld e,11
  60+ C05E 0E 0A                ld c,MENU_TITLE
  61+ C060 21 6C C0             ld hl,txt_game_over
  62+ C063 CD FC A0             call menu_print
  63+ C066 CD 76 C0             call space_prompt
  64+ C069 C3 00 C0             jp main_menu

  69+ C076              ; "PRESS SPACE TO CONTINUE", and wait until SPACE is pressed (newly: one held
  70+ C076              ; down for firing as the screen came up doesn't count)
  71+ C076              LD_PROMPT_ROW   equ 23              ; (under the reward lines,
  72+ C076                                                  ; SA_ROW0..SA_ROW_MAX)
  73+ C076              space_prompt:
  74+ C076 11 04 17             ld de,LD_PROMPT_ROW<<8 | 4
  75+ C079 0E 0F                ld c,MENU_ATTR
  76+ C07B 21 01 C1             ld hl,txt_continue
  77+ C07E CD FC A0             call menu_print
  78+ C081 CD 46 A1     .w:     call menu_frame
  79+ C084 CD FB 26             call zrand                      ; (keep stirring the seed)
  80+ C087 CD 00 E0             call kbd_scan                   ; (the input page: menu_clear)
  81+ C08A 21 01 07             ld hl,KB_SPACE

 143+ C119              ; End of a level: every slot's weapon gets its full load again (wpn_cfg,

 163+ C13B              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 164+ C13B              ; Salvage, at the end of a level: each human saved this level (saved) adds
 165+ C13B              ; a salvage point (salvage_points).  Every point total in salvage_tab that
 166+ C13B              ; the new total reaches (passed over from the old one) gives its rewards: a
 167+ C13B              ; weapon unlocked (one more of that type in wpn_stock, for the load-out page)
 168+ C13B              ; and / or (SA_* flags) a full repair (vtol_hp = VTOL_HP) or the booster
 169+ C13B              ; module (fitted at once, its tank full).  After the table's last total,
 170+ C13B              ; SALVAGE_TAIL, every SALVAGE_STEP more points is a full repair.  Shown on
 171+ C13B              ; the LEVEL COMPLETE screen: the humans saved, the salvage, and a line for
 172+ C13B              ; each reward (rows SA_ROW0..SA_ROW_MAX; any more aren't shown).
 173+ C13B              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 174+ C13B              SA_REPAIR       equ 1               ; salvage_tab rewards (flags): full repair,
 175+ C13B              SA_BOOSTER      equ 2               ;   the booster module,

 177+ C13B              SA_NV_MONO      equ 8               ;   vision green, monochrome,
 178+ C13B              SA_THERMAL      equ 16              ;   thermal, the vertical thrusters
 179+ C13B              SA_VTHRUST      equ 32              ;   (vthrust_fitted), the lateral
 180+ C13B              SA_LTHRUST      equ 64              ;   thrusters (lthrust_fitted)
 181+ C13B              SALVAGE_TAIL    equ 145
 182+ C13B              SALVAGE_STEP    equ 5
 183+ C13B              SA_ROW0         equ 16
 184+ C13B              SA_ROW_MAX      equ 22

 246+ C1B3              ; Carry set if total DE is reached this time: sa_old < DE <= salvage_points.

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - level loading (8K page PAGE_LEVEL, game logic: runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6; it pages the file handler, PAGE_FILE, into slot 7)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; Each level is a file, ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPL, naming its city, ZPDATA/CITYnn.ZPC
   6+ C000              ; (both made by gentables.py; the formats are described there).  A city is
   7+ C000              ; played for several levels.  load_level reads both:
   8+ C000              ;   * the level record into level_cur (levels.asm): city name, zombie and
   9+ C000              ;     wave counts, the draw distance, ...;
  10+ C000              ;   * the city into the city bank (page 7, slot 3): city_col at $6000 and
  11+ C000              ;     city_map at $7000, one 8K read;
  12+ C000              ;   * the level's own map changes (x, z, cell code, city_col), for hand-made
  13+ C000              ;     layouts;
  14+ C000              ;   * the city's palette and sky colour into the Layer 2 palette, then the
  15+ C000              ;     level's own palette over it, if it has one (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPP);
  16+ C000              ;   * view_r / dot_r from the draw distance (2..VIEW_R tiles).
  17+ C000              ; Loading the map also clears every cell's zombie and human marks.  The
  18+ C000              ; files must be in the ZPDATA folder beside zpolice.nex on the SD card.
  19+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  20+ C000
  21+ C000              ; Level file
  22+ C000              LVF_CITY        equ 5               ; city number
  23+ C000              LVF_REC         equ 6               ; the level record (LV_SIZE bytes)
  24+ C000              LVF_NCHG        equ LVF_REC+LV_SIZE ; number of map changes,
  25+ C000              LVF_CHG         equ LVF_NCHG+1      ; then x, z, cell code, city_col each
  26+ C000              LVF_CHG_MAX     equ 64
  27+ C000              LVF_MAX         equ LVF_CHG+4*LVF_CHG_MAX
  28+ C000              ; City file
  29+ C000              CTF_SKY         equ 14              ; sky colour: RRRGGGBB, low blue bit
  30+ C000              CTF_PAL         equ 32              ; the palette, 256 pairs
  31+ C000              CTF_DATA        equ CTF_PAL+512     ; then city_col, city_map
  32+ C000              ; Level palette file (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPP, optional: tools/levelpal.py)
  33+ C000              LPF_PAL         equ 8               ; the palette, 256 pairs
  34+ C000              LPF_SIZE        equ LPF_PAL+512
  35+ C000              LEVEL_VERSION   equ 2               ; the files' format versions (+4): the
  36+ C000              CITY_VERSION    equ 1               ;   level file's 2 (specials by wave)
  37+ C000              LPAL_VERSION    equ 1
  38+ C000              ; Vision palette file (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPV: tools/visionpal.py)
  39+ C000              VPF_PAL         equ 8               ; 4 palettes (VM_MODES), 256 pairs each
  40+ C000              VPF_SIZE        equ VPF_PAL+4*512
  41+ C000              VPAL_VERSION    equ 1
  42+ C000              LDERR_BADFILE   equ 255             ; error code: not a valid file
  43+ C000
  44+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  45+ C000              ; A = level (1..99): load it.  Carry set on failure, A = the esxDOS error
  46+ C000              ; code or LDERR_BADFILE.  Leaves PAGE_FILE in slot 7.
  47+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  48+ C000              load_level:
  49+ C000 0E 2F                ld c,'0'-1                      ; the level's two digits
  50+ C002 0C           .tens:  inc c
  51+ C003 D6 0A                sub 10
  52+ C005 30 FB                jr nc,.tens
  53+ C007 C6 3A                add a,'0'+10
  54+ C009 32 6B C2             ld (ll_level+13),a
  55+ C00C 79                   ld a,c
  56+ C00D 32 6A C2             ld (ll_level+12),a
  57+ C010 ED 91 57 10          nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE
  58+ C014 21 5E C2             ld hl,ll_level                  ; the level file
  59+ C017 11 C2 CA             ld de,ll_lbuf
  60+ C01A 01 78 01             ld bc,LVF_MAX
  61+ C01D CD 81 E0             call fh_load
  62+ C020 D8                   ret c
  63+ C021 21 C2 CA             ld hl,ll_lbuf
  64+ C024 11 96 C2             ld de,ll_lmagic
  65+ C027 0E 02                ld c,LEVEL_VERSION
  66+ C029 CD C0 C1             call ll_check
  67+ C02C D8                   ret c
  68+ C02D 21 C8 CA             ld hl,ll_lbuf+LVF_REC           ; its record
  69+ C030 11 5B A0             ld de,level_cur
  70+ C033 01 71 00             ld bc,LV_SIZE
  71+ C036 ED B0                ldir
  72+ C038 3A C7 CA             ld a,(ll_lbuf+LVF_CITY)         ; its city file: two digits
  73+ C03B 0E 2F                ld c,'0'-1

  75+ C03E D6 0A                sub 10
  76+ C040 30 FB                jr nc,.ctens
  77+ C042 C6 3A                add a,'0'+10
  78+ C044 32 7D C2             ld (ll_city+12),a
  79+ C047 79                   ld a,c
  80+ C048 32 7C C2             ld (ll_city+11),a
  81+ C04B 21 71 C2             ld hl,ll_city
  82+ C04E 06 01                ld b,FA_READ|FA_OPEN_EX
  83+ C050 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
  84+ C053 D8                   ret c
  85+ C054 21 3A CC             ld hl,ll_cbuf                   ; header and palette
  86+ C057 01 20 02             ld bc,CTF_DATA
  87+ C05A CD 2E E0             call fh_read
  88+ C05D DA 2C C1             jp c,.cerr
  89+ C060 3A 17 E1             ld a,(fh_handle)                ; city_col and city_map: the whole
  90+ C063 21 00 60             ld hl,city_col                  ; city bank, in one read
  91+ C066 01 00 20             ld bc,2*GRID*GRID
  92+ C069 CD 2E E0             call fh_read
  93+ C06C DA 2C C1             jp c,.cerr

  95+ C070 FE 20                cp high (2*GRID*GRID)

   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - load-out screen (8K page PAGE_LOADOUT, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Before the first level (newGame) and between levels, after LEVEL COMPLETE
   5+ C000              ; (loadout_go pages it in).  On the
   6+ C000              ; left, the store: every weapon type unlocked (wpn_unlocked) with the number
   7+ C000              ; in store (wpn_stock), even 0 when the only one is fitted.  On the right,
   8+ C000              ; the VTOL's 5 weapon slots and what is fitted in each.
   9+ C000              ;   1-5    select a slot (yellow)
  10+ C000              ;   Q / A  move the highlight up / down the store list.  The highlighted
  11+ C000              ;          weapon is green if it can be fitted in the selected slot (the
  12+ C000              ;          slot allows it, wpn_fits, and one is in store), red if not; the
  13+ C000              ;          rest of the list is white.

  15+ C000              ;          one comes out of the store, with a full load (WCFG_LOAD), and
  16+ C000              ;          whatever was fitted there goes back into the store

  18+ C000              ;          slot EMPTY (lo_unload)

  20+ C000              ;          (the centre slot); while it is empty 0: START LEVEL is red
  21+ C000              ; Uses the resident text routines (text.asm) and the keys page in slot 7.

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - redefine keys screen (8K page PAGE_KEYDEF, runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; From the main menu (option 9, keydef_go pages it in).  Lists every control
   6+ C000              ; (K_ACTIONS of them) with its key (key_defs) and its joystick input
   7+ C000              ; (joy_defs, "-" for none; input.asm).
   8+ C000              ;   Q / A  move the highlight up / down the list (white; highlighted green);
   9+ C000              ;          KD_VIS rows of it show, scrolling to keep the highlight in view
  10+ C000              ;   SPACE  "PRESS A KEY OR JOYSTICK", a second's pause, then the next input
  11+ C000              ;          becomes the highlighted control's key, or its joystick input if
  12+ C000              ;          it is a joystick's, unless another control already uses it: then
  13+ C000              ;          "KEY ALREADY IN USE" (for a second) and no change
  14+ C000              ;   0      every key and joystick input back to its default (key_defaults,
  15+ C000              ;          joy_defaults)
  16+ C000              ;   1      back to the main menu (menu_go), saving the definitions first if
  17+ C000              ;          they changed (kd_save; "KEYS NOT SAVED" for a second if they
  18+ C000              ;          couldn't be)
  19+ C000              ; These keys are fixed (key_code_pressed), whatever the controls are set to.
  20+ C000              ; Uses the resident text routines (text.asm) and the input page in slot 7.
  21+ C000              ;
  22+ C000              ; The definitions are kept on the SD card as ZPDATA/KEYS.ZPK (beside the level
  23+ C000              ; files): "ZPKY", KF_VERSION, K_ACTIONS, then key_defs and joy_defs (2 bytes
  24+ C000              ; each control).  start loads them (kd_load, with this page in slot 6), if the
  25+ C000              ; file is there and fits this game: else the defaults.
  26+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  27+ C000
  28+ C000              KD_ROW0         equ 1               ; first row of the list (under the title)
  29+ C000              KD_NAME_COL     equ 1               ; control names,
  30+ C000              KD_KEY_COL      equ 16              ; their keys,
  31+ C000              KD_KEY_LEN      equ 7               ;   (key names at most this long)
  32+ C000              KD_JOY_COL      equ 24              ; their joystick inputs
  33+ C000              KD_JOY_LEN      equ 8               ;   (joystick names at most this long)
  34+ C000                      ASSERT KD_KEY_COL + KD_KEY_LEN < KD_JOY_COL && KD_JOY_COL + KD_JOY_LEN <= 32
